"""Text is escaped per backend; generated prose cannot inject typesetting commands."""
from html import escape
import json
import re
from .document_model import Document
from ..expression import Number, Symbol, render, to_latex as expression_latex
from .typesetting import typst_style,typst_literal


def _math(expr, parent=0) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Number):
        return str(expr.value.numerator) if expr.value.denominator == 1 else f"frac({expr.value.numerator},{expr.value.denominator})"
    if isinstance(expr, Symbol):
        return expr.name if re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z]',expr.name) else "upright(" + json.dumps(expr.name) + ")"
    if expr.op == '/':return f"frac({_math(expr.left)},{_math(expr.right)})"
    if expr.op == '**':
        base=_math(expr.left)
        if not isinstance(expr.left,(Number,Symbol)) or isinstance(expr.left,Number) and expr.left.value<0:base='('+base+')'
        return base+'^('+_math(expr.right)+')'
    precedence=10 if expr.op in ('+','-') else 20
    operator=' ' if expr.op=='*' else ' '+expr.op+' '
    result=_math(expr.left,precedence)+operator+_math(expr.right,precedence+int(expr.op=='-'))
    return '('+result+')' if precedence<parent else result


def _latex_math(expr,parent=0):
    if isinstance(expr,(Number,Symbol)):return expression_latex(expr)
    if expr.op=='/':return r'\frac{'+_latex_math(expr.left)+'}{'+_latex_math(expr.right)+'}'
    if expr.op=='**':
        base=_latex_math(expr.left)
        if not isinstance(expr.left,(Number,Symbol)) or isinstance(expr.left,Number) and expr.left.value<0:
            base=r'\left('+base+r'\right)'
        return base+'^{'+_latex_math(expr.right)+'}'
    precedence=10 if expr.op in ('+','-') else 20
    operator=r'\,' if expr.op=='*' else ' '+expr.op+' '
    result=_latex_math(expr.left,precedence)+operator+_latex_math(expr.right,precedence+int(expr.op=='-'))
    return r'\left('+result+r'\right)' if precedence<parent else result



def _tex(text: str) -> str:
    replacements = {'\\': r'\textbackslash{}', '{': r'\{', '}': r'\}', '&': r'\&', '%': r'\%',
                    '$': r'\$', '#': r'\#', '_': r'\_', '~': r'\textasciitilde{}', '^': r'\textasciicircum{}'}
    pieces = re.split(r'([^\s]{48,})', text)
    def escaped(value):
        return ''.join(replacements.get(char, char) for char in value)
    return ''.join(r'\allowbreak{}'.join(escaped(piece[i:i+24]) for i in range(0,len(piece),24))
                   if len(piece)>=48 and not any(c.isspace() for c in piece) else escaped(piece) for piece in pieces)


def to_html(document: Document) -> str:
    lines = ['<!doctype html><html lang="pt"><meta charset="utf-8">', f'<title>{escape(document.title)}</title>',
             f'<h1>{escape(document.title)}</h1>', f'<p>Sintetico: {document.synthetic}</p>']
    lines.append('<style>body{max-width:900px;margin:2rem auto;font-family:serif}pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}img{max-width:100%}</style>')
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([f'<h2>{escape(section.heading)}</h2>', f'<pre>{escape(section.text)}</pre>',
                      f'<p>Evidencias: {escape(", ".join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations))}</p>'])
        lines.extend(f'<pre>{escape(render(eq.left))} = {escape(render(eq.right))}</pre>' for eq in section.equations)
        lines.extend(f'<figure><img src="{escape(fig.path)}" alt="{escape(fig.caption)}"><figcaption>{escape(fig.caption)}</figcaption></figure>' for fig in section.figures)
        for table in section.tables:
            lines.append('<table><caption>'+escape(table.caption)+'</caption><thead><tr>'+''.join('<th scope="col">'+escape(v)+'</th>' for v in table.headers)+'</tr></thead><tbody>')
            lines.extend('<tr>'+''.join('<td>'+escape(v)+'</td>' for v in row)+'</tr>' for row in table.rows)
            lines.append('</tbody></table>')
            lines.append('<p>Evidencias: '+escape(', '.join(table.evidence_ids))+'</p>')
    lines += [f'<p>{escape(ref.text())}</p>' for ref in document.references]
    return '\n'.join(lines + [f'<p>{escape(document.limitations)}</p>', '</html>', ''])


def to_latex(document: Document) -> str:
    lines = [r'\documentclass[10pt,a4paper]{article}', r'\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}', r'\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}',
             r'\usepackage{graphicx,amsmath,array,longtable,booktabs,microtype,fancyhdr,xcolor}',
             r'\IfFileExists{lmodern.sty}{\usepackage{lmodern}}{}',r'\microtypesetup{expansion=false}',
             r'\usepackage[left=22mm,right=22mm,top=25mm,bottom=27mm]{geometry}',
             r'\definecolor{nablaAccent}{HTML}{117879}', r'\definecolor{nablaMuted}{HTML}{526471}',
             r'\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}', r'\setlength{\parskip}{.65em}', r'\linespread{1.08}',
             r'\setlength{\headheight}{14pt}', r'\pagestyle{fancy}\fancyhf{}',
             r'\fancyhead[R]{\small\sffamily\textcolor{nablaMuted}{NABLA / SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING}}',
             r'\fancyfoot[L]{\fontsize{6.3}{7.5}\selectfont\ttfamily SHA-256: '+document.content_id+'}',
             r'\fancyfoot[R]{\small\thepage}', r'\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}',
             r'\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{.4pt}',r'\emergencystretch=2em',
             r'\begin{document}', r'{\small\sffamily\textcolor{nablaAccent}{NABLA / RESEARCH}}\par',
             r'{\LARGE\bfseries ' + _tex(document.title) + r'}\par\medskip',
             'Sintetico: ' + str(document.synthetic) + r'\par']
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([r'\section{\textcolor{nablaAccent}{' + _tex(section.heading) + '}}', _tex(section.text) + r'\par'])
        if section.evidence_ids or section.citations:
            lines.append('Evidencias: ' + _tex(', '.join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations)) + r'\par')
        lines.extend(r'\begin{equation}' + _latex_math(eq.left) + ' = ' + _latex_math(eq.right) + r'\end{equation}' for eq in section.equations)
        for fig in section.figures:
            lines.extend([r'\begin{figure}[htbp]\centering\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=95mm,keepaspectratio]{' + fig.path + '}',
                          r'\caption{'+_tex(fig.caption)+'}',r'\end{figure}'])
        for table in section.tables:
            column = r'>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{\dimexpr\linewidth/'+str(len(table.headers))+r'-2\tabcolsep\relax}'
            lines.extend([r'\begin{longtable}{'+column*len(table.headers)+'}',r'\caption{'+_tex(table.caption)+r'}\\',r'\toprule'])
            header = ' & '.join(r'\textbf{'+_tex(v)+'}' for v in table.headers)+r'\\ \midrule'
            lines.extend([header,r'\endfirsthead',r'\toprule',header,r'\endhead',r'\bottomrule\endfoot'])
            lines.extend(' & '.join(_tex(v) for v in row)+r'\\' for row in table.rows)
            lines.extend([r'\end{longtable}', r'\par Evidencias: '+_tex(', '.join(table.evidence_ids))])
    lines += [_tex(ref.text()) + r'\par' for ref in document.references]
    return '\n'.join(lines + [_tex(document.limitations), r'\end{document}', ''])


def to_typst(document: Document) -> str:
    def literal(value: str) -> str:
        return typst_literal(value)
    def text(value: str) -> str:
        return '#text(' + literal(value) + ')\n#parbreak()'
    def heading(value: str) -> str:
        return '#heading(level: 1, text(' + literal(value) + '))'
    lines = [typst_style(document.title,document.content_id),
             '#nabla-title('+literal(document.title)+', subtitle: '+literal('Sintetico: ' + str(document.synthetic))+')']
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([heading(section.heading), text(section.text)])
        if section.evidence_ids or section.citations:
            lines.append(text('Evidencias: ' + ', '.join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations)))
        lines.extend('$ ' + _math(eq.left) + ' = ' + _math(eq.right) + ' $' for eq in section.equations)
        lines.extend('#figure(align(center, image(' + json.dumps(fig.path) + ', width: 100%, height: 95mm, fit: "contain")), caption: text(' + literal(fig.caption) + '))' for fig in section.figures)
        for table in section.tables:
            cells = [v for row in table.rows for v in row]
            lines.append('#figure(table(columns: '+str(len(table.headers))+', '+
                         'table.header(repeat: true, '+', '.join('strong(text('+literal(v)+'))' for v in table.headers)+'), '+
                         ', '.join('text('+literal(v)+')' for v in cells)+
                         '), caption: text('+literal(table.caption)+'), kind: table)')
            if table.evidence_ids:
                lines.append(text('Evidencias: '+', '.join(table.evidence_ids)))
    if document.references:
        lines.append(heading('Referências'))
        lines += [text(ref.text()) for ref in document.references]
    return '\n\n'.join(lines + [heading('Limitações'), text(document.limitations), ''])

"""Content-addressed figure ingestion and integrity validation."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from .document_model import Figure


def ingest_figure(source: Path, asset_root: Path, caption: str) -> Figure:
    source, root = Path(source), Path(asset_root)
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    if not raw.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') or len(raw) > 32 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError('Figura deve ser PNG até 32 MiB')
    figure = Figure(f'figures/{hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}.png', caption)
    target = root / figure.path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        if target.read_bytes() != raw:
            raise ValueError('Artefato com hash incompatível')
    else:
        with target.open('xb') as output:
            output.write(raw)
    validate_figure(figure, root)
    return figure


def validate_figure(figure: Figure, asset_root: Path) -> Path:
    root = Path(asset_root).resolve()
    path = root / figure.path
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('Figura fora do diretório de artefatos')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if (not raw.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') or len(raw) > 32 * 1024 * 1024
            or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != path.stem):
        raise ValueError('Conteúdo da figura não corresponde ao identificador')
    return path
END FILE: src/nablamath/documents/figures.py

"""Frozen v1 rendering for verifying previously published document artifacts.

Preserved from be282f9; new publications use the current print profile.
"""
from html import escape
import json
import re
from .document_model import Document
from ..expression import Number, Symbol, render, to_latex as expression_latex


def _math(expr) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Number):
        return str(expr.value.numerator) if expr.value.denominator == 1 else f"({expr.value.numerator}/{expr.value.denominator})"
    if isinstance(expr, Symbol):
        return "upright(" + json.dumps(expr.name) + ")"
    op = "^" if expr.op == "**" else expr.op
    return f"({_math(expr.left)}) {op} ({_math(expr.right)})"



def _tex(text: str) -> str:
    replacements = {'\\': r'\textbackslash{}', '{': r'\{', '}': r'\}', '&': r'\&', '%': r'\%',
                    '$': r'\$', '#': r'\#', '_': r'\_', '~': r'\textasciitilde{}', '^': r'\textasciicircum{}'}
    pieces = re.split(r'([^\s]{48,})', text)
    def escaped(value):
        return ''.join(replacements.get(char, char) for char in value)
    return ''.join(r'\allowbreak{}'.join(escaped(piece[i:i+24]) for i in range(0,len(piece),24))
                   if len(piece)>=48 and not any(c.isspace() for c in piece) else escaped(piece) for piece in pieces)


def to_html(document: Document) -> str:
    lines = ['<!doctype html><html lang="pt"><meta charset="utf-8">', f'<title>{escape(document.title)}</title>',
             f'<h1>{escape(document.title)}</h1>', f'<p>Sintetico: {document.synthetic}</p>']
    lines.append('<style>body{max-width:900px;margin:2rem auto;font-family:serif}pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}img{max-width:100%}</style>')
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([f'<h2>{escape(section.heading)}</h2>', f'<pre>{escape(section.text)}</pre>',
                      f'<p>Evidencias: {escape(", ".join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations))}</p>'])
        lines.extend(f'<pre>{escape(render(eq.left))} = {escape(render(eq.right))}</pre>' for eq in section.equations)
        lines.extend(f'<figure><img src="{escape(fig.path)}" alt="{escape(fig.caption)}"><figcaption>{escape(fig.caption)}</figcaption></figure>' for fig in section.figures)
        for table in section.tables:
            lines.append('<table><caption>'+escape(table.caption)+'</caption><thead><tr>'+''.join('<th scope="col">'+escape(v)+'</th>' for v in table.headers)+'</tr></thead><tbody>')
            lines.extend('<tr>'+''.join('<td>'+escape(v)+'</td>' for v in row)+'</tr>' for row in table.rows)
            lines.append('</tbody></table>')
            lines.append('<p>Evidencias: '+escape(', '.join(table.evidence_ids))+'</p>')
    lines += [f'<p>{escape(ref.text())}</p>' for ref in document.references]
    return '\n'.join(lines + [f'<p>{escape(document.limitations)}</p>', '</html>', ''])


def to_latex(document: Document) -> str:
    lines = [r'\documentclass{article}', r'\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}', r'\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}', r'\usepackage{graphicx}', r'\usepackage{amsmath}', r'\usepackage[margin=2cm]{geometry}', r'\sloppy',
             r'\begin{document}', r'\section*{' + _tex(document.title) + '}',
             'Sintetico: ' + str(document.synthetic) + r'\par']
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([r'\subsection*{' + _tex(section.heading) + '}', _tex(section.text) + r'\par',
                      'Evidencias: ' + _tex(', '.join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations)) + r'\par'])
        lines.extend(r'\[' + expression_latex(eq.left) + ' = ' + expression_latex(eq.right) + r'\]' for eq in section.equations)
        for fig in section.figures:
            lines.extend([r'\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=.8\linewidth]{' + fig.path + r'}\par', _tex(fig.caption) + r'\par', r'\end{center}'])
        for table in section.tables:
            lines.extend([r'\begin{center}', _tex(table.caption)+r'\par',
                          r'\begin{tabular}{'+'l'*len(table.headers)+'}'])
            lines.append(' & '.join(_tex(v) for v in table.headers)+r'\\ \hline')
            lines.extend(' & '.join(_tex(v) for v in row)+r'\\' for row in table.rows)
            lines.extend([r'\end{tabular}', r'\par Evidencias: '+_tex(', '.join(table.evidence_ids)), r'\end{center}'])
    lines += [_tex(ref.text()) + r'\par' for ref in document.references]
    return '\n'.join(lines + [_tex(document.limitations), r'\end{document}', ''])


def to_typst(document: Document) -> str:
    def literal(value: str) -> str:
        # Explicit break opportunities prevent provenance hashes from overflowing.
        wrapped = re.sub(r'[^\s]{48,}', lambda m: '\u200b'.join(m[0][i:i+24] for i in range(0,len(m[0]),24)), value)
        return json.dumps(wrapped, ensure_ascii=False)
    def text(value: str) -> str:
        return '#text(' + literal(value) + ')\n#parbreak()'
    def heading(value: str) -> str:
        return '#heading(level: 1, text(' + literal(value) + '))'
    lines = ['#set page(paper: "a4", margin: 2cm)', '#set text(size: 10pt)',
             '#set par(justify: true, leading: 0.6em)', '#set heading(numbering: "1.")',
             '#align(center, text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold", ' + literal(document.title) + '))',
             text('Sintetico: ' + str(document.synthetic))]
    for section in document.sections:
        lines.extend([heading(section.heading), text(section.text)])
        if section.evidence_ids or section.citations:
            lines.append(text('Evidencias: ' + ', '.join(section.evidence_ids + section.citations)))
        lines.extend('$ ' + _math(eq.left) + ' = ' + _math(eq.right) + ' $' for eq in section.equations)
        lines.extend('#figure(image(' + json.dumps(fig.path) + ', width: 90%), caption: text(' + literal(fig.caption) + '))' for fig in section.figures)
        for table in section.tables:
            cells = [*table.headers, *(v for row in table.rows for v in row)]
            lines.append('#figure(table(columns: '+str(len(table.headers))+', '+
                         ', '.join('text('+literal(v)+')' for v in cells)+
                         '), caption: text('+literal(table.caption)+'))')
            if table.evidence_ids:
                lines.append(text('Evidencias: '+', '.join(table.evidence_ids)))
    if document.references:
        lines.append(heading('Referências'))
        lines += [text(ref.text()) for ref in document.references]
    return '\n\n'.join(lines + [heading('Limitações'), text(document.limitations), ''])

"""Optional PDF compilation, isolated from the checkout and without shell escape."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import importlib.util
import sys

from .document_model import Document
from .exporters import to_latex, to_typst
from ..artifacts.process import run_renderer


def build_pdf(document: Document, destination: Path, backend: str = "typst", *, asset_root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    commands = {"typst": ("typst", "typ", to_typst), "latex": ("pdflatex", "tex", to_latex)}
    if backend not in commands:
        raise ValueError("Backend PDF desconhecido")
    name, suffix, exporter = commands[backend]
    compiler = shutil.which(name)
    python_typst = backend == 'typst' and compiler is None and importlib.util.find_spec('typst') is not None
    if compiler is None and not python_typst:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Compilador opcional ausente: {name}")
    destination = Path(destination)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(destination)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nabla-document-") as directory:
        root = Path(directory)
        for section in document.sections:
            for figure in section.figures:
                if asset_root is None:
                    raise ValueError("Figuras requerem diretorio de artefatos")
                from .figures import validate_figure
                asset = validate_figure(figure, asset_root)
                if asset.is_symlink() or not asset.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(asset_root).resolve()):
                    raise ValueError("Figura fora do diretorio de artefatos")
                target = root / figure.path
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(asset, target)
        source = root / f"document.{suffix}"
        source.write_text(exporter(document), encoding="utf-8")
        args = ([compiler, "compile", "--root", str(root), str(source), str(root / "document.pdf")]
                if backend == "typst" else
                [compiler, "-no-shell-escape", "-interaction=nonstopmode", "-halt-on-error", source.name])
        if python_typst:
            args = [sys.executable, '-c',
                    'import sys,typst; open(sys.argv[2],"wb").write(typst.compile(sys.argv[1], root=sys.argv[3]))',
                    str(source), str(root/'document.pdf'), str(root)]
        run_renderer(args,cwd=root,timeout=60)
        if backend == 'latex':
            # Repeated table headers, widths and page references settle on pass two.
            run_renderer(args,cwd=root,timeout=60)
        pdf = root / "document.pdf"
        if not pdf.is_file() or not pdf.read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-'):
            raise RuntimeError("Compilacao PDF falhou: PDF ausente ou inválido")
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with destination.open('xb') as output:
            output.write(pdf.read_bytes())
    return destination
END FILE: src/nablamath/documents/pdf_builder.py

"""Common-AST profiles for research papers, engineering reports and teaching notes."""
from .document_model import Document,Section

PROFILES={
 'research_paper':('Hypothesis','Method','Results','Discussion'),
 'engineering_report':('Requirements','Model','Verification','Results','Operating limits'),
 'teaching':('Learning objectives','Assumptions','Worked examples','Exercises','Solutions'),
}


def build_profile(profile,title,sections,*,limitations,references=(),synthetic=True):
    if profile not in PROFILES or not isinstance(sections,dict) or set(sections)!=set(PROFILES[profile]):
        raise ValueError('Perfil requer todas as seções declaradas sem seções desconhecidas')
    ordered=[]
    for name in PROFILES[profile]:
        section=sections[name]
        if not isinstance(section,Section) or section.heading!=name:raise ValueError('Seção deve corresponder ao perfil')
        ordered.append(section)
    evidential={'research_paper':'Results','engineering_report':'Verification','teaching':'Worked examples'}[profile]
    section=sections[evidential]
    if not section.evidence_ids and not any(t.evidence_ids for t in section.tables):raise ValueError('Perfil requer evidência rastreável')
    return Document(title,tuple(ordered),synthetic,limitations,tuple(references))
END FILE: src/nablamath/documents/profiles.py

"""Atomic publication of a shared scientific document and its provenance."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
from .document_model import Document, Section
from .exporters import to_html, to_latex, to_typst
from .figures import validate_figure
from .pdf_builder import build_pdf
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json


def research_document(title, *, hypothesis, method, results, discussion, limitations,
                      evidence_ids, equations=(), figures=(), references=(), synthetic=True):
    if not evidence_ids:
        raise ValueError('Resultados requerem identificadores de evidência')
    return Document(title, (Section('Hipótese', hypothesis), Section('Método', method),
                    Section('Resultados', results, tuple(evidence_ids), tuple(equations), tuple(figures)),
                    Section('Discussão', discussion)), synthetic, limitations, tuple(references))


def publish(document: Document, destination: Path, *, asset_root=None, pdf_backend=None, evidence_sources=None, require_evidence=False):
    destination = Path(destination)
    evidence_sources = evidence_sources or {}
    requested = {key for section in document.sections
                 for key in (*section.evidence_ids, *(key for table in section.tables for key in table.evidence_ids))}
    if set(evidence_sources)-requested:
        raise ValueError('Fonte de evidência não citada')
    if require_evidence and requested-set(evidence_sources):
        raise ValueError('Evidência citada sem fonte verificável')
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.studio-', dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        evidence = {}
        for key, source in evidence_sources.items():
            raw = Path(source).read_bytes()
            if len(raw)>32*1024*1024 or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=key:
                raise ValueError('Evidência não corresponde ao SHA-256 citado')
            name = 'evidence/'+key+'.json'
            target = stage/name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
            evidence[key] = name
        for section in document.sections:
            for figure in section.figures:
                if asset_root is None:
                    raise ValueError('Figuras requerem raiz de artefatos')
                source = validate_figure(figure, asset_root)
                target = stage / figure.path
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        for suffix, exporter in [('html', to_html), ('tex', to_latex), ('typ', to_typst)]:
            (stage/f'document.{suffix}').write_text(exporter(document), encoding='utf-8')
        (stage/'document.json').write_text(canonical_json(document.to_data())+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
        if pdf_backend:
            build_pdf(document, stage/'document.pdf', pdf_backend, asset_root=stage)
        manifest = {'schema_version': 1, 'render_profile':'nabla-print-v2','document_id': document.content_id, 'pdf_backend': pdf_backend,
                    'evidence': evidence, 'unresolved_evidence': sorted(requested-set(evidence)),
                    'files': {p.relative_to(stage).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                              for p in sorted(stage.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}}
        (stage/'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
        if not verify_publication(stage):
            raise ValueError('Publicação não reproduzível')
        stage.rename(destination)
        return manifest
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify_publication(root):
    try:
        root = Path(root)
        if any(p.is_symlink() for p in root.rglob('*')) or (root/'manifest.json').stat().st_size > 1024*1024:
            return False
        manifest = json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        files = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'manifest.json'}
        if set(manifest['files']) != files:
            return False
        for name, digest in manifest['files'].items():
            path = root/name
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
                return False
            if path.stat().st_size > 32*1024*1024:
                return False
            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
                return False
        document = Document.from_data(json.loads((root/'document.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
        if document.content_id != manifest['document_id']:
            return False
        profile = manifest.get('render_profile','nabla-print-v1')
        if profile=='nabla-print-v1':
            from .legacy_exporters import to_html as html,to_latex as latex,to_typst as typst
        elif profile=='nabla-print-v2':
            html,latex,typst = to_html,to_latex,to_typst
        else:
            return False
        for suffix, exporter in [('html', html), ('tex', latex), ('typ', typst)]:
            if (root/f'document.{suffix}').read_text(encoding='utf-8') != exporter(document):
                return False
        expected = {'document.json', 'document.html', 'document.tex', 'document.typ'}
        requested = {key for section in document.sections
                 for key in (*section.evidence_ids, *(key for table in section.tables for key in table.evidence_ids))}
        evidence = manifest['evidence']
        if set(evidence)-requested or manifest['unresolved_evidence'] != sorted(requested-set(evidence)):
            return False
        for key, name in evidence.items():
            if name != 'evidence/'+key+'.json' or hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=key:
                return False
            expected.add(name)
        for section in document.sections:
            for figure in section.figures:
                validate_figure(figure, root)
                expected.add(figure.path)
        if manifest['pdf_backend'] is not None:
            if manifest['pdf_backend'] not in {'latex', 'typst'} or not (root/'document.pdf').read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-'):
                return False
            expected.add('document.pdf')
        if expected != files:
            return False
        return manifest['schema_version'] == 1
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, OSError):
        return False

"""Resolve explicit document evidence links against a scientific artifact DAG."""
from .document_model import Document
from ..core.scientific_artifact import ScientificArtifact
from ..core.semantic_contracts import require_digest
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from ..knowledge.lineage import LineageGraph


def document_reference_graph(document: Document, artifact: ScientificArtifact):
    if not isinstance(document, Document) or not isinstance(artifact, ScientificArtifact):
        raise ValueError("Document and scientific artifact required")
    available = {node.content_id for node in artifact.nodes}
    sections, referenced = [], set()
    for index, section in enumerate(document.sections):
        links = [require_digest(key) for key in section.evidence_ids]
        if len(set(links)) != len(links) or any(key not in available for key in links):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate or unresolved document evidence")
        referenced.update(links)
        sections.append({"index": index, "heading": section.heading, "evidence_ids": sorted(links),
                         "citation_keys": sorted(section.citations)})
    nodes = [{"id": node.content_id, "parents": list(node.parents)} for node in artifact.nodes]
    nodes.append({"id": document.content_id, "parents": sorted(referenced)})
    graph = LineageGraph.create(nodes)
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "document_id": document.content_id, "artifact_id": artifact.content_id,
              "sections": sections, "lineage": graph.to_data(), "lineage_id": graph.content_id,
              "scope": "explicit reference availability; text entailment and editorial acceptance require review"}
    return {**report, "report_id": fingerprint(report)}

"""Shared print typography; content is always supplied as escaped literals."""
import json
import re


def typst_literal(value):
    wrapped = re.sub(r'[^\s]{40,}', lambda match:'\u200b'.join(
        match[0][i:i+24] for i in range(0,len(match[0]),24)), str(value))
    return json.dumps(wrapped,ensure_ascii=False)


def typst_style(title, content_id, *, language='pt'):
    if language not in {'pt','en','es','fr','de'}:
        raise ValueError('Unsupported publication language')
    template = r'''
#let ink = rgb("172b3a")
#let accent = rgb("117879")
#let muted = rgb("526471")
#set document(title: TITLE)
#set page(paper: "a4", margin: (left: 22mm, right: 22mm, top: 23mm, bottom: 29mm),
  header: align(right, text(size: 7.5pt, fill: muted, "NABLA  /  SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING")),
  footer: context [
    #set text(font: "DejaVu Sans Mono", size: 6.5pt, fill: muted)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt + rgb("c9d5db"))
    #v(3pt)
    #text("SHA-256: " + IDENTIFIER)
    #h(1fr) #counter(page).display()
  ])
#set text(font: ("Libertinus Serif", "New Computer Modern"), size: 10.5pt,
          lang: LANGUAGE, fill: ink, hyphenate: true)
#set par(justify: true, leading: 0.7em, spacing: 0.8em)
#set heading(numbering: "1.")
#show heading: it => block(above: 1.4em, below: 0.65em, sticky: true)[
  #set text(font: "DejaVu Sans", weight: "bold", fill: accent, hyphenate: false,
            size: if it.level == 1 { 12pt } else { 10.5pt })
  #it
]
#set math.equation(numbering: "(1)")
#show math.equation: set block(above: 0.9em, below: 0.9em)
#show figure.caption: set text(size: 8.5pt, fill: muted)
#show figure.where(kind: table): set block(breakable: true)
#set figure(gap: 7pt)
#set table(inset: (x: 6pt, y: 5pt), align: left,
           stroke: (x: none, y: 0.35pt + rgb("dbe3e7")),
           fill: (x,y) => if calc.odd(y) { rgb("f2f6f7") } else { none })
#let nabla-title(value, subtitle: none) = {
  block(above: 6mm, below: 7mm)[
    #text(font: "DejaVu Sans", size: 8pt, tracking: 1.2pt, fill: accent)[NABLA / RESEARCH]
    #v(9pt)
    #text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold", hyphenate: false, value)
    #if subtitle != none { v(8pt); text(size: 9pt, fill: muted, subtitle) }
    #v(12pt)
    #line(length: 22mm, stroke: 2pt + accent)
  ]
}
'''
    literals = {'TITLE':typst_literal(title),'IDENTIFIER':json.dumps(content_id),'LANGUAGE':json.dumps(language)}
    return re.sub(r'\b(TITLE|IDENTIFIER|LANGUAGE)\b',lambda match:literals[match[0]],template)

"""Global DNA/RNA/protein alignment by Needleman-Wunsch, with deterministic ties."""
import math


def align_sequences(first, second, *, match=1, mismatch=-1, gap=-1):
    if any(not isinstance(s, str) or not s or not s.isascii() or not s.isalpha() for s in (first, second)):
        raise ValueError('Sequences must be nonempty ASCII letters; gaps are inserted by the aligner')
    if len(first)*len(second) > 1000000 or max(len(first), len(second)) > 10000:
        raise ValueError('Alignment exceeds budget')
    if any(type(x) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(x) for x in (match,mismatch,gap)):
        raise ValueError('Scores must be finite numbers')
    first, second = first.upper(), second.upper()
    n, m = len(first), len(second)
    scores = [[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(n+1):
        scores[i][0] = i*gap
    for j in range(m+1):
        scores[0][j] = j*gap
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            scores[i][j] = max(scores[i-1][j-1]+(match if first[i-1] == second[j-1] else mismatch),
                               scores[i-1][j]+gap, scores[i][j-1]+gap)
    a, b, i, j = [], [], n, m
    while i or j:
        if i and j and scores[i][j] == scores[i-1][j-1]+(match if first[i-1] == second[j-1] else mismatch):
            a.append(first[i-1]); b.append(second[j-1]); i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif i and scores[i][j] == scores[i-1][j]+gap:
            a.append(first[i-1]); b.append('-'); i -= 1
        else:
            a.append('-'); b.append(second[j-1]); j -= 1
    a, b = ''.join(reversed(a)), ''.join(reversed(b))
    return {'first': a, 'second': b, 'score': scores[n][m],
            'identity': sum(x == y for x,y in zip(a,b))/len(a),
            'algorithm': 'needleman_wunsch', 'scoring': {'match':match,'mismatch':mismatch,'gap':gap},
            'limitations': 'Global alignment with linear gaps; no evolutionary or clinical inference.'}


def gc_content(sequence):
    if not isinstance(sequence, str) or not sequence or set(sequence.upper()) - set('ACGT'):
        raise ValueError('An unambiguous DNA sequence is required')
    sequence = sequence.upper()
    return (sequence.count('G') + sequence.count('C'))/len(sequence)

"""Spherical distances, WGS84/Web Mercator transforms and raster NDVI."""
import math

EARTH_RADIUS_M = 6371008.8
MERCATOR_RADIUS_M = 6378137.0
MERCATOR_LATITUDE_LIMIT = 85.0511287798066


def _coordinate(longitude, latitude):
    if any(type(v) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in (longitude,latitude)):
        raise ValueError('Coordinates must be finite numbers')
    if not -180 <= longitude <= 180 or not -90 <= latitude <= 90:
        raise ValueError('Longitude/latitude outside WGS84 range')
    return math.radians(longitude), math.radians(latitude)


def haversine(first, second, *, radius=EARTH_RADIUS_M):
    if len(first) != 2 or len(second) != 2 or not math.isfinite(radius) or radius <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Require two (longitude,latitude) pairs and a positive radius')
    lon1, lat1 = _coordinate(*first); lon2, lat2 = _coordinate(*second)
    a = math.sin((lat2-lat1)/2)**2 + math.cos(lat1)*math.cos(lat2)*math.sin((lon2-lon1)/2)**2
    return 2*radius*math.asin(math.sqrt(min(1,max(0,a))))


def to_web_mercator(longitude, latitude):
    lon, lat = _coordinate(longitude, latitude)
    if abs(latitude) > MERCATOR_LATITUDE_LIMIT:
        raise ValueError('Latitude outside EPSG:3857 extent')
    return MERCATOR_RADIUS_M*lon, MERCATOR_RADIUS_M*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat/2))


def from_web_mercator(x, y):
    limit = MERCATOR_RADIUS_M*math.pi
    if any(not math.isfinite(v) or abs(v) > limit+1e-6 for v in (x,y)):
        raise ValueError('Coordinate outside EPSG:3857 extent')
    return math.degrees(x/MERCATOR_RADIUS_M), math.degrees(2*math.atan(math.exp(y/MERCATOR_RADIUS_M))-math.pi/2)


def ndvi(near_infrared, red, *, nodata=None):
    """Return a NumPy raster; zero denominators and optional nodata become NaN."""
    try:
        import numpy as np
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise ImportError('Install nablamath[research] for raster processing') from exc
    nir, red = np.asarray(near_infrared,dtype=float), np.asarray(red,dtype=float)
    if nir.shape != red.shape or nir.size > 10000000:
        raise ValueError('Bands require matching shapes within the raster budget')
    valid = np.isfinite(nir) & np.isfinite(red) & ((nir+red) != 0)
    if nodata is not None:
        valid &= (nir != nodata) & (red != nodata)
    result = np.full(nir.shape, np.nan)
    np.divide(nir-red, nir+red, out=result, where=valid)
    return result

"""Small state-vector and density-matrix simulator; qubit zero is most significant."""
import math
import random


def simulate_circuit(qubits, gates, *, shots=0, seed=0, density_matrix=False):
    if type(qubits) is not int or not 1 <= qubits <= 12:
        raise ValueError('Require 1–12 qubits')
    if not isinstance(gates, list) or len(gates) > 1000 or type(shots) is not int or not 0 <= shots <= 100000:
        raise ValueError('Circuit or shot budget exceeded')
    if type(seed) is not int or type(density_matrix) is not bool or (density_matrix and qubits > 8):
        raise ValueError('Invalid seed or density-matrix budget (maximum 8 qubits)')
    state = [0j]*(1 << qubits); state[0] = 1+0j
    root = 1/math.sqrt(2)
    matrices = {'X':((0,1),(1,0)), 'Y':((0,-1j),(1j,0)), 'Z':((1,0),(0,-1)),
                'H':((root,root),(root,-root)), 'S':((1,0),(0,1j)),
                'T':((1,0),(0,complex(root,root)))}
    for gate in gates:
        if not isinstance(gate,dict) or gate.get('gate') not in {*matrices,'CX','RZ'}:
            raise ValueError('Unknown quantum gate')
        name, target = gate['gate'], gate.get('target')
        expected = {'gate','target'} | ({'control'} if name == 'CX' else {'angle'} if name == 'RZ' else set())
        if set(gate) != expected or type(target) is not int or not 0 <= target < qubits:
            raise ValueError('Invalid gate fields or target')
        mask = 1 << (qubits-1-target)
        if name == 'CX':
            control = gate['control']
            if type(control) is not int or not 0 <= control < qubits or control == target:
                raise ValueError('Invalid control qubit')
            cmask = 1 << (qubits-1-control)
            for i in range(len(state)):
                if i & cmask and not i & mask:
                    state[i], state[i|mask] = state[i|mask], state[i]
        else:
            if name == 'RZ':
                angle = gate['angle']
                if type(angle) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(angle):
                    raise ValueError('Finite angle in radians required')
                phase = complex(math.cos(angle/2),math.sin(angle/2))
                matrix = ((phase.conjugate(),0),(0,phase))
            else:
                matrix = matrices[name]
            for i in range(len(state)):
                if not i & mask:
                    a,b = state[i],state[i|mask]
                    state[i],state[i|mask] = matrix[0][0]*a+matrix[0][1]*b, matrix[1][0]*a+matrix[1][1]*b
    probabilities = [abs(z)**2 for z in state]
    norm = sum(probabilities)
    if not math.isfinite(norm) or abs(norm-1) > 1e-10:
        raise ArithmeticError('Circuit lost normalization')
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    counts = {}
    # Random.choices avoids a shot-by-state Python loop.
    for sample in rng.choices(range(len(state)), weights=probabilities, k=shots):
        key = format(sample, f'0{qubits}b'); counts[key] = counts.get(key,0)+1
    pair = lambda z: [z.real,z.imag]
    result = {'state': [pair(z) for z in state], 'probabilities': probabilities, 'counts': counts,
              'seed':seed, 'qubit_order':'most_significant_first', 'norm_error':abs(norm-1),
              'limitations':'Ideal noiseless unitary simulation; no physical quantum hardware.'}
    if density_matrix:
        result['density_matrix'] = [[pair(a*b.conjugate()) for b in state] for a in state]
    return result


def apply_channel(density, kraus):
    """Apply a trace-preserving Kraus channel to a validated density matrix."""
    try:
        import numpy as np
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise ImportError('Install nablamath[research] for quantum channels') from exc
    rho = np.asarray(density, dtype=complex)
    if rho.ndim != 2 or rho.shape[0] != rho.shape[1] or not 1 <= rho.shape[0] <= 256:
        raise ValueError('Density matrix must be square and bounded')
    n = len(rho)
    if not np.isfinite(rho).all() or not np.allclose(rho,rho.conj().T,atol=1e-10,rtol=0) or abs(np.trace(rho)-1) > 1e-10 or np.linalg.eigvalsh(rho).min() < -1e-10:
        raise ValueError('Density matrix must be Hermitian, positive and trace one')
    if not 1 <= len(kraus) <= 64:
        raise ValueError('Require 1–64 Kraus operators')
    operators = [np.asarray(k,dtype=complex) for k in kraus]
    if any(k.shape != rho.shape or not np.isfinite(k).all() for k in operators):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Kraus operator')
    if not np.allclose(sum(k.conj().T@k for k in operators),np.eye(n),atol=1e-10,rtol=0):
        raise ValueError('Channel must preserve trace')
    return sum(k@rho@k.conj().T for k in operators)

"""Ideal continuous logistic populations and normalized closed SIR dynamics."""
import math
from ...math.equations.ode import integrate
from ..contracts import si,result,ONE,SECOND


def logistic(initial,capacity,rate,duration,*,steps=200):
    p=si(initial,ONE,positive=True);k=si(capacity,ONE,positive=True);r=si(rate,ONE/SECOND,positive=True);t=si(duration,SECOND,positive=True)
    if r*t>50 or type(steps) is not int or not 2<=steps<=100000 or float(r*t)/steps>.1:
        raise ValueError('Integração fora do regime limitado de passo')
    if p>k:
        raise ValueError('Este perfil requer população inicial até a capacidade')
    trajectory=integrate(lambda time,state:(float(r)*state[0]*(1-state[0]/float(k)),),(float(p),),0.,float(t),steps,'rk4')
    reference=float(k)/(1+(float(k/p)-1)*math.exp(-float(r*t)))
    final=trajectory[-1][1][0]
    return result('biology','continuous_logistic_population',{'initial':initial,'capacity':capacity,'rate':rate,'duration':duration,'steps':steps},
                  {'final':final,'analytic_reference':reference,'absolute_error':abs(final-reference),'trajectory':trajectory},
                  {'population':'dimensionless_count','time':'s','rate':'1/s'},
                  {'positive_and_bounded':all(0<s[0]<=float(k)*(1+1e-12) for _,s in trajectory),
                   'analytic_agreement':abs(final-reference)<=1e-6*max(1,abs(reference))},
                  'Continuous ideal population; no stochasticity, spatial effects or empirical biological validation.')


def sir(initial,beta,gamma,duration,*,steps=400):
    from ...core.semantic_ir import rational
    state=tuple(rational(v) for v in initial)
    b=si(beta,ONE/SECOND,positive=True);g=si(gamma,ONE/SECOND,positive=True);t=si(duration,SECOND,positive=True)
    if len(state)!=3 or any(v<0 for v in state) or sum(state)!=1 or type(steps) is not int or not 2<=steps<=100000 or (b+g)*t/steps>1/10:
        raise ValueError('SIR requer frações normalizadas e passo suficientemente pequeno')
    def derivative(time,values):
        s,i,r=values;infection=float(b)*s*i;recovery=float(g)*i
        return -infection,infection-recovery,recovery
    trajectory=integrate(derivative,tuple(float(v) for v in state),0.,float(t),steps,'rk4')
    residual=max(abs(sum(row)-1) for _,row in trajectory)
    return result('biology','closed_normalized_SIR',{'initial':state,'beta':beta,'gamma':gamma,'duration':duration,'steps':steps},
                  {'trajectory':trajectory,'final':trajectory[-1][1],'population_residual':residual},
                  {'state':'population_fraction','time':'s','rates':'1/s'},
                  {'population_conserved':residual<1e-10,'nonnegative':all(min(row)>=-1e-12 for _,row in trajectory)},
                  'Homogeneous closed deterministic SIR, no demographics or interventions; not an epidemic forecast.')
END FILE: src/nablamath/domains/biology/__init__.py

"""Exact elemental balancing for neutral formulas and ideal two-species equilibrium."""
from collections import Counter
from functools import reduce
from fractions import Fraction
import math
import re
from ...core.semantic_ir import rational
from ...math.linear_algebra import Matrix
from ..contracts import result,si,ONE,MOLE


ELEMENTS=frozenset('H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Sc Ti V Cr Mn Fe Co Ni Cu Zn Ga Ge As Se Br Kr Rb Sr Y Zr Nb Mo Tc Ru Rh Pd Ag Cd In Sn Sb Te I Xe Cs Ba La Ce Pr Nd Pm Sm Eu Gd Tb Dy Ho Er Tm Yb Lu Hf Ta W Re Os Ir Pt Au Hg Tl Pb Bi Po At Rn Fr Ra Ac Th Pa U Np Pu Am Cm Bk Cf Es Fm Md No Lr Rf Db Sg Bh Hs Mt Ds Rg Cn Nh Fl Mc Lv Ts Og'.split())

def composition(formula):
    if not isinstance(formula,str) or not formula or len(formula)>128:
        raise ValueError('Fórmula neutra limitada obrigatória')
    tokens=re.findall(r'[A-Z][a-z]?|\d+|[()]',formula)
    if ''.join(tokens)!=formula or len(tokens)>64:
        raise ValueError('Isótopos, cargas e notação desconhecida não suportados')
    stack=[Counter()]; index=0
    while index<len(tokens):
        token=tokens[index]
        if token=='(':
            if len(stack)>=5:
                raise ValueError('Fórmula muito aninhada')
            stack.append(Counter());index+=1;continue
        if token==')':
            if len(stack)==1 or not stack[-1]:
                raise ValueError('Parêntese inválido')
            group=stack.pop()
        elif re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z][a-z]?',token):
            if token not in ELEMENTS:raise ValueError('Elemento químico desconhecido')
            group=Counter({token:1})
        else:
            raise ValueError('Contagem sem elemento')
        index+=1;count=1
        if index<len(tokens) and tokens[index].isdigit():
            count=int(tokens[index]);index+=1
        if not 1<=count<=1000:
            raise ValueError('Contagem atômica fora do limite')
        stack[-1].update({key:value*count for key,value in group.items()})
    if len(stack)!=1 or not stack[0] or max(stack[0].values())>1000000:
        raise ValueError('Fórmula incompleta ou muito grande')
    return dict(sorted(stack[0].items()))


def balance_reaction(reactants,products):
    reactants,products=tuple(reactants),tuple(products)
    if not reactants or not products or len(reactants)+len(products)>16 or len(set(reactants+products))!=len(reactants+products):
        raise ValueError('Reação requer espécies distintas e no máximo 16')
    molecules=[composition(f) for f in reactants+products]
    elements=sorted(set().union(*(set(m) for m in molecules)))
    rows=tuple(tuple(Fraction(m.get(element,0))*(1 if j<len(reactants) else -1) for j,m in enumerate(molecules)) for element in elements)
    reduced,_=Matrix(rows).echelon();pivots={}
    for row in reduced.rows:
        pivot=next((i for i,v in enumerate(row) if v),None)
        if pivot is not None:pivots[pivot]=row
    free=[j for j in range(len(molecules)) if j not in pivots]
    if len(free)!=1:
        raise ValueError('Balanceamento deve ter uma única razão estequiométrica')
    values=[Fraction(0)]*len(molecules);values[free[0]]=1
    for pivot,row in pivots.items():values[pivot]=-row[free[0]]
    denominator=math.lcm(*(v.denominator for v in values));integers=[int(v*denominator) for v in values]
    divisor=reduce(math.gcd,integers)
    coefficients=[v//divisor for v in integers]
    if all(v<0 for v in coefficients):coefficients=[-v for v in coefficients]
    if any(v<=0 for v in coefficients):
        raise ValueError('Não há balanceamento estritamente positivo na orientação dada')
    residuals={element:sum(row[j]*coefficients[j] for j in range(len(molecules))) for element,row in zip(elements,rows)}
    return result('chemistry','neutral_elemental_balance',{'reactants':reactants,'products':products},
                  {'coefficients':coefficients,'element_residuals':residuals},
                  {'coefficients':'stoichiometric_integer','element_residuals':'atoms'},
                  {'all_elements_balanced':all(v==0 for v in residuals.values()),'primitive':reduce(math.gcd,coefficients)==1},
                  'Neutral elemental conservation only; not thermodynamics, kinetics or experimental feasibility.')


def two_species_equilibrium(total_moles,equilibrium_constant):
    n=si(total_moles,MOLE,positive=True);k=si(equilibrium_constant,ONE,positive=True)
    a=n/(1+k);b=n-a
    return result('chemistry','ideal_A_to_B_equilibrium',{'total_moles':total_moles,'equilibrium_constant':equilibrium_constant},
                  {'A':a,'B':b},{'A':'mol','B':'mol'},
                  {'material_balance':a+b==n,'equilibrium_ratio':b/a==k},
                  'Ideal isomerization A <-> B; K supplied externally, no activity corrections or kinetic prediction.')

"""Ideal closed reversible first-order A↔B kinetics with analytic reference."""
import math
from ..contracts import si,result
from ...core.units import SECOND,MOLE,METER
from ...worlds.integrators import integrate_adaptive
CONCENTRATION=MOLE/METER**3


def reversible_first_order(initial_a,initial_b,forward_rate,reverse_rate,duration,*,atol=1e-10,rtol=1e-8):
    a,b=(float(si(v,CONCENTRATION,nonnegative=True)) for v in (initial_a,initial_b))
    kf,kr=(float(si(v,SECOND**-1,positive=True)) for v in (forward_rate,reverse_rate));end=float(si(duration,SECOND,positive=True))
    if end*(kf+kr)>10000:raise ValueError('Horizonte fora do perfil não rígido')
    def derivative(t,y):
        rate=-kf*y[0]+kr*y[1]
        return rate,-rate
    trajectory=integrate_adaptive(derivative,(a,b),0.,end,atol=atol,rtol=rtol)
    total=a+b;equilibrium=total*kr/(kf+kr)
    exact_a=equilibrium+(a-equilibrium)*math.exp(-(kf+kr)*end)
    error=max(abs(trajectory['final'][0]-exact_a),abs(trajectory['final'][1]-(total-exact_a)))
    conservation=max(abs(sum(state)-total) for _,state in trajectory['trajectory'])
    return result('chemistry','ideal_reversible_first_order',dict(initial_a=initial_a,initial_b=initial_b,forward_rate=forward_rate,reverse_rate=reverse_rate,duration=duration,atol=atol,rtol=rtol),
                  {'final':trajectory['final'],'trajectory':trajectory['trajectory'],'reference_error':error,'conservation_residual':conservation},
                  {'concentration':'mol/m^3','time':'s'},
                  {'conserved_total':conservation<=1e-10*max(1,total),'reference_tolerance':error<=20*(atol+rtol*total),
                   'nonnegative_within_numerical_tolerance':all(min(state)>=-10*atol for _,state in trajectory['trajectory'])},
                  'Ideal closed first-order two-species kinetics; finite non-stiff profile; no experimental calibration.')

"""Ideal series RLC sinusoidal steady-state phasors, peak-voltage convention."""
import math
from ..contracts import OHM,si,result
from ...core.units import VOLT,SECOND,AMPERE
from .transient import FARAD
HENRY=VOLT*SECOND/AMPERE


def series_rlc(resistance,inductance,capacitance,voltage_peak,angular_frequency):
    r=si(resistance,OHM,positive=True);l=si(inductance,HENRY,positive=True);c=si(capacitance,FARAD,positive=True)
    v=si(voltage_peak,VOLT,nonnegative=True);omega=si(angular_frequency,SECOND**-1,positive=True)
    reactance=omega*l-1/(omega*c);z=complex(float(r),float(reactance));current=float(v)/z
    power=float(v)**2*float(r)/(2*abs(z)**2)
    return result('circuits','ideal_series_RLC_phasor',dict(resistance=resistance,inductance=inductance,capacitance=capacitance,
                  voltage_peak=voltage_peak,angular_frequency=angular_frequency),
                  {'impedance_real':r,'impedance_imaginary':reactance,'current_real':current.real,'current_imaginary':current.imag,
                   'average_real_power':power,'resonance_angular_frequency':1/math.sqrt(float(l*c))},
                  {'impedance':'ohm','current':'A peak','power':'W','angular_frequency':'rad/s'},
                  {'power_nonnegative':power>=0,'phasor_kvl_residual':abs(z*current-float(v))<=1e-10*max(1,abs(float(v)))},
                  'Ideal linear sinusoidal steady state; peak convention; no transients, parasitics or observed validation.')

"""Nodal analysis over rationals. No AC, nonlinear devices or parasitic effects."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction

from ...core.semantic_ir import rational
from ...math.linear_algebra.matrices import Matrix


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Resistor:
    a: str
    b: str
    ohms: Fraction

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.a or not self.b or self.a == self.b:
            raise ValueError('Resistor requer dois nos distintos')
        resistance = rational(self.ohms)
        if resistance <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Resistencia deve ser positiva')
        object.__setattr__(self, 'ohms', resistance)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DCResult:
    voltages: tuple[tuple[str, Fraction], ...]
    branch_currents: tuple[Fraction, ...]
    kcl_residuals: tuple[tuple[str, Fraction], ...]
    dissipated_power: Fraction
    supplied_power: Fraction
    units: tuple[str, ...] = ('V', 'A', 'ohm', 'W')

    @property
    def verified(self):
        return not any(v for _, v in self.kcl_residuals) and self.dissipated_power == self.supplied_power


def solve_dc(resistors: tuple[Resistor, ...], injections: dict[str, Fraction], *, ground: str = '0') -> DCResult:
    if not 1 <= len(resistors) <= 128:
        raise ValueError('Circuito requer de 1 a 128 resistores')
    nodes = sorted({n for r in resistors for n in (r.a, r.b)})
    if ground not in nodes or len(nodes) > 33 or any(n not in nodes for n in injections):
        raise ValueError('Referencia ou nos invalidos; maximo 32 nos livres')
    currents = {n: rational(injections.get(n, 0)) for n in nodes}
    if ground in injections and sum(currents.values(), Fraction()):
        raise ValueError('Corrente total injetada deve ser zero quando a referencia e explicita')
    currents[ground] = -sum((v for n, v in currents.items() if n != ground), Fraction())
    # Require every node to be connected to the reference before linear solving.
    reached = {ground}
    for _ in nodes:
        for r in resistors:
            if r.a in reached or r.b in reached:
                reached.update((r.a, r.b))
    if reached != set(nodes):
        raise ValueError('Componente flutuante sem referencia')
    free = [n for n in nodes if n != ground]
    index = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(free)}
    data = [[Fraction() for _ in free] for _ in free]
    for r in resistors:
        conductance = 1/r.ohms
        for a, b in ((r.a, r.b), (r.b, r.a)):
            if a != ground:
                data[index[a]][index[a]] += conductance
                if b != ground:
                    data[index[a]][index[b]] -= conductance
    solution = Matrix(tuple(tuple(row) for row in data)).inverse() @ Matrix(tuple((currents[n],) for n in free))
    voltage = {ground: Fraction(), **{n: solution.rows[index[n]][0] for n in free}}
    branch = tuple((voltage[r.a]-voltage[r.b])/r.ohms for r in resistors)
    residual = {n: -currents[n] for n in nodes}
    dissipated = Fraction()
    for r, current in zip(resistors, branch):
        residual[r.a] += current
        residual[r.b] -= current
        dissipated += r.ohms * current**2
    supplied = sum((voltage[n]*currents[n] for n in nodes), Fraction())
    result = DCResult(tuple(sorted(voltage.items())), branch, tuple(sorted(residual.items())), dissipated, supplied)
    if not result.verified:
        raise ArithmeticError('Circuito falhou nas leis de Kirchhoff ou balanco de potencia')
    return result

"""Unit-checked ideal series RC step response with an analytic voltage oracle."""
import math
from ...core.units import AMPERE, SECOND, VOLT, Quantity
from ..contracts import OHM, si, result
from ...worlds.integrators.adaptive import integrate_adaptive

FARAD = AMPERE*SECOND/VOLT


def rc_step(resistance, capacitance, source_voltage, initial_voltage, duration, *, atol=1e-9,
            rtol=1e-6, max_attempts=100000):
    r = float(si(resistance, OHM, positive=True))
    c = float(si(capacitance, FARAD, positive=True))
    source = float(si(source_voltage, VOLT))
    initial = float(si(initial_voltage, VOLT))
    end = float(si(duration, SECOND, positive=True))
    tau = r*c
    if not math.isfinite(tau) or tau <= 0 or end/tau > 10000:
        raise ValueError('Constante RC fora do perfil não rígido')
    trajectory = integrate_adaptive(lambda t,y: ((source-y[0])/tau,), (initial,), 0., end,
                                    atol=atol, rtol=rtol, max_attempts=max_attempts)
    errors = [abs(y[0]-(source+(initial-source)*math.exp(-t/tau)))
              for t,y in trajectory['trajectory']]
    final = trajectory['final'][0]
    current = (source-final)/r
    return result('circuits', 'ideal_series_RC_step',
                  dict(resistance=resistance, capacitance=capacitance, source_voltage=source_voltage,
                       initial_voltage=initial_voltage, duration=duration, atol=atol, rtol=rtol,
                       max_attempts=max_attempts),
                  {'time_constant': tau, 'final_voltage': final, 'final_current': current,
                   'trajectory': trajectory['trajectory'], 'max_reference_error': max(errors),
                   'accepted_steps': trajectory['accepted_steps'], 'rejected_steps': trajectory['rejected_steps']},
                  {'time_constant': 's', 'voltage': 'V', 'current': 'A'},
                  {'local_error_accepted': trajectory['max_accepted_local_error_ratio'] <= 1,
                   'analytic_reference': max(errors) <= 20*(atol+rtol*max(abs(initial), abs(source)))},
                  'Ideal linear RC, constant source, non-stiff finite horizon; no observed validation. '
                  'Local tolerance is not a rigorous global error enclosure.')

"""SI checks and portable result receipts shared by bounded disciplinary models."""
from fractions import Fraction
from ..core.units import Quantity, ONE, METER, SECOND, KILOGRAM, KELVIN, AMPERE, MOLE, NEWTON, JOULE, VOLT
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint

PASCAL=NEWTON/METER**2
WATT=JOULE/SECOND
OHM=VOLT/AMPERE


def si(quantity,unit,*,positive=False,nonnegative=False):
    if not isinstance(quantity,Quantity):
        raise ValueError('Parâmetro requer Quantity com unidade explícita')
    value=quantity.to(unit).value
    if (positive and value<=0) or (nonnegative and value<0) or abs(value)>10**18:
        raise ValueError('Parâmetro físico fora do domínio')
    return value


def result(domain,model,inputs,outputs,units,checks,limitations):
    from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json
    import json
    def clean(value):
        if isinstance(value,Fraction):
            return str(value)
        if isinstance(value,Quantity):
            return {'value':str(value.value),'unit':value.unit.to_data()}
        if isinstance(value,dict):
            return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value,(tuple,list)):
            return [clean(v) for v in value]
        return value
    payload=clean({'schema_version':1,'domain':domain,'model':model,'inputs':inputs,'outputs':outputs,
                   'units':units,'checks':checks,'checks_passed':bool(checks) and all(checks.values()),
                   'limitations':limitations,'experimental_validation':False})
    canonical_json(payload)
    return {**payload,'result_id':fingerprint(payload)}

"""Normalized continuous-time state-space systems up to dimension two."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from ...core.semantic_ir import rational
from ...math.linear_algebra import Matrix
from ...math.equations.ode import integrate
from ..contracts import result


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StateSpace:
    a: tuple[tuple,...]
    b: tuple
    c: tuple
    d: object = 0

    def __post_init__(self):
        a=tuple(tuple(rational(v) for v in row) for row in self.a);b=tuple(rational(v) for v in self.b);c=tuple(rational(v) for v in self.c)
        n=len(a)
        if n not in (1,2) or any(len(row)!=n for row in a) or len(b)!=n or len(c)!=n:
            raise ValueError('Sistema SISO de dimensão 1 ou 2 obrigatório')
        object.__setattr__(self,'a',a);object.__setattr__(self,'b',b);object.__setattr__(self,'c',c);object.__setattr__(self,'d',rational(self.d))

    def analyze(self):
        n=len(self.a);a=Matrix(self.a);trace=sum(self.a[i][i] for i in range(n));det=a.determinant()
        stable=self.a[0][0]<0 if n==1 else trace<0 and det>0
        ab=tuple(sum(self.a[i][j]*self.b[j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
        controllability=Matrix(tuple((self.b[i],ab[i])[:n] for i in range(n)))
        ca=tuple(sum(self.c[i]*self.a[i][j] for i in range(n)) for j in range(n))
        observability=Matrix((self.c,ca)[:n])
        rank=controllability.echelon()[1]; observable=observability.echelon()[1]
        return result('control','normalized_continuous_siso',{'A':self.a,'B':self.b,'C':self.c,'D':self.d},
                      {'asymptotically_stable':stable,'controllability_rank':rank,'observability_rank':observable,'trace':trace,'determinant':det},
                      {'A':'1/s','B':'1/s','C':'1','D':'1','state':'1','input':'1','output':'1'},
                      {'rank_bounds':0<=rank<=n and 0<=observable<=n},
                      'Exact Hurwitz criterion for 1D/2D normalized linear systems; no delays, saturation or experimental validation.')

    def simulate_step(self,*,amplitude=1,duration=1.,steps=100):
        amplitude=rational(amplitude)
        if not math.isfinite(duration) or not 0<duration<=100 or type(steps) is not int or not 2<=steps<=100000:
            raise ValueError('Intervalo ou passos inválidos')
        n=len(self.a)
        def derivative(t,state):
            return tuple(sum(float(self.a[i][j])*state[j] for j in range(n))+float(self.b[i]*amplitude) for i in range(n))
        trajectory=integrate(derivative,(0.,)*n,0.,duration,steps,'rk4')
        outputs=tuple(sum(float(c)*x for c,x in zip(self.c,state))+float(self.d*amplitude) for _,state in trajectory)
        return {'model':'normalized_continuous_siso','method':'rk4','trajectory':trajectory,'outputs':outputs,
                'duration_unit':'s','state_unit':'1','input':str(amplitude),'experimental_validation':False}

"""Hydrostatic columns at constant density and gravity, with SI pressure balance."""

def hydrostatic_pressure(density,gravity,depth,surface_pressure):

    h=si(depth,METER,nonnegative=True);p0=si(surface_pressure,PASCAL,nonnegative=True)

                  {'density':density,'gravity':gravity,'depth':depth,'surface_pressure':surface_pressure},
                  {'pressure':pressure,'gauge_pressure':pressure-p0}, {'pressure':'Pa','gauge_pressure':'Pa'},

"""Exact static pressure across finite constant-density layers."""
from ..contracts import si,result,PASCAL
from ...core.units import METER,KILOGRAM,SECOND


def layered_hydrostatics(thicknesses,densities,gravity,surface_pressure):
    if not 1<=len(thicknesses)<=128 or len(thicknesses)!=len(densities):raise ValueError('Camadas fora do perfil')
    h=[si(v,METER,positive=True) for v in thicknesses];rho=[si(v,KILOGRAM/METER**3,positive=True) for v in densities]
    g=si(gravity,METER/SECOND**2,positive=True);p0=si(surface_pressure,PASCAL,nonnegative=True)
    depths=[0];pressures=[p0]
    for length,density in zip(h,rho):depths.append(depths[-1]+length);pressures.append(pressures[-1]+density*g*length)
    return result('earth','layered_static_hydrostatics',dict(thicknesses=thicknesses,densities=densities,gravity=gravity,surface_pressure=surface_pressure),
                  {'interface_depths':depths,'interface_pressures':pressures},{'depth':'m','pressure':'Pa'},
                  {'pressure_monotone':all(a<b for a,b in zip(pressures,pressures[1:]))},
                  'Static incompressible piecewise-constant density layers; no dynamics, mixing or observed validation.')

"""Small-displacement axial bars and cantilever beams in linear elasticity."""
from ..contracts import si,result,PASCAL,NEWTON,METER,Quantity


def axial_bar(force,length,area,young_modulus):
    f=si(force,NEWTON); l=si(length,METER,positive=True)
    a=si(area,METER**2,positive=True); e=si(young_modulus,PASCAL,positive=True)
    stress=f/a; strain=stress/e; extension=strain*l
    if abs(strain)>1/100:
        raise ValueError('Deformação excede regime linear declarado (1%)')
    return result('engineering','linear_axial_bar',locals_input(force=force,length=length,area=area,young_modulus=young_modulus),
                  {'stress':stress,'strain':strain,'extension':extension},
                  {'stress':'Pa','strain':'1','extension':'m'},
                  {'force_balance':stress*a==f,'hooke_law':e*extension/l==stress},
                  'Uniform bar, small strain, no buckling, plasticity or experimental validation.')


def locals_input(**values):
    return values


def cantilever_tip(force,length,young_modulus,second_moment):
    f=si(force,NEWTON);l=si(length,METER,positive=True)
    e=si(young_modulus,PASCAL,positive=True);i=si(second_moment,METER**4,positive=True)
    deflection=f*l**3/(3*e*i); rotation=f*l*l/(2*e*i)
    if abs(deflection)>l/20 or abs(rotation)>1/10:
        raise ValueError('Viga fora da hipótese de pequenas deflexões')
    return result('engineering','euler_bernoulli_cantilever',
                  {'force':force,'length':length,'young_modulus':young_modulus,'second_moment':second_moment},
                  {'tip_deflection':deflection,'tip_rotation':rotation,'root_moment':f*l},
                  {'tip_deflection':'m','tip_rotation':'rad','root_moment':'N*m'},
                  {'tip_compliance':3*e*i*deflection==f*l**3,'rotation_consistency':2*e*i*rotation==f*l*l},
                  'Slender prismatic linear beam; no shear deformation, buckling or experimental validation.')

"""One-dimensional thermoelastic constitutive model with declared temperature change."""
from ..contracts import si,result,PASCAL,KELVIN,ONE


def thermoelastic(young_modulus,expansion,temperature_change,total_strain):
    e=si(young_modulus,PASCAL,positive=True);alpha=si(expansion,ONE/KELVIN)
    dt=si(temperature_change,KELVIN);strain=si(total_strain,ONE)
    thermal=alpha*dt; elastic=strain-thermal;stress=e*elastic
    if abs(strain)>1/100 or abs(thermal)>1/100:
        raise ValueError('Deformação térmica/total excede hipótese linear')
    return result('materials','linear_thermoelasticity',
                  {'young_modulus':young_modulus,'expansion':expansion,'temperature_change':temperature_change,'total_strain':total_strain},
                  {'stress':stress,'thermal_strain':thermal,'elastic_strain':elastic},
                  {'stress':'Pa','thermal_strain':'1','elastic_strain':'1'},
                  {'strain_decomposition':elastic+thermal==strain,'constitutive_residual':stress-e*(strain-alpha*dt)==0},
                  'Homogeneous small-strain material; no plasticity, damage, phase change or experimental validation.')

"""Exact isotropic 3D small-strain elasticity; no plasticity or measured calibration."""
from ..contracts import si,result,PASCAL
from ...core.units import ONE
from ...core.semantic_ir import rational


def isotropic_elasticity(young_modulus,poisson_ratio,strain):
    e=si(young_modulus,PASCAL,positive=True);nu=si(poisson_ratio,ONE)
    if not -1<nu<rational('1/2') or len(strain)!=3 or any(len(row)!=3 for row in strain):raise ValueError('Poisson ou tensor de deformação inválido')
    eps=tuple(tuple(rational(v) for v in row) for row in strain)
    if any(abs(v)>rational('1/100') for row in eps for v in row) or any(eps[i][j]!=eps[j][i] for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
        raise ValueError('Deformação pequena e simétrica obrigatória')
    mu=e/(2*(1+nu));lam=e*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu));trace=sum(eps[i][i] for i in range(3))
    stress=tuple(tuple(2*mu*eps[i][j]+(lam*trace if i==j else 0) for j in range(3)) for i in range(3))
    energy=sum(stress[i][j]*eps[i][j] for i in range(3) for j in range(3))/2
    return result('materials','isotropic_small_strain_3d',dict(young_modulus=young_modulus,poisson_ratio=poisson_ratio,strain=strain),
                  {'stress':stress,'strain_energy_density':energy,'lame_lambda':lam,'shear_modulus':mu},
                  {'stress':'Pa','strain_energy_density':'J/m^3'},
                  {'symmetric_stress':all(stress[i][j]==stress[j][i] for i in range(3) for j in range(3)), 'nonnegative_energy':energy>=0},
                  'Isotropic linear small strain <= 0.01; no plasticity, anisotropy or experimental calibration.')

"""Versioned data-only algorithm choices committed to an exact evaluation.

A CodeProposal does not contain a patch, module path, callback, bytecode, command,
URL or source text. The name refers to a proposal about a known algorithm, not
permission to execute generated code. Extending ALGORITHMS requires an ordinary
reviewed repository change. Hash commitments are integrity checks, not signatures.
"""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from itertools import islice
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from ..core.semantic_contracts import require_digest, require_fields, require_text
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json, fingerprint
from ..evaluation.frozen import FrozenEvaluation

ALGORITHMS = frozenset({'exact-rational-v1', 'alternate-rational-v1'})
VERSION = 'declarative-algorithm-proposal-v1'


def implementation_digest():
    """Bind trials to the actual trusted implementations and evaluator sources."""
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    names = ('evolution/code_proposals.py', 'evolution/secure_trials.py',
             'evaluation/frozen.py', 'verify/certificate.py',
             'math/linear_algebra/matrices.py', 'math/linear_algebra/solvers.py',
             'agents/tool_registry.py', 'core/semantic_contracts.py',
             'verification/independence.py', 'evaluation/lineage.py',
             'verify/__init__.py', 'core/semantic_ir.py')
    return fingerprint({name: hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                        for name in names})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrialBudget:
    """Whole-trial limits. Task cost is conservatively charged before execution."""
    max_tasks: int = 16
    max_attempts: int = 1
    max_input_bytes: int = 65536
    max_output_bytes: int = 262144
    timeout_seconds: float = 10.0

    def __post_init__(self):
        import math
        limits = ((self.max_tasks, 100), (self.max_attempts, 8),
                  (self.max_input_bytes, 1048576), (self.max_output_bytes, 1048576))
        if any(type(value) is not int or not 1 <= value <= limit for value, limit in limits):
            raise ValueError('Invalid trial budget')
        if (isinstance(self.timeout_seconds, bool)
                or not isinstance(self.timeout_seconds, (int, float))
                or not math.isfinite(self.timeout_seconds)
                or not 0 < self.timeout_seconds <= 60):
            raise ValueError('Invalid trial deadline')

    def to_data(self):
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data):
        require_fields(data, set(cls.__dataclass_fields__))
        return cls(**data)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CodeProposal:
    """One immutable algorithm revision against exactly one frozen protocol."""
    algorithm: str
    protocol_id: str
    implementation_id: str
    owner: str
    rationale: str
    budget: TrialBudget
    parent_id: str | None = None
    generation: int = 0
    schema_version: int = 1

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.algorithm not in ALGORITHMS:
            raise ValueError('Only reviewed built-in algorithm IDs are allowed')
        require_digest(self.protocol_id)
        require_digest(self.implementation_id)
        require_text(self.owner, 'owner', limit=256)
        require_text(self.rationale, 'rationale', limit=4096)
        if not isinstance(self.budget, TrialBudget):
            raise ValueError('Immutable trial budget required')
        if type(self.generation) is not int or not 0 <= self.generation <= 32:
            raise ValueError('Invalid proposal generation')
        if type(self.schema_version) is not int or self.schema_version != 1:
            raise ValueError('Unsupported proposal version')
        if self.parent_id is not None:
            require_digest(self.parent_id)
        if (self.generation == 0) != (self.parent_id is None):
            raise ValueError('Root and child lineage must be explicit')

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, protocol, *, algorithm, owner, rationale, budget=None):
        if not isinstance(protocol, FrozenEvaluation):
            raise ValueError('Frozen exact evaluation required')
        result = cls(algorithm, protocol.protocol_id, implementation_digest(),
                     owner, rationale, budget or TrialBudget())
        result.preflight(protocol)
        return result

    def descendant(self, *, algorithm, rationale, budget=None):
        """A changed budget is part of the new revision and invalidates approval."""
        return CodeProposal(algorithm, self.protocol_id, self.implementation_id,
                            self.owner, rationale, budget or self.budget,
                            self.proposal_id, self.generation+1)

    def to_data(self):
        return asdict(self)

    @property
    def proposal_id(self):
        return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data, *, expected_id):
        require_digest(expected_id)
        require_fields(data, set(cls.__dataclass_fields__))
        payload = dict(data)
        payload['budget'] = TrialBudget.from_data(payload['budget'])
        result = cls(**payload)
        if result.proposal_id != expected_id:
            raise ValueError('Proposal commitment mismatch')
        return result

    def preflight(self, protocol):
        import json
        if not isinstance(protocol, FrozenEvaluation) or protocol.protocol_id != self.protocol_id:
            raise ValueError('Proposal targets a different frozen protocol')
        if self.implementation_id != implementation_digest():
            raise ValueError('Trusted implementation changed; create a newly reviewed proposal')
        data = json.loads(protocol.protocol_json)
        tasks = data['tasks']
        if len(tasks) > self.budget.max_tasks:
            raise ValueError('Frozen cohort exceeds whole-trial task budget')
        if len(canonical_json(data).encode()) > self.budget.max_input_bytes:
            raise ValueError('Frozen protocol exceeds input budget')
        # The built-in trial adapter intentionally supports a small exact domain.
        # FrozenEvaluation supports larger cohorts; that does not expand this worker.
        for task in tasks:
            if task['family'] == 'linear_system' and len(task['rhs']) > 8:
                raise ValueError('Trial linear systems are limited to dimension eight')
            if task['family'] == 'polynomial_integral' and len(task['coefficients']) > 16:
                raise ValueError('Trial integral degree exceeds supported arithmetic budget')
        return self.proposal_id


def validate_lineage(proposals):
    """Validate a bounded ordered revision chain, never resolve external parents."""
    rows = list(islice(proposals, 34))
    if not rows or len(rows) > 33:
        raise ValueError('Expected at most 33 proposal revisions')
    previous = None
    for proposal in rows:
        if not isinstance(proposal, CodeProposal):
            raise ValueError('Typed proposal required')
        if previous is None:
            if proposal.parent_id is not None:
                raise ValueError('Lineage must begin at a root')
        elif (proposal.parent_id != previous.proposal_id
              or proposal.generation != previous.generation+1
              or proposal.protocol_id != previous.protocol_id
              or proposal.owner != previous.owner
              or proposal.implementation_id != previous.implementation_id):
            raise ValueError('Revision chain fork or contract change')
        previous = proposal
    return dict(valid=True, count=len(rows), head=previous.proposal_id)
END FILE: src/nablamath/evolution/code_proposals.py
