"""Polynomial differential forms with exact wedge and exterior derivative."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Mapping

from ..algebra.groebner import Polynomial

IndexSet = tuple[int, ...]


def _partial(polynomial: Polynomial, variable: int) -> Polynomial:
    terms = []
    for monomial, coefficient in polynomial.terms:
        exponent = monomial[variable]
        if exponent:
            reduced = list(monomial)
            reduced[variable] -= 1
            terms.append((tuple(reduced), coefficient * exponent))
    return Polynomial(polynomial.variables, terms)


def _wedge_indices(left: IndexSet, right: IndexSet) -> tuple[int, IndexSet] | None:
    if set(left) & set(right):
        return None
    inversions = sum(1 for first in left for second in right if first > second)
    return (-1 if inversions % 2 else 1), tuple(sorted(left + right))


@dataclass(frozen=True, init=False)
class DifferentialForm:
    variables: tuple[str, ...]
    degree: int
    components: tuple[tuple[IndexSet, Polynomial], ...]

    def __init__(self, variables: tuple[str, ...], degree: int,
                 components: Mapping[IndexSet, Polynomial]) -> None:
        if degree < 0:
            raise ValueError("Grau da forma inválido")
        if degree > len(variables) and components:
            raise ValueError("Somente a forma zero existe acima da dimensão")
        canonical = []
        for indices, coefficient in components.items():
            if tuple(sorted(indices)) != indices or len(indices) != degree or len(set(indices)) != degree:
                raise ValueError("Índices precisam ser estritamente crescentes")
            if any(not 0 <= index < len(variables) for index in indices):
                raise ValueError("Índice de diferencial fora da dimensão")
            if coefficient.variables != variables:
                raise ValueError("Coeficiente usa coordenadas diferentes")
            if not coefficient.is_zero:
                canonical.append((indices, coefficient))
        object.__setattr__(self, "variables", variables)
        object.__setattr__(self, "degree", degree)
        object.__setattr__(self, "components", tuple(sorted(canonical)))

    def wedge(self, other: DifferentialForm) -> DifferentialForm:
        if self.variables != other.variables:
            raise ValueError("Formas usam coordenadas diferentes")
        result: dict[IndexSet, Polynomial] = {}
        for left_indices, left_coefficient in self.components:
            for right_indices, right_coefficient in other.components:
                combined = _wedge_indices(left_indices, right_indices)
                if combined is None:
                    continue
                sign, indices = combined
                result[indices] = result.get(indices, Polynomial.zero(self.variables)) \
                    + sign * left_coefficient * right_coefficient
        return DifferentialForm(self.variables, self.degree + other.degree, result)

    def exterior_derivative(self) -> DifferentialForm:
        if self.degree == len(self.variables):
            return DifferentialForm(self.variables, self.degree + 1, {})
        result: dict[IndexSet, Polynomial] = {}
        for indices, coefficient in self.components:
            for variable in range(len(self.variables)):
                derivative = _partial(coefficient, variable)
                combined = _wedge_indices((variable,), indices)
                if derivative.is_zero or combined is None:
                    continue
                sign, output_indices = combined
                result[output_indices] = result.get(output_indices, Polynomial.zero(self.variables)) \
                    + sign * derivative
        return DifferentialForm(self.variables, self.degree + 1, result)


def scalar_form(polynomial: Polynomial) -> DifferentialForm:
    return DifferentialForm(polynomial.variables, 0, {(): polynomial})


def coordinate_form(variables: tuple[str, ...], index: int) -> DifferentialForm:
    return DifferentialForm(variables, 1, {(index,): Polynomial.constant(variables, 1)})


__all__ = ["DifferentialForm", "coordinate_form", "scalar_form"]

"""Coordinate differential forms over a closed symbolic expression grammar."""
from itertools import combinations
from .._structured import expression, names, sympy, data


def _form(coordinates, components):
    coordinates=names(coordinates,8);sp=sympy();result={}
    if not isinstance(components,dict) or len(components)>256:raise ValueError('Finite form components required')
    for key,value in components.items():
        indices=tuple(int(i) for i in key.split(',')) if key else ()
        if tuple(sorted(set(indices)))!=indices or any(not 0<=i<len(coordinates) for i in indices):raise ValueError('Canonical increasing form indices required')
        result[indices]=expression(value,coordinates)[0]
    if len({len(k) for k in result})>1:raise ValueError('A differential form has one degree')
    return coordinates,result


def _wedge(a,b):
    sp=sympy();result={}
    for left,x in a.items():
        for right,y in b.items():
            if set(left)&set(right):continue
            sign=(-1)**sum(i>j for i in left for j in right);key=tuple(sorted(left+right))
            result[key]=sp.expand(result.get(key,0)+sign*x*y)
    return {k:v for k,v in result.items() if v!=0}


def exterior_derivative(coordinates,components):
    coordinates,form=_form(coordinates,components);sp=sympy();out={}
    for key,value in form.items():
        for i,name in enumerate(coordinates):
            for target,coefficient in _wedge({(i,):sp.diff(value,sp.Symbol(name))},{key:sp.Integer(1)}).items():
                out[target]=sp.expand(out.get(target,0)+coefficient)
    return {','.join(map(str,k)):str(v) for k,v in out.items() if v!=0}


def wedge(coordinates,left,right):
    _,a=_form(coordinates,left);_,b=_form(coordinates,right)
    return {','.join(map(str,k)):str(v) for k,v in _wedge(a,b).items()}


def pullback(source_coordinates,target_coordinates,mapping,components):
    sp=sympy();target_coordinates,form=_form(target_coordinates,components);source_coordinates=names(source_coordinates,8)
    if len(mapping)!=len(target_coordinates):raise ValueError('Map dimension mismatch')
    functions=[expression(v,source_coordinates)[0] for v in mapping]
    substitution=dict(zip(map(sp.Symbol,target_coordinates),functions));result={}
    for key,value in form.items():
        term={():value.subs(substitution,simultaneous=True)}
        for i in key:
            term=_wedge(term,{(j,):sp.diff(functions[i],sp.Symbol(name)) for j,name in enumerate(source_coordinates)})
        for k,v in term.items():result[k]=sp.expand(result.get(k,0)+v)
    return {','.join(map(str,k)):str(v) for k,v in result.items() if v!=0}


def integrate_box(coordinates,components,bounds):
    sp=sympy();coordinates,form=_form(coordinates,components);n=len(coordinates)
    if set(form)-{tuple(range(n))} or len(bounds)!=n:raise ValueError('Top-degree form and one interval per coordinate required')
    value=form.get(tuple(range(n)),sp.Integer(0))
    from ...ops._area_utils import scalar
    for name,interval in zip(coordinates,bounds):
        if len(interval)!=2:raise ValueError('Two interval endpoints required')
        a,b=(sp.Rational(str(scalar(v))) for v in interval)
        if a>=b:raise ValueError('Increasing box intervals required')
        value=sp.integrate(value,(sp.Symbol(name),a,b))
    return {'integral':str(value),'evaluated':not value.has(sp.Integral),'orientation':list(coordinates)}

"""Geometria euclidiana plana exata sobre coordenadas racionais."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Point2:
    x: Fraction
    y: Fraction
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "x", Fraction(self.x)); object.__setattr__(self, "y", Fraction(self.y))


def squared_distance(left: Point2, right: Point2) -> Fraction:
    return (left.x - right.x) ** 2 + (left.y - right.y) ** 2


def orientation(a: Point2, b: Point2, c: Point2) -> int:
    determinant = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x)
    return (determinant > 0) - (determinant < 0)


def polygon_twice_signed_area(points: tuple[Point2, ...]) -> Fraction:
    if len(points) < 3: raise ValueError("polígono requer ao menos três pontos")
    return sum((point.x * points[(index + 1) % len(points)].y - point.y * points[(index + 1) % len(points)].x
                for index, point in enumerate(points)), Fraction())


__all__ = ["Point2", "orientation", "polygon_twice_signed_area", "squared_distance"]

"""Linear bundle cocycles on an explicitly supplied finite chart nerve."""
from itertools import combinations
from .._structured import rational_matrix, sympy, data


def verify_bundle(charts, transitions, triples=()):
    sp=sympy()
    if not isinstance(charts,list) or not 1<=len(charts)<=32 or len(set(charts))!=len(charts) or any(type(v) is not str for v in charts):raise ValueError('Distinct chart labels required')
    matrices={}
    for edge in transitions:
        if set(edge)!={'from','to','matrix'} or edge['from'] not in charts or edge['to'] not in charts:raise ValueError('Invalid chart transition')
        key=(edge['from'],edge['to'])
        if key in matrices:raise ValueError('Duplicate transition')
        m=rational_matrix(edge['matrix'],maximum=16)
        if m.rows!=m.cols or m.det()==0:raise ValueError('Transition must be invertible')
        matrices[key]=m
    if not matrices:raise ValueError('At least one transition required')
    rank=next(iter(matrices.values())).rows
    if any(m.shape!=(rank,rank) for m in matrices.values()):raise ValueError('Bundle ranks differ')
    for (a,b),m in matrices.items():
        if a==b and m!=sp.eye(rank):raise ValueError('Identity chart transition required')
        if (b,a) in matrices and matrices[b,a]*m!=sp.eye(rank):raise ValueError('Inverse transition mismatch')
    for triple in triples:
        if len(triple)!=3 or any(v not in charts for v in triple):raise ValueError('Invalid triple overlap')
        a,b,c=triple
        if any(key not in matrices for key in ((a,b),(b,c),(a,c))):raise ValueError('Missing transition on declared triple')
        if matrices[b,c]*matrices[a,b]!=matrices[a,c]:raise ValueError('Cocycle condition failed')
    return {'rank':rank,'declared_triples_checked':len(triples),'compatible':True,
            'scope':'Constant GL(Q) transitions on supplied overlaps; geometric cover validity is an explicit hypothesis.'}


def compatible_sections(transitions, sections):
    for edge in transitions:
        a,b=edge['from'],edge['to'];m=rational_matrix(edge['matrix'])
        if a not in sections or b not in sections:raise ValueError('A section on every transition endpoint is required')
        left=rational_matrix([[v] for v in sections[a]]);right=rational_matrix([[v] for v in sections[b]])
        if m*left!=right:return False
    return True


def gauge_connection(coordinates,connection,gauge):
    """A' = g^-1 A g + g^-1 dg, with symbolic matrices, chart-local only."""
    from .._structured import expression,names
    sp=sympy();coordinates=names(coordinates,8)
    g=sp.Matrix([[expression(v,coordinates)[0] for v in row] for row in gauge]);n=g.rows
    if not 1<=n<=8 or g.cols!=n or len(connection)!=len(coordinates) or sp.simplify(g.det())==0:raise ValueError('Invalid local gauge/connection')
    inverse=g.inv();output=[]
    for name,raw in zip(coordinates,connection):
        a=sp.Matrix([[expression(v,coordinates)[0] for v in row] for row in raw])
        if a.shape!=(n,n):raise ValueError('Connection rank mismatch')
        output.append((inverse*a*g+inverse*g.diff(sp.Symbol(name))).applyfunc(sp.simplify))
    return {'connection':data(output),'invertible_where':str(g.det())+' != 0'}


def parallel_transport(coordinates,connection,path,initial,duration=1.,steps=100):
    from .._structured import expression,sympy,numeric_array
    from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
    import numpy as np
    sp=sympy();n=len(coordinates)
    if len(connection)!=n or len(path)!=n or type(steps) is not int or not 1<=steps<=10000 or not 0<duration<=10000:raise ValueError('Invalid connection/path data')
    curve=[expression(v,['t'])[0] for v in path];t=sp.Symbol('t');derivatives=[sp.diff(v,t) for v in curve]
    symbols=tuple(map(sp.Symbol,coordinates));rank=len(initial)
    matrices=[sp.Matrix([[expression(v,coordinates)[0] for v in row] for row in raw]) for raw in connection]
    if not 1<=rank<=16 or any(a.shape!=(rank,rank) for a in matrices):raise ValueError('Connection rank differs from transported vector')
    substitution=dict(zip(symbols,curve));operator=sum((d*a.subs(substitution,simultaneous=True) for d,a in zip(derivatives,matrices)),sp.zeros(rank))
    def rhs(time,y):return -np.array(operator.subs(t,time),dtype=float)@y
    solution=solve_ivp(rhs,(0,duration),numeric_array(initial,ndim=1),t_eval=np.linspace(0,duration,steps+1),rtol=1e-9,atol=1e-11)
    if not solution.success or not np.isfinite(solution.y).all():raise ArithmeticError('Parallel transport failed')
    return {'times':solution.t.tolist(),'vectors':solution.y.T.tolist(),'convention':'dV/dt + A_i(x(t))*dx_i/dt*V=0','scope':'Numerical transport in one supplied chart.'}

"""Exact coordinate Riemannian tensors from a metric's two-jet at a point."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction

from ..linear_algebra.matrices import Matrix

Tensor2 = tuple[tuple[Fraction, ...], ...]
Tensor3 = tuple[Tensor2, ...]
Tensor4 = tuple[Tensor3, ...]


def _fraction_tensor(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return tuple(_fraction_tensor(item) for item in value)
    return Fraction(value)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MetricJet:
    metric: Tensor2
    first: Tensor3  # first[k][i][j] = ∂_k g_ij
    second: Tensor4  # second[k][l][i][j] = ∂_k ∂_l g_ij

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        metric = _fraction_tensor(self.metric)
        first = _fraction_tensor(self.first)
        second = _fraction_tensor(self.second)
        size = len(metric)
        if size < 1 or any(len(row) != size for row in metric):
            raise ValueError("Métrica deve ser quadrada")
        if any(metric[i][j] != metric[j][i] for i in range(size) for j in range(size)):
            raise ValueError("Métrica deve ser simétrica")
        if len(first) != size or any(len(layer) != size or any(len(row) != size for row in layer)
                                     for layer in first):
            raise ValueError("Primeiro jet possui shape inválido")
        if len(second) != size or any(len(layer) != size for layer in second):
            raise ValueError("Segundo jet possui shape inválido")
        if any(len(second[k][l]) != size or any(len(row) != size for row in second[k][l])
               for k in range(size) for l in range(size)):
            raise ValueError("Segundo jet possui shape inválido")
        object.__setattr__(self, "metric", metric)
        object.__setattr__(self, "first", first)
        object.__setattr__(self, "second", second)
        Matrix(metric).inverse()  # reject degenerate metrics

    @property
    def dimension(self) -> int:
        return len(self.metric)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RiemannianPoint:
    inverse_metric: Tensor2
    christoffel: Tensor3  # Γ^l_ij
    riemann: Tensor4  # R^l_ijk
    ricci: Tensor2
    scalar_curvature: Fraction


def riemannian_tensors(jet: MetricJet) -> RiemannianPoint:
    n = jet.dimension
    inverse = Matrix(jet.metric).inverse().rows
    gamma = [[[Fraction(0) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for upper in range(n):
        for left in range(n):
            for right in range(n):
                gamma[upper][left][right] = sum(
                    inverse[upper][middle] * (
                        jet.first[left][right][middle] + jet.first[right][left][middle]
                        - jet.first[middle][left][right]
                    ) / 2 for middle in range(n)
                )
    d_inverse = [[[Fraction(0) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for derivative in range(n):
        for left in range(n):
            for right in range(n):
                d_inverse[derivative][left][right] = -sum(
                    inverse[left][a] * jet.first[derivative][a][b] * inverse[b][right]
                    for a in range(n) for b in range(n)
                )
    d_gamma = [[[[Fraction(0) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
                for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for derivative in range(n):
        for upper in range(n):
            for left in range(n):
                for right in range(n):
                    d_gamma[derivative][upper][left][right] = sum(
                        d_inverse[derivative][upper][middle] * (
                            jet.first[left][right][middle] + jet.first[right][left][middle]
                            - jet.first[middle][left][right]
                        ) / 2 + inverse[upper][middle] * (
                            jet.second[derivative][left][right][middle]
                            + jet.second[derivative][right][left][middle]
                            - jet.second[derivative][middle][left][right]
                        ) / 2 for middle in range(n)
                    )
    riemann = [[[[Fraction(0) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
                for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for upper in range(n):
        for vector in range(n):
            for left in range(n):
                for right in range(n):
                    riemann[upper][vector][left][right] = (
                        d_gamma[left][upper][right][vector]
                        - d_gamma[right][upper][left][vector]
                        + sum(gamma[upper][left][middle] * gamma[middle][right][vector]
                              - gamma[upper][right][middle] * gamma[middle][left][vector]
                              for middle in range(n))
                    )
    ricci = [[sum(riemann[upper][left][upper][right] for upper in range(n))
              for right in range(n)] for left in range(n)]
    scalar = sum(inverse[left][right] * ricci[left][right]
                 for left in range(n) for right in range(n))
    return RiemannianPoint(tuple(tuple(row) for row in inverse),
                           _fraction_tensor(gamma), _fraction_tensor(riemann),
                           tuple(tuple(row) for row in ricci), scalar)


__all__ = ["MetricJet", "RiemannianPoint", "riemannian_tensors"]

"""Affine rational polynomial schemes and explicit projective charts.

Ideal computations use a bounded SymPy Groebner backend; no arbitrary CAS text.
Primary decomposition below is deliberately univariate, where factorization is
an actual complete algorithm over Q. No general primary decomposition is implied.
"""
from itertools import combinations
from .._structured import expression,names,sympy,data


def _ideal(equations,variables):
    sp=sympy();variables=names(variables,6)
    if not isinstance(equations,list) or not 1<=len(equations)<=32:raise ValueError('Require 1–32 polynomial generators')
    symbols=tuple(map(sp.Symbol,variables));polynomials=[]
    for raw in equations:
        value,_=expression(raw,variables,functions=False,degree_limit=16)
        p=sp.Poly(value,*symbols,domain=sp.QQ)
        if p.total_degree()>16 or len(p.terms())>256:raise ValueError('Polynomial budget exceeded')
        polynomials.append(p.as_expr())
    return sp,variables,symbols,polynomials


def affine_scheme(equations,variables):
    sp,variables,symbols,polynomials=_ideal(equations,variables)
    gb=sp.groebner(polynomials,*symbols,order='lex',domain=sp.QQ)
    if any(p.as_expr()==1 for p in gb.polys):
        return {'groebner_basis':['1'],'dimension':-1,'empty':True,'zero_dimensional':False}
    supports=[{i for i,power in enumerate(p.monoms()[0]) if power} for p in gb.polys if p.as_expr()!=0]
    height=next(k for k in range(len(symbols)+1) if any(all(set(c)&s for s in supports) for c in combinations(range(len(symbols)),k))) if supports else 0
    return {'groebner_basis':[str(p.as_expr()) for p in gb.polys],'dimension':len(symbols)-height,
            'zero_dimensional':bool(gb.is_zero_dimensional),'empty':False,
            'scope':'Affine scheme defined by the supplied ideal over Q; not automatically reduced.'}


def eliminate(equations,variables,remove):
    sp,variables,symbols,polynomials=_ideal(equations,variables)
    if not set(remove)<=set(variables):raise ValueError('Unknown elimination variable')
    removed=tuple(sp.Symbol(v) for v in remove);remaining=tuple(s for s in symbols if str(s) not in remove)
    gb=sp.groebner(polynomials,*(removed+remaining),order='lex',domain=sp.QQ)
    return {'generators':[str(p.as_expr()) for p in gb.polys if not (p.as_expr().free_symbols&set(removed))],
            'remaining_variables':list(map(str,remaining))}


def saturate(equations,variables,denominator):
    sp,variables,symbols,polynomials=_ideal(equations,variables)
    f,_=expression(denominator,variables,functions=False);sp.Poly(f,*symbols,domain=sp.QQ)
    if f==0:raise ValueError('Cannot localize at zero')
    t=sp.Dummy('localization');gb=sp.groebner(polynomials+[1-t*f],t,*symbols,order='lex',domain=sp.QQ)
    return {'generators':[str(p.as_expr()) for p in gb.polys if t not in p.as_expr().free_symbols],
            'meaning':'I : denominator^infinity; ideal of the closure of the principal-open restriction'}


def univariate_primary(polynomial,variable='x'):
    sp,_,symbols,polys=_ideal([polynomial],[variable]);p=sp.Poly(polys[0],*symbols,domain=sp.QQ)
    if p.is_zero:raise ValueError('Zero ideal requires a separate domain component')
    _,factors=sp.factor_list(p)
    return {'primary_ideals':[[str(f.as_expr()**m)] for f,m in factors],
            'radical_generator':str(sp.prod(f.as_expr() for f,_ in factors)),
            'reduced':all(m==1 for _,m in factors),'coefficient_field':'Q'}


def projective_chart(equations,variables,index):
    sp,variables,symbols,polys=_ideal(equations,variables)
    if type(index) is not int or not 0<=index<len(symbols):raise ValueError('Invalid projective chart')
    for p in polys:
        degrees={sum(m) for m,c in sp.Poly(p,*symbols).terms() if c}
        if len(degrees)>1:raise ValueError('Projective equations must be homogeneous')
    return {'variables':[v for i,v in enumerate(variables) if i!=index],
            'equations':[str(p.subs(symbols[index],1)) for p in polys],
            'chart':variables[index]+' != 0'}


def _quotient_dimension(gb):
    from itertools import product
    leading=[p.monoms()[0] for p in gb.polys if p.as_expr()!=0];n=len(gb.gens)
    if any(not any(m) for m in leading):return 0
    bounds=[]
    for i in range(n):
        powers=[m[i] for m in leading if m[i] and all(v==0 for j,v in enumerate(m) if j!=i)]
        if not powers:raise ValueError('Zero-dimensional ideal required')
        bounds.append(min(powers))
    import math
    if math.prod(bounds)>4096:raise ValueError('Quotient staircase budget exceeded')
    return sum(not any(all(a>=b for a,b in zip(monomial,lead)) for lead in leading) for monomial in product(*(range(v) for v in bounds)))


def zero_dimensional_radical(equations,variables):
    sp,variables,symbols,polys=_ideal(equations,variables);gb=sp.groebner(polys,*symbols,domain=sp.QQ,order='lex')
    if any(p.as_expr()==1 for p in gb.polys):return {'generators':['1'],'quotient_dimension':0}
    dimension=_quotient_dimension(gb)
    if dimension>128:raise ValueError('Radical quotient dimension budget exceeded')
    additions=[]
    for s in symbols:
        order=tuple(v for v in symbols if v!=s)+(s,);elimination=sp.groebner(polys,*order,domain=sp.QQ,order='lex')
        candidates=[sp.Poly(p.as_expr(),s,domain=sp.QQ) for p in elimination.polys if p.as_expr()!=0 and p.as_expr().free_symbols<={s}]
        if not candidates:raise ArithmeticError('Zero-dimensional elimination failed')
        minimal=min(candidates,key=lambda p:p.degree());additions.append(minimal.sqf_part().as_expr())
    radical=sp.groebner(polys+additions,*symbols,domain=sp.QQ,order='lex')
    return {'generators':[str(p.as_expr()) for p in radical.polys],'quotient_dimension':_quotient_dimension(radical),
            'original_quotient_dimension':dimension,'scope':'Exact radical of a zero-dimensional Q ideal via square-free coordinate annihilators.'}


def zero_dimensional_primary(equations,variables):
    sp,variables,symbols,polys=_ideal(equations,variables);radical=zero_dimensional_radical(equations,variables);dimension=radical['quotient_dimension']
    if dimension==0:return {'primary_ideals':[],'empty':True}
    t=sp.Dummy('primitive');chosen=None
    for base in range(1,17):
        linear=sum(base**i*s for i,s in enumerate(symbols));gb=sp.groebner(polys+[t-linear],*symbols,t,order='lex',domain=sp.QQ)
        univariate=[sp.Poly(p.as_expr(),t,domain=sp.QQ) for p in gb.polys if p.as_expr()!=0 and p.as_expr().free_symbols<={t}]
        if not univariate:continue
        minimal=min(univariate,key=lambda p:p.degree())
        if minimal.sqf_part().degree()==dimension:chosen=(linear,minimal);break
    if chosen is None:raise ArithmeticError('Separating linear form search budget exhausted')
    linear,minimal=chosen;_,factors=sp.factor_list(minimal);components=[]
    for factor,multiplicity in factors:
        relation=factor.as_expr().subs(t,linear)**multiplicity
        component=sp.groebner(polys+[relation],*symbols,order='lex',domain=sp.QQ)
        components.append([str(p.as_expr()) for p in component.polys])
    return {'primary_ideals':components,'separating_form':str(linear),'annihilator':str(minimal.as_expr()).replace(str(t),'T'),
            'scope':'Zero-dimensional rational primary decomposition using a separating reduced-algebra primitive element; no positive-dimensional decomposition claim.'}

"""Finite diagrams of rational vector spaces and Cech complexes.

The input cover/intersection labels and restriction maps are explicit hypotheses.
Computing their cohomology does not assert that a geometric cover is acyclic.
"""
from itertools import combinations
from .._structured import rational_matrix,sympy,data
from ..algebra.homological import chain_complex


def _diagram(dimensions,restrictions):
    sp=sympy()
    if not isinstance(dimensions,dict) or not 1<=len(dimensions)<=64 or any(type(k) is not str or type(v) is not int or not 1<=v<=16 for k,v in dimensions.items()):raise ValueError('Invalid stalk dimensions')
    maps={}
    for record in restrictions:
        if set(record)!={'from','to','matrix'}:raise ValueError('Closed restriction record required')
        a,b=record['from'],record['to']
        if a not in dimensions or b not in dimensions or (a,b) in maps:raise ValueError('Invalid restriction endpoints')
        m=rational_matrix(record['matrix'],maximum=16)
        if m.shape!=(dimensions[b],dimensions[a]):raise ValueError('Restriction dimension mismatch')
        maps[a,b]=m
    for (a,b),ab in maps.items():
        if a==b and ab!=sp.eye(dimensions[a]):raise ValueError('Restriction identity fails')
        for (c,d),cd in maps.items():
            if b==c and (a,d) in maps and maps[a,d]!=cd*ab:raise ValueError('Restriction composition fails')
    return maps


def global_sections(dimensions,restrictions):
    sp=sympy();maps=_diagram(dimensions,restrictions);labels=list(dimensions);offset={};n=0
    for label in labels:offset[label]=n;n+=dimensions[label]
    if n>128:raise ValueError('Global section dimension budget exceeded')
    equations=[]
    for (a,b),m in maps.items():
        for i in range(dimensions[b]):
            row=[sp.Integer(0)]*n;row[offset[b]+i]=1
            for j in range(dimensions[a]):row[offset[a]+j]-=m[i,j]
            equations.append(row)
    system=sp.Matrix(equations) if equations else sp.zeros(0,n)
    basis=system.nullspace()
    return {'dimension':len(basis),'basis':data(basis),'coordinate_order':labels,'offsets':offset}


def cech_cohomology(cover_size,intersections,dimensions,restrictions):
    sp=sympy();maps=_diagram(dimensions,restrictions)
    if type(cover_size) is not int or not 1<=cover_size<=6:raise ValueError('Cover size must be 1–6')
    cells=[]
    for degree in range(cover_size):
        cells.append([(c,intersections[','.join(map(str,c))]) for c in combinations(range(cover_size),degree+1) if ','.join(map(str,c)) in intersections])
    if any(label not in dimensions for group in cells for c,label in group):raise ValueError('Missing section space on intersection')
    sizes=[sum(dimensions[label] for _,label in group) for group in cells]
    if sum(sizes)>128:raise ValueError('Cech complex dimension budget exceeded')
    ds=[]
    for k in range(len(cells)-1):
        differential=sp.zeros(sizes[k+1],sizes[k]);out_offset=0
        offsets={};offset=0
        for cell,label in cells[k]:offsets[cell]=offset;offset+=dimensions[label]
        for cell,label in cells[k+1]:
            for removed in range(len(cell)):
                face=cell[:removed]+cell[removed+1:]
                if face not in offsets:raise ValueError('Intersection nerve must be downward closed')
                source=intersections[','.join(map(str,face))]
                restriction=sp.eye(dimensions[label]) if source==label else maps.get((source,label))
                if restriction is None:raise ValueError('Missing Cech restriction')
                i,j=out_offset,offsets[face]
                differential[i:i+dimensions[label],j:j+dimensions[source]]+=(-1)**removed*restriction
            out_offset+=dimensions[label]
        ds.append(differential)
    if any(ds[i+1]*ds[i]!=sp.zeros(ds[i+1].rows,ds[i].cols) for i in range(len(ds)-1)):raise ValueError('Cech differential squared is nonzero')
    ranks=[0]+[d.rank() for d in ds]+[0]
    return {'dimensions':[n-ranks[i]-ranks[i+1] for i,n in enumerate(sizes)],'differentials':data(ds),
            'scope':'Cohomology of the supplied finite Cech diagram; no automatic sheaf cohomology comparison.'}

"""Ordenação topológica e emparelhamento bipartido finitos."""

from collections import deque
from typing import Mapping


def topological_sort(vertices: frozenset[str], edges: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if any(left not in vertices or right not in vertices for left, right in edges): raise ValueError("aresta com vértice ausente")
    indegree = {vertex: 0 for vertex in vertices}; outgoing = {vertex: [] for vertex in vertices}
    for left, right in edges: outgoing[left].append(right); indegree[right] += 1
    ready = sorted(vertex for vertex, degree in indegree.items() if degree == 0); result = []
    while ready:
        vertex = ready.pop(0); result.append(vertex)
        for target in sorted(outgoing[vertex]):
            indegree[target] -= 1
            if indegree[target] == 0: ready.append(target); ready.sort()
    if len(result) != len(vertices): raise ValueError("grafo contém ciclo dirigido")
    return tuple(result)


def maximum_bipartite_matching(left: frozenset[str], right: frozenset[str],
                               edges: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]) -> dict[str, str]:
    if left & right: raise ValueError("partições devem ser disjuntas")
    if any(a not in left or b not in right for a, b in edges): raise ValueError("aresta fora das partições")
    adjacency = {vertex: sorted(b for a, b in edges if a == vertex) for vertex in left}
    matched_right: dict[str, str] = {}
    def augment(vertex: str, visited: set[str]) -> bool:
        for target in adjacency[vertex]:
            if target in visited: continue
            visited.add(target)
            if target not in matched_right or augment(matched_right[target], visited):
                matched_right[target] = vertex; return True
        return False
    for vertex in sorted(left): augment(vertex, set())
    return {source: target for target, source in sorted(matched_right.items(), key=lambda pair: pair[1])}


__all__ = ["maximum_bipartite_matching", "topological_sort"]

"""Algoritmos para grafos dirigidos finitos representados por adjacência."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from collections.abc import Hashable, Iterable, Mapping
from typing import TypeVar


Vertex = TypeVar("Vertex", bound=Hashable)


def normalize(graph: Mapping[Vertex, Iterable[Vertex]]) -> dict[Vertex, tuple[Vertex, ...]]:
    """Valida fechamento dos vértices e remove arestas duplicadas."""
    vertices = set(graph)
    if len(vertices) > 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("grafo excede o limite")
    result: dict[Vertex, tuple[Vertex, ...]] = {}
    for vertex, neighbors in graph.items():
        unique = tuple(dict.fromkeys(neighbors))
        if any(neighbor not in vertices for neighbor in unique):
            raise ValueError("aresta referencia vértice ausente")
        result[vertex] = unique
    return result


def reverse(graph: Mapping[Vertex, Iterable[Vertex]]) -> dict[Vertex, tuple[Vertex, ...]]:
    normalized = normalize(graph)
    result: dict[Vertex, list[Vertex]] = {vertex: [] for vertex in normalized}
    for source, targets in normalized.items():
        for target in targets:
            result[target].append(source)
    return {vertex: tuple(neighbors) for vertex, neighbors in result.items()}


def topological_sort(graph: Mapping[Vertex, Iterable[Vertex]]) -> tuple[Vertex, ...]:
    """Retorna uma ordenação de Kahn ou rejeita ciclos."""
    normalized = normalize(graph)
    indegree = {vertex: 0 for vertex in normalized}
    for targets in normalized.values():
        for target in targets:
            indegree[target] += 1
    queue = deque(vertex for vertex in normalized if indegree[vertex] == 0)
    result = []
    while queue:
        vertex = queue.popleft()
        result.append(vertex)
        for target in normalized[vertex]:
            indegree[target] -= 1
            if indegree[target] == 0:
                queue.append(target)
    if len(result) != len(normalized):
        raise ValueError("grafo contém ciclo dirigido")
    return tuple(result)


def strongly_connected_components(
    graph: Mapping[Vertex, Iterable[Vertex]],
) -> tuple[frozenset[Vertex], ...]:
    """Calcula componentes fortemente conexas pelo algoritmo de Kosaraju."""
    normalized = normalize(graph)
    visited: set[Vertex] = set()
    finish: list[Vertex] = []

    for root in normalized:
        if root in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(root)
        stack: list[tuple[Vertex, int]] = [(root, 0)]
        while stack:
            vertex, index = stack[-1]
            neighbors = normalized[vertex]
            if index < len(neighbors):
                neighbor = neighbors[index]
                stack[-1] = (vertex, index + 1)
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    stack.append((neighbor, 0))
            else:
                finish.append(vertex)
                stack.pop()

    reversed_graph = reverse(normalized)
    visited.clear()
    components = []
    for root in reversed(finish):
        if root in visited:
            continue
        component: set[Vertex] = set()
        stack = [root]
        visited.add(root)
        while stack:
            vertex = stack.pop()
            component.add(vertex)
            for neighbor in reversed_graph[vertex]:
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    stack.append(neighbor)
        components.append(frozenset(component))
    return tuple(components)


def transitive_closure(
    graph: Mapping[Vertex, Iterable[Vertex]],
) -> dict[Vertex, frozenset[Vertex]]:
    """Retorna vértices alcançáveis por caminhos não vazios."""
    normalized = normalize(graph)
    result = {}
    for root in normalized:
        reachable: set[Vertex] = set()
        stack = list(normalized[root])
        while stack:
            vertex = stack.pop()
            if vertex in reachable:
                continue
            reachable.add(vertex)
            stack.extend(normalized[vertex])
        result[root] = frozenset(reachable)
    return result


__all__ = [
    "normalize",
    "reverse",
    "strongly_connected_components",
    "topological_sort",
    "transitive_closure",
]

"""Fluxo máximo exato por Edmonds–Karp em redes racionais."""

from collections import deque
from fractions import Fraction
from typing import Mapping


def maximum_flow(vertices: frozenset[str], capacities: Mapping[tuple[str, str], int | Fraction],
                 source: str, sink: str) -> tuple[Fraction, dict[tuple[str, str], Fraction]]:
    if source == sink or source not in vertices or sink not in vertices: raise ValueError("fonte ou sorvedouro inválido")
    capacity = {(u, v): Fraction(value) for (u, v), value in capacities.items()}
    if any(u not in vertices or v not in vertices or u == v for u, v in capacity): raise ValueError("aresta inválida")
    if any(value < 0 for value in capacity.values()): raise ValueError("capacidade negativa")
    residual = dict(capacity)
    for u, v in tuple(capacity): residual.setdefault((v, u), Fraction())
    flow = {edge: Fraction() for edge in capacity}
    value = Fraction()
    while True:
        parent: dict[str, str | None] = {source: None}; queue = deque([source])
        while queue and sink not in parent:
            u = queue.popleft()
            for v in sorted(vertices):
                if v not in parent and residual.get((u, v), 0) > 0: parent[v] = u; queue.append(v)
        if sink not in parent: break
        path_capacity = None; v = sink
        while parent[v] is not None:
            u = parent[v]; available = residual[u, v]
            path_capacity = available if path_capacity is None else min(path_capacity, available); v = u
        assert path_capacity is not None
        v = sink
        while parent[v] is not None:
            u = parent[v]; residual[u, v] -= path_capacity; residual[v, u] = residual.get((v, u), 0) + path_capacity
            if (u, v) in flow: flow[u, v] += path_capacity
            else: flow[v, u] -= path_capacity
            v = u
        value += path_capacity
    return value, flow


__all__ = ["maximum_flow"]

"""Grafos simples finitos e algoritmos estruturais determinísticos."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from collections import deque


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Graph:
    vertices: tuple[str, ...]
    edges: frozenset[frozenset[str]]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        values = set(self.vertices)
        if len(values) != len(self.vertices): raise ValueError("vértices duplicados")
        for edge in self.edges:
            if len(edge) != 2 or not edge <= values: raise ValueError("aresta inválida")

    def neighbors(self, vertex: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        if vertex not in self.vertices: raise KeyError(vertex)
        return tuple(sorted(next(iter(edge - {vertex})) for edge in self.edges if vertex in edge))

    def shortest_path(self, source: str, target: str) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        if source not in self.vertices or target not in self.vertices: raise KeyError("vértice ausente")
        queue = deque([source]); parent = {source: None}
        while queue:
            current = queue.popleft()
            if current == target:
                path = []
                while current is not None: path.append(current); current = parent[current]
                return tuple(reversed(path))
            for neighbor in self.neighbors(current):
                if neighbor not in parent: parent[neighbor] = current; queue.append(neighbor)
        return None

    def components(self) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...]:
        remaining = set(self.vertices); result = []
        while remaining:
            start = min(remaining); component = set(); queue = [start]
            while queue:
                current = queue.pop()
                if current in component: continue
                component.add(current); queue.extend(self.neighbors(current))
            remaining -= component; result.append(tuple(sorted(component)))
        return tuple(result)


__all__ = ["Graph"]

"""Grafos dirigidos ponderados com pesos racionais não negativos."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from heapq import heappop, heappush
from typing import Mapping


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WeightedDigraph:
    vertices: frozenset[str]
    weights: Mapping[tuple[str, str], Fraction]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        normalized = {(source, target): Fraction(weight) for (source, target), weight in self.weights.items()}
        if not self.vertices: raise ValueError("grafo vazio")
        if any(source not in self.vertices or target not in self.vertices for source, target in normalized): raise ValueError("aresta com vértice ausente")
        if any(weight < 0 for weight in normalized.values()): raise ValueError("Dijkstra exige pesos não negativos")
        object.__setattr__(self, "weights", normalized)

    def shortest_distances(self, source: str) -> dict[str, Fraction | None]:
        if source not in self.vertices: raise KeyError(source)
        distances = {source: Fraction()}; queue = [(Fraction(), source)]
        adjacency: dict[str, list[tuple[str, Fraction]]] = {vertex: [] for vertex in self.vertices}
        for (left, right), weight in self.weights.items(): adjacency[left].append((right, weight))
        while queue:
            distance, vertex = heappop(queue)
            if distance != distances.get(vertex): continue
            for target, weight in sorted(adjacency[vertex]):
                candidate = distance + weight
                if target not in distances or candidate < distances[target]:
                    distances[target] = candidate; heappush(queue, (candidate, target))
        return {vertex: distances.get(vertex) for vertex in sorted(self.vertices)}


__all__ = ["WeightedDigraph"]

"""Códigos binários finitos e desigualdade de Kraft exata."""

from fractions import Fraction
from typing import Mapping, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")


def is_prefix_free(code: Mapping[T, str]) -> bool:
    words = tuple(code.values())
    if not words or len(set(words)) != len(words) or any(not word or set(word) - {"0", "1"} for word in words):
        raise ValueError("palavras-código binárias, únicas e não vazias são obrigatórias")
    return all(not right.startswith(left) for left in words for right in words if left != right)


def kraft_sum(code: Mapping[T, str]) -> Fraction:
    is_prefix_free(code)  # também valida o formato; Kraft vale mesmo sem prefix-free
    return sum((Fraction(1, 2 ** len(word)) for word in code.values()), Fraction())


def encode(symbols: tuple[T, ...], code: Mapping[T, str]) -> str:
    if not is_prefix_free(code): raise ValueError("código precisa ser livre de prefixo")
    try: return "".join(code[symbol] for symbol in symbols)
    except KeyError as exc: raise ValueError("símbolo sem palavra-código") from exc


def decode(bits: str, code: Mapping[T, str]) -> tuple[T, ...]:
    if not is_prefix_free(code) or set(bits) - {"0", "1"}: raise ValueError("código ou bits inválidos")
    reverse = {word: symbol for symbol, word in code.items()}; buffer = ""; output = []
    for bit in bits:
        buffer += bit
        if buffer in reverse: output.append(reverse[buffer]); buffer = ""
    if buffer: raise ValueError("sequência termina em palavra incompleta")
    return tuple(output)


__all__ = ["decode", "encode", "is_prefix_free", "kraft_sum"]

"""Quantidades de informação para distribuições finitas."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Hashable, TypeVar


Event = TypeVar("Event", bound=Hashable)


def _distribution(values: Mapping[Event, float], name: str) -> dict[Event, float]:
    if not values:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} vazia")
    converted = {event: float(probability) for event, probability in values.items()}
    if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0 for value in converted.values()):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} contém probabilidade inválida")
    if not math.isclose(sum(converted.values()), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} não soma um")
    return converted


def entropy(distribution: Mapping[Event, float], base: float = 2.0) -> float:
    """Calcula a entropia de Shannon, ignorando termos de probabilidade zero."""
    values = _distribution(distribution, "distribuição")
    if not math.isfinite(base) or base <= 0 or base == 1:
        raise ValueError("base logarítmica inválida")
    return -sum(value * math.log(value, base) for value in values.values() if value)


def cross_entropy(
    distribution: Mapping[Event, float],
    reference: Mapping[Event, float],
    base: float = 2.0,
) -> float:
    """Calcula H(P,Q), retornando infinito quando Q zera suporte de P."""
    left = _distribution(distribution, "distribuição")
    right = _distribution(reference, "referência")
    if set(left) != set(right):
        raise ValueError("suportes incompatíveis")
    if not math.isfinite(base) or base <= 0 or base == 1:
        raise ValueError("base logarítmica inválida")
    if any(left[event] > 0 and right[event] == 0 for event in left):
        return math.inf
    return -sum(left[event] * math.log(right[event], base) for event in left if left[event])


def relative_entropy(
    distribution: Mapping[Event, float],
    reference: Mapping[Event, float],
    base: float = 2.0,
) -> float:
    """Calcula a divergência de Kullback-Leibler D(P||Q)."""
    cross = cross_entropy(distribution, reference, base)
    if math.isinf(cross):
        return cross
    return cross - entropy(distribution, base)


def joint_entropy(
    distribution: Mapping[tuple[Event, Event], float], base: float = 2.0
) -> float:
    return entropy(distribution, base)


def mutual_information(
    distribution: Mapping[tuple[Event, Event], float], base: float = 2.0
) -> float:
    """Calcula I(X;Y) a partir de uma distribuição conjunta finita."""
    joint = _distribution(distribution, "distribuição conjunta")
    left: dict[Event, float] = {}
    right: dict[Event, float] = {}
    for (first, second), probability in joint.items():
        left[first] = left.get(first, 0.0) + probability
        right[second] = right.get(second, 0.0) + probability
    total = 0.0
    for (first, second), probability in joint.items():
        if probability:
            total += probability * math.log(probability / (left[first] * right[second]), base)
    return total


__all__ = [
    "cross_entropy",
    "entropy",
    "joint_entropy",
    "mutual_information",
    "relative_entropy",
]

"""Version 1: rational pivoted LU with independently checkable identities."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from .matrices import Matrix, identity
CONTRACT_VERSION = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LUDecomposition:
    permutation: Matrix
    lower: Matrix
    upper: Matrix

    def verify(self, original: Matrix) -> bool:
        """Check PA=LU and triangular/unit-diagonal structure exactly."""
        n, m = original.shape
        if n != m or any(a.shape != (n, n) for a in
                         (self.permutation, self.lower, self.upper)):
            return False
        p, l, u = self.permutation.rows, self.lower.rows, self.upper.rows
        return (all(sum(row) == 1 and all(v in (0, 1) for v in row) for row in p)
                and all(sum(p[i][j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n))
                and all(l[i][i] == 1 for i in range(n))
                and all(l[i][j] == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
                and all(u[i][j] == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(i))
                and self.permutation @ original == self.lower @ self.upper)


def pivoted_lu(matrix: Matrix) -> LUDecomposition:
    """Return PA=LU over rationals, including singular square matrices (n<=128)."""
    n, m = matrix.shape
    if n != m or n > 128:
        raise ValueError("requires a square matrix of order at most 128")
    u = [list(row) for row in matrix.rows]
    l = [list(row) for row in identity(n).rows]
    p = [list(row) for row in identity(n).rows]
    for k in range(n):
        pivot = next((i for i in range(k, n) if u[i][k]), None)
        if pivot is None:
            continue
        if pivot != k:
            u[k], u[pivot] = u[pivot], u[k]
            p[k], p[pivot] = p[pivot], p[k]
            for j in range(k):
                l[k][j], l[pivot][j] = l[pivot][j], l[k][j]
        for i in range(k + 1, n):
            l[i][k] = u[i][k] / u[k][k]
            for j in range(k, n):
                u[i][j] -= l[i][k] * u[k][j]
    return LUDecomposition(*(Matrix(tuple(tuple(row) for row in a)) for a in (p, l, u)))

"""Bounded exact rational spectral analysis with independently checked identities.

Rational eigenspaces are computed only for caller-supplied rational eigenvalues.
Irrational and complex spectral decompositions are not inferred. Minimal and
characteristic polynomials apply to every square rational matrix in the budget.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction

from .matrices import Matrix,identity
from .solvers import characteristic_polynomial
from ..polynomials.univariate import Polynomial
from ...core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from ...core.semantic_contracts import canonical_payload


def _matrix(matrix):
    if not isinstance(matrix,Matrix) or matrix.shape[0]!=matrix.shape[1] or matrix.shape[0]>8:
        raise ValueError('Spectral analysis requires square rational matrix dimension <=8')
    if any(max(abs(v.numerator).bit_length(),v.denominator.bit_length())>512 for row in matrix.rows for v in row):
        raise ValueError('Matrix input coefficients exceed 512-bit budget')
    return matrix


def _bounded(matrix):
    if any(max(abs(v.numerator).bit_length(),v.denominator.bit_length())>16384 for row in matrix.rows for v in row):
        raise ValueError('Spectral arithmetic exceeded bit budget')
    return matrix


def _add(left,right):
    if left.shape!=right.shape:
        raise ValueError('Matrix shapes differ')
    return _bounded(Matrix(tuple(tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(lrow,rrow)) for lrow,rrow in zip(left.rows,right.rows))))


def _scale(matrix,value):
    return _bounded(Matrix(tuple(tuple(value*v for v in row) for row in matrix.rows)))


def evaluate_matrix_polynomial(polynomial,matrix):
    """Horner evaluation with exact arithmetic; coefficients are scalar matrices."""
    _matrix(matrix)
    if not isinstance(polynomial,Polynomial) or polynomial.degree>16:
        raise ValueError('Matrix polynomial degree budget exceeded')
    size=matrix.shape[0]
    unit=identity(size)
    current=_scale(unit,0)
    for coefficient in reversed(polynomial.coefficients):
        current=_add(_bounded(current@matrix),_scale(unit,coefficient))
    return current


def _rref(rows):
    data=[list(row) for row in rows]
    if not data or not data[0]:
        raise ValueError('Nonempty rational matrix required')
    pivot_row=0
    pivots=[]
    for column in range(len(data[0])):
        candidate=next((r for r in range(pivot_row,len(data)) if data[r][column]),None)
        if candidate is None:
            continue
        data[pivot_row],data[candidate]=data[candidate],data[pivot_row]
        scale=data[pivot_row][column]
        data[pivot_row]=[v/scale for v in data[pivot_row]]
        for row in range(len(data)):
            if row!=pivot_row and data[row][column]:
                multiple=data[row][column]
                data[row]=[v-multiple*p for v,p in zip(data[row],data[pivot_row])]
        if any(max(abs(v.numerator).bit_length(),v.denominator.bit_length())>16384 for row in data for v in row):
            raise ValueError('Elimination exceeded arithmetic bit budget')
        pivots.append(column)
        pivot_row+=1
        if pivot_row==len(data):
            break
    return tuple(tuple(row) for row in data),tuple(pivots)


def nullspace(matrix):
    """Canonical rational nullspace basis; empty tuple for the zero kernel."""
    if not isinstance(matrix,Matrix) or max(matrix.shape)>64:
        raise ValueError('Nullspace matrix dimensions must be <=64')
    _bounded(matrix)
    reduced,pivots=_rref(matrix.rows)
    free=[column for column in range(matrix.shape[1]) if column not in pivots]
    basis=[]
    for column in free:
        vector=[Fraction()]*matrix.shape[1]
        vector[column]=Fraction(1)
        for row,pivot in enumerate(pivots):
            vector[pivot]=-reduced[row][column]
        basis.append(tuple(vector))
    if any(any(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(row,vector)) for row in matrix.rows) for vector in basis):
        raise ArithmeticError('Nullspace exact replay failed')
    return tuple(basis)


def _flatten(matrix):
    return tuple(v for row in matrix.rows for v in row)


def minimal_polynomial(matrix):
    """First exact linear dependence of I,A,...,A**n (monic and minimal)."""
    _matrix(matrix)
    powers=[identity(matrix.shape[0])]
    for degree in range(1,matrix.shape[0]+1):
        powers.append(_bounded(powers[-1]@matrix))
        columns=tuple(_flatten(power) for power in powers)
        rows=tuple(tuple(column[index] for column in columns) for index in range(len(columns[0])))
        kernel=nullspace(Matrix(rows))
        if kernel:
            vector=kernel[0]
            if not vector[-1]:
                raise ArithmeticError('Earlier power dependence was missed')
            result=Polynomial(tuple(value/vector[-1] for value in vector))
            if any(v for row in evaluate_matrix_polynomial(result,matrix).rows for v in row):
                raise ArithmeticError('Minimal polynomial annihilation failed')
            return result
    raise ArithmeticError('Cayley-Hamilton dependence not found')


def _matrix_data(matrix):
    return [[str(v) for v in row] for row in matrix.rows]


def _poly_data(polynomial):
    return [str(v) for v in polynomial.coefficients]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SpectralCertificate:
    matrix: Matrix
    characteristic: Polynomial
    minimal: Polynomial

    def to_data(self):
        payload={'schema_version':1,'matrix':_matrix_data(self.matrix),
                 'characteristic':_poly_data(self.characteristic),'minimal':_poly_data(self.minimal),
                 'formal_proof':False,'scope':'Exact rational matrix identities with independent algorithmic replay'}
        return {**payload,'certificate_id':fingerprint(payload)}


def spectral_certificate(matrix):
    _matrix(matrix)
    result=SpectralCertificate(matrix,Polynomial(characteristic_polynomial(matrix)),minimal_polynomial(matrix))
    if not verify_spectral_certificate(result.to_data()):
        raise ArithmeticError('Spectral certificate replay failed')
    return result


def _decode_rational(text):
    if not isinstance(text,str) or len(text)>6000:
        raise ValueError('Invalid rational encoding')
    result=Fraction(text)
    if str(result)!=text or max(abs(result.numerator).bit_length(),result.denominator.bit_length())>16384:
        raise ValueError('Noncanonical or oversized rational')
    return result


def _decode_polynomial(data):
    if not isinstance(data,list) or not 1<=len(data)<=9:
        raise ValueError('Invalid spectral polynomial')
    values=tuple(_decode_rational(v) for v in data)
    result=Polynomial(values)
    if result.coefficients!=values:
        raise ValueError('Noncanonical spectral polynomial')
    return result


def verify_spectral_certificate(data):
    """Verify characteristic coefficients using n+1 determinant evaluations.

    This checker does not call the Faddeev-LeVerrier producer. The degree-n monic
    polynomial is uniquely determined by n+1 exact evaluations. Minimality is
    checked by independence of I,...,A**(d-1), plus annihilation at degree d.
    """
    try:
        canonical_payload(data)
        if type(data) is not dict or set(data)!={'schema_version','matrix','characteristic','minimal','formal_proof','scope','certificate_id'}:
            return False
        if type(data['schema_version']) is not int or data['schema_version']!=1 or data['formal_proof'] is not False:
            return False
        if data['scope']!='Exact rational matrix identities with independent algorithmic replay':
            return False
        if data['certificate_id']!=fingerprint({k:v for k,v in data.items() if k!='certificate_id'}):
            return False
        rows=data['matrix']
        if not isinstance(rows,list) or not 1<=len(rows)<=8 or any(not isinstance(row,list) or len(row)!=len(rows) for row in rows):
            return False
        matrix=_matrix(Matrix(tuple(tuple(_decode_rational(v) for v in row) for row in rows)))
        characteristic=_decode_polynomial(data['characteristic'])
        minimal=_decode_polynomial(data['minimal'])
        n=matrix.shape[0]
        if characteristic.degree!=n or characteristic.leading!=1 or not 1<=minimal.degree<=n or minimal.leading!=1:
            return False
        unit=identity(n)
        for point in range(n+1):
            shifted=_add(_scale(unit,point),_scale(matrix,-1))
            if characteristic(point)!=shifted.determinant():
                return False
        if any(v for row in evaluate_matrix_polynomial(characteristic,matrix).rows for v in row):
            return False
        if any(v for row in evaluate_matrix_polynomial(minimal,matrix).rows for v in row):
            return False
        powers=[unit]
        for _ in range(1,minimal.degree):
            powers.append(_bounded(powers[-1]@matrix))
        flattened=tuple(_flatten(power) for power in powers)
        power_rows=tuple(tuple(column[index] for column in flattened) for index in range(n*n))
        if nullspace(Matrix(power_rows)):
            return False
        _,remainder=characteristic.divmod(minimal)
        return remainder.is_zero
    except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,AttributeError,ArithmeticError,RecursionError):
        return False


def _eigenvalue(value):
    if isinstance(value,bool) or not isinstance(value,(int,Fraction)):
        raise ValueError('Exact rational eigenvalue required')
    value=Fraction(value)
    if max(abs(value.numerator).bit_length(),value.denominator.bit_length())>512:
        raise ValueError('Eigenvalue bit budget exceeded')
    return value


def generalized_eigenspace(matrix,eigenvalue,*,order=1):
    """Canonical basis of ker((A-lambda I)**order), order<=matrix dimension."""
    _matrix(matrix)
    eigenvalue=_eigenvalue(eigenvalue)
    if type(order) is not int or not 1<=order<=matrix.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Generalized eigenspace order must be in [1,n]')
    shifted=_add(matrix,_scale(identity(matrix.shape[0]),-eigenvalue))
    power=identity(matrix.shape[0])
    for _ in range(order):
        power=_bounded(power@shifted)
    return nullspace(power)


def eigenvalue_multiplicity(matrix,eigenvalue):
    _matrix(matrix)
    eigenvalue=_eigenvalue(eigenvalue)
    polynomial=Polynomial(characteristic_polynomial(matrix))
    factor=Polynomial((-eigenvalue,1))
    multiplicity=0
    while polynomial.degree>0:
        quotient,remainder=polynomial.divmod(factor)
        if not remainder.is_zero:
            break
        polynomial=quotient
        multiplicity+=1
    return multiplicity


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RationalDiagonalization:
    basis: Matrix
    diagonal: Matrix
    inverse_basis: Matrix

    def verify(self,matrix):
        try:
            _matrix(matrix)
            n=matrix.shape[0]
            if any(m.shape!=(n,n) for m in (self.basis,self.diagonal,self.inverse_basis)):
                return False
            if any(self.diagonal.rows[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i!=j):
                return False
            return (self.basis@self.inverse_basis==identity(n)
                    and self.inverse_basis@self.basis==identity(n)
                    and matrix@self.basis==self.basis@self.diagonal)
        except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,ArithmeticError):
            return False


def rational_diagonalization(matrix,eigenvalues):
    """Construct an exact diagonalization from a complete supplied rational spectrum.

    Defective matrices and incomplete/nonrational spectra are explicitly rejected.
    The returned basis is deterministic for a given matrix and value set.
    """
    _matrix(matrix)
    if not isinstance(eigenvalues,(list,tuple)) or not 1<=len(eigenvalues)<=matrix.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Finite rational spectrum required')
    values=sorted(set(_eigenvalue(value) for value in eigenvalues))
    basis=[]
    diagonal=[]
    for value in values:
        vectors=generalized_eigenspace(matrix,value)
        if not vectors:
            raise ValueError('Supplied value is not an eigenvalue')
        basis.extend(vectors)
        diagonal.extend([value]*len(vectors))
    n=matrix.shape[0]
    if len(basis)!=n:
        raise ValueError('Spectrum is incomplete or matrix is not rationally diagonalizable')
    basis_matrix=Matrix(tuple(tuple(column[row] for column in basis) for row in range(n)))
    diagonal_matrix=Matrix(tuple(tuple(diagonal[i] if i==j else Fraction() for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)))
    result=RationalDiagonalization(basis_matrix,diagonal_matrix,basis_matrix.inverse())
    if not result.verify(matrix):
        raise ArithmeticError('Diagonalization identity replay failed')
    return result


__all__=['SpectralCertificate','spectral_certificate','verify_spectral_certificate',
         'evaluate_matrix_polynomial','minimal_polynomial','nullspace','generalized_eigenspace',

def algebraic_spectral(matrix):
    from .._structured import rational_matrix,sympy,data
    sp=sympy();a=rational_matrix(matrix,maximum=8)
    if a.rows!=a.cols:raise ValueError('Square exact matrix required')
    p=a.charpoly().as_poly();roots=p.all_roots(radicals=False);groups=[]
    for value in dict.fromkeys(roots):
        from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
        field=sp.QQ if value.is_Rational else sp.QQ.algebraic_field(value)
        scalar=field.from_sympy(value)
        shifted=DomainMatrix([[field.from_sympy(a[i,j])-(scalar if i==j else field.zero) for j in range(a.cols)] for i in range(a.rows)],a.shape,field)
        null=shifted.nullspace();rows=null.to_Matrix();basis=[rows.row(i).T for i in range(rows.rows)]
        groups.append({'eigenvalue':str(value),'algebraic_multiplicity':roots.count(value),'eigenvectors':data(basis),
                       'residuals_zero':bool(shifted.matmul(null.transpose()).is_zero_matrix)})
    real,complex_=p.intervals(all=True,eps=sp.Rational(1,10**12))
    return {'characteristic_polynomial':str(p.as_expr()),'eigenspaces':groups,
            'real_root_isolations':data(real),'complex_root_isolations':data(complex_),
            'diagonalizable_over_algebraic_closure':sum(len(g['eigenvectors']) for g in groups)==a.rows,
            'scope':'Exact algebraic roots and checked eigenvectors over Qbar, bounded dense rational matrices.'}

"""Exact invariant projectors and additive semisimple/nilpotent decomposition.

All identities are rational matrix identities with explicit witnesses. No root
finding, floating-point eigensolver, or assumption of rational eigenvalues is
needed. Supplied coprime factors need not be irreducible; consequently projectors
are called invariant projectors, not necessarily primary spectral projectors.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction

from .matrices import Matrix,identity
from .exact_spectral import (
    _matrix,_bounded,_add,_scale,_matrix_data,_decode_rational,
    evaluate_matrix_polynomial,minimal_polynomial,
)
from ..polynomials.univariate import Polynomial
from ..polynomials.exact_algebra import (
    polynomial_crt,polynomial_power,QuotientElement,extended_polynomial_gcd,
)
from ..polynomials.real_roots import square_free_decomposition
from ...core.semantic_contracts import canonical_payload
from ...core.semantic_ir import fingerprint

_ONE=Polynomial((1,))
_ZERO=Polynomial((0,))


def _is_zero(matrix):
    return not any(v for row in matrix.rows for v in row)


def _matrix_power(matrix,exponent):
    result=identity(matrix.shape[0])
    base=matrix
    while exponent:
        if exponent&1:
            result=_bounded(result@base)
        exponent >>= 1
        if exponent:
            base=_bounded(base@base)
    return result


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InvariantProjector:
    factor: Polynomial
    polynomial: Polynomial
    matrix: Matrix
    dimension: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InvariantDecomposition:
    matrix: Matrix
    minimal: Polynomial
    projectors: tuple[InvariantProjector,...]

    def verify(self):
        try:
            _matrix(self.matrix)
            if self.minimal!=minimal_polynomial(self.matrix):
                return False
            if not 1<=len(self.projectors)<=self.matrix.shape[0]:
                return False
            product=_ONE
            total=_scale(identity(self.matrix.shape[0]),0)
            for i,projector in enumerate(self.projectors):
                if (not isinstance(projector.factor,Polynomial) or projector.factor.degree<1
                        or projector.factor.leading!=1 or projector.matrix.shape!=self.matrix.shape):
                    return False
                product=product*projector.factor
                if projector.matrix!=evaluate_matrix_polynomial(projector.polynomial,self.matrix):
                    return False
                if projector.matrix@projector.matrix!=projector.matrix:
                    return False
                if self.matrix@projector.matrix!=projector.matrix@self.matrix:
                    return False
                if not _is_zero(evaluate_matrix_polynomial(projector.factor,self.matrix)@projector.matrix):
                    return False
                # Idempotent trace equals image dimension over Q.
                trace=sum(projector.matrix.rows[j][j] for j in range(self.matrix.shape[0]))
                if type(projector.dimension) is not int or trace!=projector.dimension or not 1<=trace<=self.matrix.shape[0]:
                    return False
                for other in self.projectors[i+1:]:
                    if not _is_zero(projector.matrix@other.matrix) or not _is_zero(other.matrix@projector.matrix):
                        return False
                    if extended_polynomial_gcd(projector.factor,other.factor).gcd!=_ONE:
                        return False
                total=_add(total,projector.matrix)
            return product==self.minimal and total==identity(self.matrix.shape[0])
        except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,ArithmeticError):
            return False

    def split_vector(self,vector):
        """Split a rational vector into components in mutually invariant images."""
        if not self.verify():
            raise ValueError('Invalid invariant decomposition')
        if not isinstance(vector,(tuple,list)) or len(vector)!=self.matrix.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError('Vector must match matrix dimension')
        if any(isinstance(v,bool) or not isinstance(v,(int,Fraction)) for v in vector):
            raise ValueError('Vector coefficients must be exact rationals')
        vector=Matrix(tuple((Fraction(value),) for value in vector))
        _bounded(vector)
        return tuple(tuple(row[0] for row in (projector.matrix@vector).rows) for projector in self.projectors)


def invariant_decomposition(matrix,factors=None):
    """Use polynomial CRT to construct commuting orthogonal invariant projectors.

    By default square-free multiplicity groups of the minimal polynomial provide
    pairwise-coprime factors. Explicit factors must multiply exactly to minimal(A).
    """
    _matrix(matrix)
    minimal=minimal_polynomial(matrix)
    if factors is None:
        factors=tuple(polynomial_power(factor,multiplicity)
                      for factor,multiplicity in square_free_decomposition(minimal)[1])
    if not isinstance(factors,(tuple,list)) or not 1<=len(factors)<=matrix.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Finite nonempty coprime factors required')
    product=_ONE
    for factor in factors:
        if not isinstance(factor,Polynomial) or factor.degree<1 or factor.leading!=1:
            raise ValueError('Positive-degree monic factors required')
        product=product*factor
    if product!=minimal:
        raise ValueError('Factors must multiply to the exact minimal polynomial')
    projectors=[]
    for index,factor in enumerate(factors):
        residues=tuple(_ONE if j==index else _ZERO for j in range(len(factors)))
        polynomial,modulus=polynomial_crt(residues,factors)
        if modulus!=minimal:
            raise ArithmeticError('Projector modulus mismatch')
        projection=evaluate_matrix_polynomial(polynomial,matrix)
        trace=sum(projection.rows[i][i] for i in range(matrix.shape[0]))
        if trace.denominator!=1:
            raise ArithmeticError('Nonintegral projector rank')
        projectors.append(InvariantProjector(factor,polynomial,projection,trace.numerator))
    result=InvariantDecomposition(matrix,minimal,tuple(projectors))
    if not result.verify():
        raise ArithmeticError('Invariant projector replay failed')
    return result


def _quotient_evaluate(polynomial,value):
    result=value._coerce(0)
    for coefficient in reversed(polynomial.coefficients):
        result=result*value+coefficient
    return result


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AdditiveDecomposition:
    matrix: Matrix
    semisimple: Matrix
    nilpotent: Matrix
    semisimple_polynomial: Polynomial
    nilpotency_index: int

    def verify(self):
        """Verify rational identities and square-free minimal polynomial of S.

        Over characteristic zero a matrix with square-free minimal polynomial is
        semisimple over the algebraic closure. It need not diagonalize over Q.
        """
        try:
            _matrix(self.matrix)
            if self.semisimple.shape!=self.matrix.shape or self.nilpotent.shape!=self.matrix.shape:
                return False
            if _add(self.semisimple,self.nilpotent)!=self.matrix:
                return False
            if self.semisimple@self.nilpotent!=self.nilpotent@self.semisimple:
                return False
            if evaluate_matrix_polynomial(self.semisimple_polynomial,self.matrix)!=self.semisimple:
                return False
            minimal=minimal_polynomial(self.semisimple)
            if extended_polynomial_gcd(minimal,minimal.derivative()).gcd!=_ONE:
                return False
            if type(self.nilpotency_index) is not int or not 1<=self.nilpotency_index<=self.matrix.shape[0]:
                return False
            if not _is_zero(_matrix_power(self.nilpotent,self.nilpotency_index)):
                return False
            if self.nilpotency_index>1 and _is_zero(_matrix_power(self.nilpotent,self.nilpotency_index-1)):
                return False
            return True
        except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,ArithmeticError):
            return False

    def to_data(self):
        body={'schema_version':1,'matrix':_matrix_data(self.matrix),
              'semisimple':_matrix_data(self.semisimple),'nilpotent':_matrix_data(self.nilpotent),
              'semisimple_polynomial':[str(v) for v in self.semisimple_polynomial.coefficients],
              'nilpotency_index':self.nilpotency_index,'formal_proof':False,
              'scope':'Exact rational additive decomposition; semisimple over algebraic closure; algorithmic replay only'}
        return {**body,'certificate_id':fingerprint(body)}


def additive_decomposition(matrix):
    """Jordan-Chevalley additive decomposition by Newton lifting in Q[x]/minimal.

    For square-free q, Newton iteration replaces x by x-q(x)/q'(x). The error
    doubles its multiplicity order, so at most n bounded iterations suffice.
    """
    _matrix(matrix)
    minimal=minimal_polynomial(matrix)
    square_free=_ONE
    for factor,_ in square_free_decomposition(minimal)[1]:
        square_free=square_free*factor
    current=QuotientElement.generator(minimal)
    for _ in range(matrix.shape[0]+1):
        error=_quotient_evaluate(square_free,current)
        if error.representative.is_zero:
            break
        derivative=_quotient_evaluate(square_free.derivative(),current)
        current=current-error/derivative
    else:
        raise ArithmeticError('Semisimple Newton lifting did not converge within dimension bound')
    semisimple=evaluate_matrix_polynomial(current.representative,matrix)
    nilpotent=_add(matrix,_scale(semisimple,-1))
    power=identity(matrix.shape[0])
    for index in range(1,matrix.shape[0]+1):
        power=_bounded(power@nilpotent)
        if _is_zero(power):
            break
    else:
        raise ArithmeticError('Nilpotent component does not vanish')
    result=AdditiveDecomposition(matrix,semisimple,nilpotent,current.representative,index)
    if not result.verify():
        raise ArithmeticError('Additive decomposition replay failed')
    return result


def verify_additive_decomposition(data):
    try:
        canonical_payload(data)
        if type(data) is not dict or set(data)!={'schema_version','matrix','semisimple','nilpotent','semisimple_polynomial','nilpotency_index','formal_proof','scope','certificate_id'}:
            return False
        if type(data['schema_version']) is not int or data['schema_version']!=1 or data['formal_proof'] is not False:
            return False
        if data['scope']!='Exact rational additive decomposition; semisimple over algebraic closure; algorithmic replay only':
            return False
        if data['certificate_id']!=fingerprint({k:v for k,v in data.items() if k!='certificate_id'}):
            return False
        matrices=[]
        for field in ('matrix','semisimple','nilpotent'):
            rows=data[field]
            if not isinstance(rows,list) or not 1<=len(rows)<=8 or any(not isinstance(row,list) or len(row)!=len(rows) for row in rows):
                return False
            matrices.append(Matrix(tuple(tuple(_decode_rational(v) for v in row) for row in rows)))
        coefficients=data['semisimple_polynomial']
        if not isinstance(coefficients,list) or not 1<=len(coefficients)<=8:
            return False
        values=tuple(_decode_rational(v) for v in coefficients)
        polynomial=Polynomial(values)
        if polynomial.coefficients!=values:
            return False
        return AdditiveDecomposition(*matrices,polynomial,data['nilpotency_index']).verify()
    except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,AttributeError,ArithmeticError,RecursionError):
        return False


__all__=['InvariantProjector','InvariantDecomposition','invariant_decomposition',
         'AdditiveDecomposition','additive_decomposition','verify_additive_decomposition']

"""Matrizes densas exatas sobre os racionais."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from typing import Iterable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Matrix:
    rows: tuple[tuple[Fraction, ...], ...]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        converted = tuple(tuple(Fraction(value) for value in row) for row in self.rows)
        if not converted or not converted[0] or any(len(row) != len(converted[0]) for row in converted):
            raise ValueError("matriz deve ser retangular e não vazia")
        object.__setattr__(self, "rows", converted)

    @property
    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]: return len(self.rows), len(self.rows[0])

    def transpose(self) -> "Matrix": return Matrix(tuple(zip(*self.rows)))

    def __matmul__(self, other: "Matrix") -> "Matrix":
        if self.shape[1] != other.shape[0]: raise ValueError("dimensões incompatíveis")
        columns = other.transpose().rows
        return Matrix(tuple(tuple(sum((a * b for a, b in zip(row, column, strict=True)), Fraction())
                                  for column in columns) for row in self.rows))

    def echelon(self) -> tuple["Matrix", int]:
        data = [list(row) for row in self.rows]; row = 0; rank = 0
        for column in range(self.shape[1]):
            pivot = next((candidate for candidate in range(row, self.shape[0]) if data[candidate][column]), None)
            if pivot is None: continue
            data[row], data[pivot] = data[pivot], data[row]
            scale = data[row][column]; data[row] = [value / scale for value in data[row]]
            for candidate in range(self.shape[0]):
                if candidate != row and data[candidate][column]:
                    factor = data[candidate][column]
                    data[candidate] = [value - factor * base for value, base in zip(data[candidate], data[row], strict=True)]
            row += 1; rank += 1
            if row == self.shape[0]: break
        return Matrix(tuple(tuple(values) for values in data)), rank

    def determinant(self) -> Fraction:
        if self.shape[0] != self.shape[1]: raise ValueError("determinante requer matriz quadrada")
        data = [list(row) for row in self.rows]; result = Fraction(1)
        for column in range(self.shape[0]):
            pivot = next((row for row in range(column, self.shape[0]) if data[row][column]), None)
            if pivot is None: return Fraction()
            if pivot != column: data[column], data[pivot] = data[pivot], data[column]; result = -result
            value = data[column][column]; result *= value
            for row in range(column + 1, self.shape[0]):
                factor = data[row][column] / value
                for index in range(column, self.shape[1]): data[row][index] -= factor * data[column][index]
        return result

    def inverse(self) -> "Matrix":
        if self.shape[0] != self.shape[1]: raise ValueError("inversa requer matriz quadrada")
        size = self.shape[0]
        data = [list(row) + list(identity(size).rows[index]) for index, row in enumerate(self.rows)]
        for column in range(size):
            pivot = next((row for row in range(column, size) if data[row][column]), None)
            if pivot is None: raise ValueError("matriz singular")
            data[column], data[pivot] = data[pivot], data[column]
            scale = data[column][column]; data[column] = [value / scale for value in data[column]]
            for row in range(size):
                if row != column and data[row][column]:
                    factor = data[row][column]
                    data[row] = [value - factor * base for value, base in zip(data[row], data[column], strict=True)]
        return Matrix(tuple(tuple(row[size:]) for row in data))


def identity(size: int) -> Matrix:
    if not 1 <= size <= 10_000: raise ValueError("dimensão inválida")
    return Matrix(tuple(tuple(Fraction(index == column) for column in range(size)) for index in range(size)))


__all__ = ["Matrix", "identity"]
