"""Contract 1: first-order conservative shallow water on a flat Cartesian bed.

Rusanov shared-face fluxes, explicit Euler, bounded wet states, and periodic,
reflecting-wall or zero-gradient outflow boundaries. This is a bounded numerical
model, not a wetting/drying, topography, dispersive-wave or turbulence solver.
Positivity violations reject/subdivide a step; depths are never silently clipped.
Units must be consistent: h and coordinates in metres, time in seconds, g in m/s².
No experimental validation or rigorous accumulated error enclosure is claimed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from itertools import islice
import math
from typing import Callable, Iterable, Mapping

CONTRACT_VERSION = 1
MAX_CELLS = 4096
MAX_STEPS = 10000


def finite(value, label):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a finite real number")
    return float(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaterState:
    """Conserved depth and two depth-integrated momenta."""
    depth: float
    momentum_x: float = 0
    momentum_y: float = 0

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('depth', 'momentum_x', 'momentum_y'):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, finite(getattr(self, name), name))
        if not 1e-12 <= self.depth <= 1e9:
            raise ValueError("wet depth must lie in [1e-12, 1e9]")
        if max(abs(self.velocity_x), abs(self.velocity_y)) > 1e8:
            raise ValueError("velocity exceeds bounded model")

    @property
    def velocity_x(self):
        return self.momentum_x/self.depth

    @property
    def velocity_y(self):
        return self.momentum_y/self.depth

    @property
    def vector(self):
        return self.depth, self.momentum_x, self.momentum_y

    @classmethod
    def primitive(cls, depth, velocity_x=0, velocity_y=0):
        h = finite(depth, 'depth')
        return cls(h, h*finite(velocity_x, 'velocity x'), h*finite(velocity_y, 'velocity y'))

    def energy(self, gravity=9.81):
        g = finite(gravity, 'gravity')
        if g <= 0:
            raise ValueError("gravity must be positive")
        return (self.momentum_x**2+self.momentum_y**2)/(2*self.depth) + .5*g*self.depth**2

    def to_data(self):
        return dict(depth=self.depth, momentum_x=self.momentum_x, momentum_y=self.momentum_y)

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data):
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {'depth', 'momentum_x', 'momentum_y'}:
            raise ValueError("invalid water state schema")
        return cls(**data)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaterGrid:
    nx: int
    ny: int
    length_x: float = 1
    length_y: float = 1
    boundary_x: str = 'periodic'
    boundary_y: str = 'periodic'
    gravity: float = 9.81
    minimum_depth: float = 1e-10

    def __post_init__(self):
        if (type(self.nx) is not int or type(self.ny) is not int
                or min(self.nx, self.ny) < 2 or self.nx*self.ny > MAX_CELLS):
            raise ValueError("grid requires >=2 cells per axis and <=4096 total")
        for name in ('length_x', 'length_y', 'gravity', 'minimum_depth'):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, finite(getattr(self, name), name))
        if not all(1e-9 <= v <= 1e9 for v in (self.length_x, self.length_y, self.gravity)):
            raise ValueError("positive bounded lengths and gravity required")
        if not 1e-12 <= self.minimum_depth <= 1:
            raise ValueError("minimum wet depth outside model range")
        if any(b not in ('periodic', 'wall', 'outflow') for b in (self.boundary_x, self.boundary_y)):
            raise ValueError("unsupported boundary type")

    @property
    def dx(self):
        return self.length_x/self.nx

    @property
    def dy(self):
        return self.length_y/self.ny

    @property
    def area(self):
        return self.dx*self.dy

    def center(self, i, j):
        if type(i) is not int or type(j) is not int or not 0 <= i < self.nx or not 0 <= j < self.ny:
            raise ValueError("invalid cell index")
        return (i+.5)*self.dx, (j+.5)*self.dy

    def to_data(self):
        return dict(version=CONTRACT_VERSION, nx=self.nx, ny=self.ny,
                    length_x=self.length_x, length_y=self.length_y,
                    boundary_x=self.boundary_x, boundary_y=self.boundary_y,
                    gravity=self.gravity, minimum_depth=self.minimum_depth)

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data):
        keys = {'version', 'nx', 'ny', 'length_x', 'length_y', 'boundary_x', 'boundary_y', 'gravity', 'minimum_depth'}
        if (not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != keys
                or type(data['version']) is not int or data['version'] != CONTRACT_VERSION):
            raise ValueError("invalid water grid schema")
        return cls(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != 'version'})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaterField:
    grid: WaterGrid
    rows: tuple[tuple[WaterState, ...], ...]

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not isinstance(self.grid, WaterGrid):
            raise ValueError("WaterGrid required")
        rows = tuple(tuple(islice(row, self.grid.nx+1)) for row in islice(self.rows, self.grid.ny+1))
        if len(rows) != self.grid.ny or any(len(row) != self.grid.nx for row in rows):
            raise ValueError("water field dimensions do not match grid")
        if any(not isinstance(state, WaterState) or state.depth < self.grid.minimum_depth
               for row in rows for state in row):
            raise ValueError("water field requires bounded wet states")
        object.__setattr__(self, 'rows', rows)

    @classmethod
    def sample(cls, grid, profile):
        return cls(grid, tuple(tuple(profile(*grid.center(i, j)) for i in range(grid.nx))
                               for j in range(grid.ny)))

    def integrals(self):
        return tuple(math.fsum(s.vector[k] for row in self.rows for s in row)*self.grid.area for k in range(3))

    def total_energy(self):
        return math.fsum(s.energy(self.grid.gravity) for row in self.rows for s in row)*self.grid.area

    @property
    def depth_range(self):
        depths = [s.depth for row in self.rows for s in row]
        return min(depths), max(depths)

    @property
    def maximum_froude(self):
        return max(math.hypot(s.velocity_x, s.velocity_y)/math.sqrt(self.grid.gravity*s.depth)
                   for row in self.rows for s in row)

    def to_data(self):
        return dict(version=CONTRACT_VERSION, grid=self.grid.to_data(),
                    rows=[[s.to_data() for s in row] for row in self.rows])

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data):
        if (not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {'version', 'grid', 'rows'}
                or type(data['version']) is not int or data['version'] != CONTRACT_VERSION):
            raise ValueError("invalid water field schema")
        grid = WaterGrid.from_data(data['grid'])
        if not isinstance(data['rows'], list) or len(data['rows']) != grid.ny:
            raise ValueError("invalid water field rows")
        if any(not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) != grid.nx for row in data['rows']):
            raise ValueError("invalid water field columns")
        return cls(grid, tuple(tuple(WaterState.from_data(s) for s in row) for row in data['rows']))


def physical_flux(state, axis, gravity=9.81):
    if not isinstance(state, WaterState) or axis not in ('x', 'y'):
        raise ValueError("state and axis x/y required")
    g = finite(gravity, 'gravity')
    if g <= 0:
        raise ValueError("gravity must be positive")
    h, hu, hv = state.vector
    pressure = .5*g*h*h
    if axis == 'x':
        return hu, hu*hu/h+pressure, hu*hv/h
    return hv, hu*hv/h, hv*hv/h+pressure


def rusanov_flux(left, right, axis, gravity=9.81):
    """Shared numerical face flux, oriented in the positive coordinate axis."""
    fl, fr = physical_flux(left, axis, gravity), physical_flux(right, axis, gravity)
    velocities = (left.velocity_x, right.velocity_x) if axis == 'x' else (left.velocity_y, right.velocity_y)
    speed = max(abs(velocities[0])+math.sqrt(gravity*left.depth),
                abs(velocities[1])+math.sqrt(gravity*right.depth))
    flux = tuple(.5*(a+b)-.5*speed*(ur-ul)
                 for a, b, ul, ur in zip(fl, fr, left.vector, right.vector, strict=True))
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in flux):
        raise ArithmeticError("nonfinite numerical flux")
    return flux


def reflected(state, axis):
    if axis == 'x':
        return WaterState(state.depth, -state.momentum_x, state.momentum_y)
    if axis == 'y':
        return WaterState(state.depth, state.momentum_x, -state.momentum_y)
    raise ValueError("axis must be x or y")


def stable_timestep(field, cfl=.4):
    """Global conservative bound using both directional wave speeds."""
    cfl = finite(cfl, 'CFL')
    if not 0 < cfl <= .45:
        raise ValueError("CFL must lie in (0,.45]")
    grid = field.grid
    maximum_x = max(abs(s.velocity_x)+math.sqrt(grid.gravity*s.depth) for row in field.rows for s in row)
    maximum_y = max(abs(s.velocity_y)+math.sqrt(grid.gravity*s.depth) for row in field.rows for s in row)
    dt = cfl/(maximum_x/grid.dx+maximum_y/grid.dy)
    if not math.isfinite(dt) or dt <= 0:
        raise ArithmeticError("time step not representable")
    return dt


def face_fluxes(field):
    """Return x faces [ny][nx+1], y faces [ny+1][nx].

    Periodic end faces share exactly the same tuple, ensuring cancellation.
    Wall ghosts reflect normal momentum. Outflow ghosts copy edge states.
    """
    grid, rows = field.grid, field.rows
    xfaces = []
    for j in range(grid.ny):
        row = rows[j]
        interior = [rusanov_flux(row[i-1], row[i], 'x', grid.gravity) for i in range(1, grid.nx)]
        if grid.boundary_x == 'periodic':
            low = high = rusanov_flux(row[-1], row[0], 'x', grid.gravity)
        else:
            low_ghost = reflected(row[0], 'x') if grid.boundary_x == 'wall' else row[0]
            high_ghost = reflected(row[-1], 'x') if grid.boundary_x == 'wall' else row[-1]
            low = rusanov_flux(low_ghost, row[0], 'x', grid.gravity)
            high = rusanov_flux(row[-1], high_ghost, 'x', grid.gravity)
        xfaces.append((low, *interior, high))
    yfaces = []
    for j in range(grid.ny+1):
        line = []
        for i in range(grid.nx):
            if 0 < j < grid.ny:
                bottom, top = rows[j-1][i], rows[j][i]
            elif grid.boundary_y == 'periodic':
                bottom, top = rows[-1][i], rows[0][i]
            elif j == 0:
                top = rows[0][i]
                bottom = reflected(top, 'y') if grid.boundary_y == 'wall' else top
            else:
                bottom = rows[-1][i]
                top = reflected(bottom, 'y') if grid.boundary_y == 'wall' else bottom
            line.append(rusanov_flux(bottom, top, 'y', grid.gravity))
        yfaces.append(tuple(line))
    if grid.boundary_y == 'periodic':
        yfaces[-1] = yfaces[0]
    return tuple(xfaces), tuple(yfaces)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaterStep:
    field: WaterField
    dt: float
    boundary_change: tuple[float, float, float]
    conservation_residual: tuple[float, float, float]


def advance_water(field, dt, *, enforce_cfl=True):
    """One Euler step and the signed outward boundary-flux balance.

    Failure is atomic: the immutable input field remains unchanged. For each
    conserved component, new_total-old_total equals boundary_change up to roundoff.
    """
    if not isinstance(field, WaterField) or type(enforce_cfl) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("typed field and explicit CFL policy required")
    dt = finite(dt, 'time step')
    if dt <= 0:
        raise ValueError("time step must be positive")
    if enforce_cfl and dt > stable_timestep(field, .45)*(1+1e-12):
        raise ValueError("time step exceeds model CFL bound")
    grid = field.grid
    fx, fy = face_fluxes(field)
    new_rows = []
    for j in range(grid.ny):
        new_row = []
        for i in range(grid.nx):
            old = field.rows[j][i]
            values = tuple(old.vector[k]-dt/grid.dx*(fx[j][i+1][k]-fx[j][i][k])
                           -dt/grid.dy*(fy[j+1][i][k]-fy[j][i][k]) for k in range(3))
            if values[0] < grid.minimum_depth:
                raise ArithmeticError("step violates minimum wet depth; reduce time step")
            try:
                new_row.append(WaterState(*values))
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ArithmeticError("step left bounded wet-state model") from exc
        new_rows.append(tuple(new_row))
    updated = WaterField(grid, tuple(new_rows))
    boundary = tuple(-dt*(grid.dy*math.fsum(fx[j][-1][k]-fx[j][0][k] for j in range(grid.ny))
                         +grid.dx*math.fsum(fy[-1][i][k]-fy[0][i][k] for i in range(grid.nx))) for k in range(3))
    old_total, new_total = field.integrals(), updated.integrals()
    residual = tuple(new_total[k]-old_total[k]-boundary[k] for k in range(3))
    return WaterStep(updated, dt, boundary, residual)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WaterRun:
    initial: WaterField
    final: WaterField
    start: float
    end: float
    steps: int
    rejected_steps: int
    boundary_change: tuple[float, float, float]
    conservation_residual: tuple[float, float, float]
    energy_change: float
    minimum_depth_seen: float
    snapshots: tuple[tuple[float, WaterField], ...]

    def to_data(self):
        return dict(version=CONTRACT_VERSION, method='flat-bed-2d-rusanov-euler',
                    initial=self.initial.to_data(), final=self.final.to_data(),
                    start=self.start, end=self.end, steps=self.steps, rejected_steps=self.rejected_steps,
                    boundary_change=list(self.boundary_change), conservation_residual=list(self.conservation_residual),
                    energy_change=self.energy_change, minimum_depth_seen=self.minimum_depth_seen,
                    snapshots=[dict(time=t, field=f.to_data()) for t, f in self.snapshots],
                    experimental_validation=False, global_error_certified=False)


def simulate_water(initial, end, *, start=0, cfl=.4, max_steps=MAX_STEPS,
                   max_retries=12, snapshot_stride=0):
    """Integrate a wet-state field, with rejection and bounded retained outputs.

    Reaching a resource limit raises an error instead of returning a successful
    run with an unfulfilled requested end time. snapshot_stride=0 stores no
    intermediate fields. Retained snapshot cells are capped at one million.
    """
    if not isinstance(initial, WaterField):
        raise ValueError("WaterField required")
    start, end = finite(start, 'start time'), finite(end, 'end time')
    if end <= start or not math.isfinite(end-start):
        raise ValueError("finite ordered time interval required")
    if type(max_steps) is not int or not 1 <= max_steps <= MAX_STEPS:
        raise ValueError("invalid step budget")
    if type(max_retries) is not int or not 0 <= max_retries <= 30:
        raise ValueError("invalid positivity retry budget")
    if type(snapshot_stride) is not int or not 0 <= snapshot_stride <= max_steps:
        raise ValueError("invalid snapshot stride")
    field, t, rejected, steps = initial, start, 0, 0
    ledger = [0., 0., 0.]
    snapshots = []
    minimum = initial.depth_range[0]
    while t < end:
        if steps >= max_steps:
            raise ArithmeticError("water integration step budget exhausted")
        dt = min(stable_timestep(field, cfl), end-t)
        for retry in range(max_retries+1):
            if t+dt <= t:
                raise ArithmeticError("water time step cannot advance floating time")
            try:
                result = advance_water(field, dt)
                break
            except ArithmeticError:
                if retry == max_retries:
                    raise
                rejected += 1
                dt /= 2
        t = end if dt == end-t else t+dt
        steps += 1
        field = result.field
        minimum = min(minimum, field.depth_range[0])
        ledger = [a+b for a, b in zip(ledger, result.boundary_change, strict=True)]
        if snapshot_stride and (steps % snapshot_stride == 0 or t == end):
            if (len(snapshots)+1)*initial.grid.nx*initial.grid.ny > 1000000:
                raise ArithmeticError("snapshot retention budget exhausted")
            snapshots.append((t, field))
    before, after = initial.integrals(), field.integrals()
    residual = tuple(after[k]-before[k]-ledger[k] for k in range(3))
    return WaterRun(initial, field, start, end, steps, rejected, tuple(ledger), residual,
                    field.total_energy()-initial.total_energy(), minimum, tuple(snapshots))


def field_error(field, reference):
    """Cell-center L1/L2/Linf diagnostics against an independent reference.

    These are discrete diagnostics; they do not include cell-average quadrature
    uncertainty or assert a continuous norm enclosure.
    """
    totals = [[], [], []]
    squares = [[], [], []]
    maximum = [0., 0., 0.]
    for j, row in enumerate(field.rows):
        for i, value in enumerate(row):
            target = reference(*field.grid.center(i, j))
            if not isinstance(target, WaterState):
                raise ValueError("reference must return WaterState")
            for k in range(3):
                error = abs(value.vector[k]-target.vector[k])
                totals[k].append(error)
                squares[k].append(error*error)
                maximum[k] = max(maximum[k], error)
    area = field.grid.length_x*field.grid.length_y
    return dict(l1=tuple(math.fsum(v)*field.grid.area/area for v in totals),
                l2=tuple(math.sqrt(math.fsum(v)*field.grid.area/area) for v in squares),
                linf=tuple(maximum), continuous_norm_certified=False)


def replay_water_steps(initial, timesteps, *, start=0, expected=None):
    """Reexecute a bounded accepted-step schedule, with all CFL/positivity checks.

    This is a deterministic numerical replay, not evidence of experimental
    validation. Rejected proposals are not represented in an accepted schedule.
    """
    if not isinstance(initial, WaterField):
        raise ValueError("initial WaterField required")
    schedule = tuple(islice(timesteps, MAX_STEPS+1))
    if not schedule or len(schedule) > MAX_STEPS:
        raise ValueError("bounded nonempty water replay schedule required")
    field, time = initial, finite(start, 'start time')
    changes = [[], [], []]
    for value in schedule:
        dt = finite(value, 'replay timestep')
        if dt <= 0 or time+dt <= time:
            raise ValueError("water replay cannot advance time")
        result = advance_water(field, dt)
        field = result.field
        for k in range(3):
            changes[k].append(result.boundary_change[k])
        time += dt
    if expected is not None and (not isinstance(expected, WaterField) or expected != field):
        raise ValueError("water replay differs from expected state")
    ledger = tuple(math.fsum(values) for values in changes)
    old, new = initial.integrals(), field.integrals()
    return dict(final=field, end=time, steps=len(schedule), boundary_change=ledger,
                conservation_residual=tuple(new[k]-old[k]-ledger[k] for k in range(3)),
                physical_validation=False)


def water_cfl_numbers(field, dt):
    """Directional maximum Courant numbers, based on local gravity-wave speeds."""
    if not isinstance(field, WaterField):
        raise ValueError("WaterField required")
    dt = finite(dt, 'diagnostic timestep')
    if dt <= 0:
        raise ValueError("positive diagnostic timestep required")
    grid = field.grid
    x = max((abs(s.velocity_x)+math.sqrt(grid.gravity*s.depth))*dt/grid.dx
            for row in field.rows for s in row)
    y = max((abs(s.velocity_y)+math.sqrt(grid.gravity*s.depth))*dt/grid.dy
            for row in field.rows for s in row)
    return dict(x=x, y=y, sum=x+y, positivity_cfl_limit=.45)

"""Bounded algebraic mixing-length closure and source-declared local calibration.

This module is a one-dimensional shear closure. It is not DNS, LES, a RANS
transport-equation solver or a universal turbulence predictor. Calibration only
fits supplied shear measurements; authenticity and independence are unverified.
All dimensional arguments use SI units and all uncertainties here are absent:
fit residuals must not be interpreted as confidence intervals.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from typing import Sequence

CONTRACT_VERSION = 1


def _number(value: float, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (float, int)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f'{name} must be finite')
    return float(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MixingLengthModel:
    """nu_t=min(nu_cap, ell**2*abs(du/dy)), ell=kappa*y*damping.

    The optional van Driest damping is 1-exp(-y_plus/A_plus). A positive cap is
    a declared numerical/model bound and is reported whenever it is active.
    Setting wall_units=None disables damping; it does not infer friction speed.
    """

    kappa: float = 0.41
    damping_a_plus: float = 26.0
    max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s: float = 100.0
    max_wall_distance_m: float = 1000.0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ('kappa', 'damping_a_plus', 'max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s', 'max_wall_distance_m'):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _number(getattr(self, name), name))
        if not 0.1 <= self.kappa <= 1.0:
            raise ValueError('kappa must be in [0.1,1]')
        if not 1 <= self.damping_a_plus <= 1000:
            raise ValueError('damping A+ must be in [1,1000]')
        if not 1e-12 <= self.max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s <= 1e12:
            raise ValueError('eddy viscosity cap outside [1e-12,1e12]')
        if not 1e-12 <= self.max_wall_distance_m <= 1e6:
            raise ValueError('wall-distance bound outside [1e-12,1e6]')

    def evaluate(
        self,
        wall_distance_m: float,
        velocity_gradient_per_s: float,
        *,
        wall_units: float | None = None,
    ) -> MixingLengthResult:
        y = _number(wall_distance_m, 'wall distance')
        gradient = _number(velocity_gradient_per_s, 'velocity gradient')
        if not 0 <= y <= self.max_wall_distance_m or abs(gradient) > 1e12:
            raise ValueError('wall distance or gradient outside model bounds')
        damping = 1.0
        if wall_units is not None:
            y_plus = _number(wall_units, 'wall units')
            if not 0 <= y_plus <= 1e12:
                raise ValueError('wall units outside [0,1e12]')
            damping = -math.expm1(-y_plus / self.damping_a_plus)
        length = self.kappa * y * damping
        uncapped = length**2 * abs(gradient)
        return MixingLengthResult(
            length,
            min(uncapped, self.max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s),
            uncapped > self.max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s,
            gradient,
        )

    def to_data(self) -> dict:
        from dataclasses import asdict
        return {
            'schema_version': CONTRACT_VERSION,
            **asdict(self),
            'model': 'bounded_algebraic_mixing_length',
            'empirical_generalization_established': False,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MixingLengthResult:
    mixing_length_m: float
    eddy_viscosity_m2_s: float
    cap_active: bool
    velocity_gradient_per_s: float

    def shear_stress_pa(self, density_kg_m3: float, molecular_viscosity_m2_s: float) -> float:
        """Total modeled shear rho*(nu+nu_t)*du/dy; sign follows gradient."""
        density = _number(density_kg_m3, 'density')
        molecular = _number(molecular_viscosity_m2_s, 'molecular viscosity')
        if not 1e-12 <= density <= 1e12 or not 0 <= molecular <= 1e6:
            raise ValueError('density or molecular viscosity outside bounds')
        return density * (molecular + self.eddy_viscosity_m2_s) * self.velocity_gradient_per_s


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShearMeasurement:
    """One caller-supplied shear observation, with source identity and SI units."""

    sample_id: str
    wall_distance_m: float
    velocity_gradient_per_s: float
    shear_stress_pa: float
    density_kg_m3: float
    molecular_viscosity_m2_s: float
    source: str
    synthetic: bool = False
    weight: float = 1.0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.sample_id, str) or not self.sample_id.strip():
            raise ValueError('sample identity required')
        if not isinstance(self.source, str) or not self.source.strip():
            raise ValueError('source declaration required')
        if type(self.synthetic) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('synthetic must be boolean')
        for name in ('wall_distance_m', 'velocity_gradient_per_s', 'shear_stress_pa',
                     'density_kg_m3', 'molecular_viscosity_m2_s', 'weight'):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _number(getattr(self, name), name))
        if not 0 <= self.wall_distance_m <= 1e6:
            raise ValueError('wall distance outside bounds')
        if abs(self.velocity_gradient_per_s) > 1e12 or abs(self.shear_stress_pa) > 1e30:
            raise ValueError('gradient or shear outside bounds')
        if not 1e-12 <= self.density_kg_m3 <= 1e12:
            raise ValueError('density outside bounds')
        if not 0 <= self.molecular_viscosity_m2_s <= 1e6 or not 1e-12 <= self.weight <= 1e12:
            raise ValueError('viscosity or weight outside bounds')

    def feature_and_target(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
        """Linear regression feature for kappa**2 without damping or cap."""
        g = self.velocity_gradient_per_s
        feature = self.density_kg_m3 * self.wall_distance_m**2 * abs(g) * g
        target = self.shear_stress_pa - self.density_kg_m3 * self.molecular_viscosity_m2_s * g
        return feature, target


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MixingLengthCalibration:
    """Weighted least-squares estimate constrained to the declared kappa domain."""

    model: MixingLengthModel
    rows: tuple[dict, ...]
    weighted_squared_residual_pa2: float
    sources: tuple[str, ...]
    synthetic_present: bool
    parameter_at_bound: bool

    def to_data(self) -> dict:
        return {
            'schema_version': CONTRACT_VERSION,
            'model': self.model.to_data(),
            'comparisons': list(self.rows),
            'weighted_squared_residual_pa2': self.weighted_squared_residual_pa2,
            'sources': list(self.sources),
            'synthetic_present': self.synthetic_present,
            'parameter_at_bound': self.parameter_at_bound,
            'source_authenticity_verified': False,
            'holdout_validation_performed': False,
            'limitations': 'Local fit to supplied samples, undamped and uncapped; no external calibration or predictive validity established.',
        }


def calibrate_mixing_length(
    measurements: Sequence[ShearMeasurement],
    *,
    minimum_kappa: float = 0.1,
    maximum_kappa: float = 1.0,
    max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s: float = 100.0,
) -> MixingLengthCalibration:
    """Fit kappa**2 to shear after molecular contribution, with fixed weights.

    The fitting closure is undamped. Samples that would engage the declared
    eddy-viscosity cap are rejected because they invalidate the linear fit.
    Degenerate all-zero features are rejected instead of inventing a parameter.
    """
    if not isinstance(measurements, (list, tuple)) or not 2 <= len(measurements) <= 10000:
        raise ValueError('two to 10000 measurements required')
    if not all(isinstance(m, ShearMeasurement) for m in measurements):
        raise ValueError('ShearMeasurement samples required')
    if len({m.sample_id for m in measurements}) != len(measurements):
        raise ValueError('sample identities must be unique')
    low, high = _number(minimum_kappa, 'minimum kappa'), _number(maximum_kappa, 'maximum kappa')
    if not 0.1 <= low < high <= 1.0:
        raise ValueError('kappa fitting interval must lie within [0.1,1]')
    pairs = [m.feature_and_target() for m in measurements]
    scale = max(abs(x) for x, _ in pairs)
    if scale == 0:
        raise ValueError('unidentifiable kappa: zero shear features')
    # Normalize the feature to reduce squaring-induced overflow/underflow.
    denominator = math.fsum(m.weight * (x / scale)**2 for m, (x, _) in zip(measurements, pairs))
    numerator = math.fsum(m.weight * (x / scale) * (y / scale) for m, (x, y) in zip(measurements, pairs))
    if not math.isfinite(numerator) or not math.isfinite(denominator) or denominator <= 0:
        raise ArithmeticError('ill-scaled calibration')
    coefficient = numerator / denominator
    constrained = min(high**2, max(low**2, coefficient))
    model = MixingLengthModel(math.sqrt(constrained), max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s=max_eddy_viscosity_m2_s,
                             max_wall_distance_m=max(1.0, max(m.wall_distance_m for m in measurements)))
    rows = []
    for sample in measurements:
        closure = model.evaluate(sample.wall_distance_m, sample.velocity_gradient_per_s)
        if closure.cap_active:
            raise ValueError('calibration samples activate the declared cap')
        predicted = closure.shear_stress_pa(sample.density_kg_m3, sample.molecular_viscosity_m2_s)
        rows.append({'sample_id': sample.sample_id, 'observed_pa': sample.shear_stress_pa,
                     'predicted_pa': predicted, 'residual_pa': predicted - sample.shear_stress_pa,
                     'weight': sample.weight, 'source': sample.source, 'synthetic': sample.synthetic})
    squared = math.fsum(r['weight'] * r['residual_pa']**2 for r in rows)
    if not math.isfinite(squared):
        raise ArithmeticError('nonfinite calibration residual')
    return MixingLengthCalibration(model, tuple(rows), squared,
                                   tuple(sorted({m.source for m in measurements})),
                                   any(m.synthetic for m in measurements), constrained != coefficient)

"""Checagem independente por integração de perfil radial em anéis."""

from math import pi

from .model import PipeFlow


def integrate_profile_midpoint(flow: PipeFlow, rings: int = 1024) -> float:
    if not 1 <= rings <= 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("Número de anéis fora do intervalo")
    dr = flow.radius_m/rings
    return sum(flow.velocity_at((i+0.5)*dr) * 2*pi*(i+0.5)*dr*dr
               for i in range(rings))

"""Propagação radial de dois corpos com momento angular conservado."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import isfinite

from .state import OrbitalState


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Propagation:
    state: OrbitalState
    duration_s: float
    steps: int
    energy_initial_j_kg: float
    energy_final_j_kg: float
    energy_error_j_kg: float
    assumptions: tuple[str, ...]


def acceleration(mu_m3_s2: float, radius_m: float) -> float:
    if not isfinite(mu_m3_s2) or mu_m3_s2 <= 0 or not isfinite(radius_m) or radius_m <= 0:
        raise ValueError("mu e raio devem ser finitos e positivos")
    return -mu_m3_s2 / radius_m**2


def propagate_radial(mu_m3_s2: float, initial: OrbitalState, duration_s: float,
                     steps: int = 1000) -> Propagation:
    """Integra (r, dr/dt) via RK4; v_t = h/r; sem orientação ou perturbações."""
    if not isfinite(mu_m3_s2) or mu_m3_s2 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("mu deve ser positivo e finito")
    if not isfinite(duration_s) or duration_s <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Duração deve ser positiva e finita")
    if isinstance(steps, bool) or not isinstance(steps, int) or not 1 <= steps <= 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("steps deve ser inteiro entre 1 e 1000000")
    h = initial.radius_m * initial.tangential_velocity_m_s
    dt = duration_s / steps
    r, vr = initial.radius_m, initial.radial_velocity_m_s

    def derivative(radius: float, radial_velocity: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
        if not isfinite(radius) or radius <= 0 or not isfinite(radial_velocity):
            raise ValueError("A integração saiu do domínio orbital")
        return radial_velocity, h**2 / radius**3 - mu_m3_s2 / radius**2

    for _ in range(steps):
        k1r, k1v = derivative(r, vr)
        k2r, k2v = derivative(r + dt*k1r/2, vr + dt*k1v/2)
        k3r, k3v = derivative(r + dt*k2r/2, vr + dt*k2v/2)
        k4r, k4v = derivative(r + dt*k3r, vr + dt*k3v)
        r += dt*(k1r + 2*k2r + 2*k3r + k4r)/6
        vr += dt*(k1v + 2*k2v + 2*k3v + k4v)/6
        derivative(r, vr)

    final = OrbitalState(r, vr, h/r, initial.epoch_s + duration_s, initial.frame)
    e0 = 0.5 * (initial.radial_velocity_m_s**2 + initial.tangential_velocity_m_s**2) - mu_m3_s2 / initial.radius_m
    e1 = 0.5 * (final.radial_velocity_m_s**2 + final.tangential_velocity_m_s**2) - mu_m3_s2 / final.radius_m
    return Propagation(final, duration_s, steps, e0, e1, abs(e1-e0),
                       ("point_mass", "two_body", "radial_reduced_model", "no_perturbations"))


__all__ = ["Propagation", "acceleration", "propagate_radial"]

"""Estado escalar mínimo para órbita ideal em um referencial inercial."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import isfinite


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OrbitalState:
    radius_m: float
    radial_velocity_m_s: float
    tangential_velocity_m_s: float
    epoch_s: float = 0.0
    frame: str = "two_body_inertial"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for value in (self.radius_m, self.radial_velocity_m_s,
                      self.tangential_velocity_m_s, self.epoch_s):
            if not isfinite(value):
                raise ValueError("Estado orbital deve ser finito")
        if self.radius_m <= 0 or self.tangential_velocity_m_s < 0:
            raise ValueError("Raio positivo e velocidade tangencial não negativa são necessários")

"""Validações de consistência dos modelos orbitais, sem fonte observacional implícita."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import isclose

from ...orbits import Orbit
from .dynamics import Propagation


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Validation:
    passed: bool
    checks: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...]


def validate_orbit(orbit: Orbit) -> Validation:
    values = orbit.summary()
    checks = ("positive_period", "nonnegative_eccentricity", "vis_viva_defined")
    passed = values["period_s"] > 0 and values["eccentricity"] >= 0 and isclose(
        orbit.speed_m_s(orbit.pericenter_m) ** 2,
        orbit.mu_m3_s2 * (2 / orbit.pericenter_m - 1 / orbit.semimajor_axis_m),
        rel_tol=1e-12,
    )
    return Validation(passed, checks, () if passed else ("analytic check failed",))


def validate_propagation(result: Propagation, tolerance_j_kg: float = 1e-2) -> Validation:
    if tolerance_j_kg < 0:
        raise ValueError("Tolerância não pode ser negativa")
    passed = result.energy_error_j_kg <= tolerance_j_kg
    return Validation(passed, ("energy_error_within_tolerance",),
                      () if passed else ("refine time step or use a vector solver",))


__all__ = ["Validation", "validate_orbit", "validate_propagation"]

"""Differentiable linear resistive-MHD Alfvén-wave reference solver.

The model is the 1D linearization of incompressible MHD around a uniform guide
field B0.  It evolves transverse velocity u and magnetic perturbation b on a
periodic grid:

    du/dt = (B0/(mu0*rho)) db/dx + nu d²u/dx²
    db/dt = B0 du/dx + eta d²b/dx²

where eta is magnetic diffusivity and nu is kinematic viscosity.

This is deliberately a reduced verification model, not a nonlinear multi-fluid,
Hall-MHD, relativistic-MHD or plasma-kinetics solver.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from typing import Sequence, TypeAlias

from ...autodiff import Var

Scalar: TypeAlias = float | Var
MU0 = 4.0e-7 * math.pi


def _value(x: Scalar) -> float:
    return x.value if isinstance(x, Var) else float(x)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AlfvenResult:
    velocity_m_s: tuple[Scalar, ...]
    magnetic_perturbation_t: tuple[Scalar, ...]
    dx_m: float
    dt_s: float
    steps: int
    density_kg_m3: float
    guide_field_t: float
    magnetic_diffusivity_m2_s: Scalar
    kinematic_viscosity_m2_s: Scalar
    assumptions: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "linearized_mhd",
        "one_dimensional",
        "periodic_boundary",
        "uniform_guide_field",
        "constant_density",
        "incompressible_transverse_perturbations",
        "scalar_resistivity",
        "scalar_viscosity",
        "explicit_central_difference",
    )

    @property
    def alfven_speed_m_s(self) -> float:
        return abs(self.guide_field_t) / math.sqrt(MU0 * self.density_kg_m3)

    def energy_j_per_m2(self) -> Scalar:
        total: Scalar = 0.0
        for velocity, magnetic in zip(self.velocity_m_s, self.magnetic_perturbation_t):
            total = total + (
                0.5 * self.density_kg_m3 * velocity * velocity
                + magnetic * magnetic / (2.0 * MU0)
            )
        return total * self.dx_m


def solve_linear_resistive_alfven(
    velocity0_m_s: Sequence[Scalar],
    magnetic0_t: Sequence[Scalar],
    length_m: float,
    duration_s: float,
    density_kg_m3: float,
    guide_field_t: float,
    magnetic_diffusivity_m2_s: Scalar,
    kinematic_viscosity_m2_s: Scalar = 0.0,
    *,
    steps: int = 10,
) -> AlfvenResult:
    velocity = tuple(velocity0_m_s)
    magnetic = tuple(magnetic0_t)
    n = len(velocity)
    if n < 3 or len(magnetic) != n:
        raise ValueError("MHD 1D requer vetores de mesmo tamanho com ao menos três células")
    if any(not math.isfinite(_value(x)) for x in velocity + magnetic):
        raise ValueError("Estado MHD inicial contém valor não finito")
    for value, name in (
        (length_m, "length_m"),
        (duration_s, "duration_s"),
        (density_kg_m3, "density_kg_m3"),
    ):
        if not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} deve ser positivo e finito")
    if not math.isfinite(guide_field_t) or guide_field_t == 0:
        raise ValueError("guide_field_t deve ser finito e não nulo")
    eta = _value(magnetic_diffusivity_m2_s)
    nu = _value(kinematic_viscosity_m2_s)
    if not math.isfinite(eta) or eta < 0 or not math.isfinite(nu) or nu < 0:
        raise ValueError("Difusividades precisam ser finitas e não negativas")
    if isinstance(steps, bool) or not isinstance(steps, int) or not 1 <= steps <= 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("steps deve ser inteiro entre 1 e 1000000")

    dx = length_m / n
    dt = duration_s / steps
    alfven_speed = abs(guide_field_t) / math.sqrt(MU0 * density_kg_m3)
    wave_limit = 0.40 * dx / alfven_speed
    max_diffusivity = max(eta, nu)
    diffusion_limit = math.inf if max_diffusivity == 0 else 0.40 * dx * dx / max_diffusivity
    if dt > min(wave_limit, diffusion_limit):
        raise ValueError("Passo temporal viola estabilidade explícita do solver MHD")

    coupling_u = guide_field_t / (MU0 * density_kg_m3)
    for _ in range(steps):
        next_velocity: list[Scalar] = []
        next_magnetic: list[Scalar] = []
        for i in range(n):
            im, ip = (i - 1) % n, (i + 1) % n
            du_dx = (velocity[ip] - velocity[im]) / (2.0 * dx)
            db_dx = (magnetic[ip] - magnetic[im]) / (2.0 * dx)
            lap_u = (velocity[ip] - 2.0 * velocity[i] + velocity[im]) / (dx * dx)
            lap_b = (magnetic[ip] - 2.0 * magnetic[i] + magnetic[im]) / (dx * dx)
            next_velocity.append(
                velocity[i] + dt * (coupling_u * db_dx + kinematic_viscosity_m2_s * lap_u)
            )
            next_magnetic.append(
                magnetic[i] + dt * (guide_field_t * du_dx + magnetic_diffusivity_m2_s * lap_b)
            )
        velocity = tuple(next_velocity)
        magnetic = tuple(next_magnetic)

    return AlfvenResult(
        velocity,
        magnetic,
        dx,
        dt,
        steps,
        density_kg_m3,
        guide_field_t,
        magnetic_diffusivity_m2_s,
        kinematic_viscosity_m2_s,
    )


__all__ = ["Scalar", "MU0", "AlfvenResult", "solve_linear_resistive_alfven"]

"""Spatially flat FLRW perfect-fluid solutions in geometrized units c=G=1.

This is a bounded analytic Einstein-equation profile, not numerical relativity.
Stress-energy uses pressure p=w*rho, zero cosmological constant, t>0.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FlatFLRW:
    equation_of_state: float = 0.0
    scale_at_unit_time: float = 1.0

    def __post_init__(self):
        if (not math.isfinite(self.equation_of_state)
                or not -1 < self.equation_of_state <= 1):
            raise ValueError("Supported perfect fluids require -1 < w <= 1")
        if not math.isfinite(self.scale_at_unit_time) or self.scale_at_unit_time <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Positive finite scale normalization required")

    @property
    def exponent(self):
        return 2 / (3 * (1 + self.equation_of_state))

    def _time(self, t):
        if isinstance(t, bool) or not math.isfinite(t) or t <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Cosmic time must be positive and finite")
        return float(t)

    def scale(self, t):
        return self.scale_at_unit_time * self._time(t) ** self.exponent

    def hubble(self, t):
        return self.exponent / self._time(t)

    def density(self, t):
        return 3 * self.hubble(t) ** 2 / (8 * math.pi)

    def pressure(self, t):
        return self.equation_of_state * self.density(t)

    def ricci_scalar(self, t):
        t = self._time(t)
        n = self.exponent
        return 6 * n * (2 * n - 1) / t ** 2

    def metric_diagonal(self, t):
        a2 = self.scale(t) ** 2
        return (-1.0, a2, a2, a2)

    def christoffel(self, t):
        """Gamma[upper][lower][lower] in comoving Cartesian coordinates."""
        a, h = self.scale(t), self.hubble(t)
        gamma = [[[0.0] * 4 for _ in range(4)] for _ in range(4)]
        for i in range(1, 4):
            gamma[0][i][i] = a * a * h
            gamma[i][0][i] = gamma[i][i][0] = h
        return tuple(tuple(tuple(row) for row in plane) for plane in gamma)

    def geodesic_acceleration(self, t, tangent):
        if len(tangent) != 4 or any(not math.isfinite(v) for v in tangent):
            raise ValueError("Four finite tangent components required")
        gamma = self.christoffel(t)
        return tuple(-sum(gamma[m][i][j] * tangent[i] * tangent[j]
                          for i in range(4) for j in range(4)) for m in range(4))

    def field_residuals(self, t):
        t = self._time(t)
        n, h, rho, p = self.exponent, self.hubble(t), self.density(t), self.pressure(t)
        hdot = -n / t ** 2
        rhodot = -2 * rho / t
        return {"friedmann": 3 * h * h - 8 * math.pi * rho,
                "acceleration": 2 * hdot + 3 * h * h + 8 * math.pi * p,
                "continuity": rhodot + 3 * h * (rho + p),
                "trace": self.ricci_scalar(t) - 8 * math.pi * (rho - 3 * p)}

    def radial_null_displacement(self, start, end):
        """Comoving light travel distance integral(dt/a); no observational fit."""
        start, end = self._time(start), self._time(end)
        if end < start:
            raise ValueError("End must not precede start")
        n, a = self.exponent, self.scale_at_unit_time
        if abs(n - 1) < 1e-14:
            return math.log(end / start) / a
        return (end ** (1 - n) - start ** (1 - n)) / ((1 - n) * a)

"""Explicit Schwarzschild reference geometry and weak-field observables.

This module implements one exact vacuum metric and selected invariants/observables.
It is not a generic Einstein-equation solver.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import isfinite, pi, sin, sqrt

from .special import C_M_S

G_M3_KG_S2 = 6.67430e-11


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SchwarzschildMetric:
    mass_kg: float

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isfinite(self.mass_kg) or self.mass_kg <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Massa central deve ser positiva e finita")

    @property
    def schwarzschild_radius_m(self) -> float:
        return 2.0 * G_M3_KG_S2 * self.mass_kg / (C_M_S ** 2)

    def _outside(self, radius_m: float) -> float:
        if not isfinite(radius_m) or radius_m <= self.schwarzschild_radius_m:
            raise ValueError("Esta carta estática exige r > raio de Schwarzschild")
        return 1.0 - self.schwarzschild_radius_m / radius_m

    def diagonal(self, radius_m: float, theta_rad: float) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
        factor = self._outside(radius_m)
        if not isfinite(theta_rad):
            raise ValueError("theta deve ser finito")
        return (
            -factor * C_M_S ** 2,
            1.0 / factor,
            radius_m ** 2,
            radius_m ** 2 * sin(theta_rad) ** 2,
        )

    def static_clock_rate(self, radius_m: float) -> float:
        return sqrt(self._outside(radius_m))

    def kretschmann_m4_inverse(self, radius_m: float) -> float:
        self._outside(radius_m)
        return 48.0 * (G_M3_KG_S2 ** 2) * (self.mass_kg ** 2) / (C_M_S ** 4 * radius_m ** 6)

    def circular_orbit_angular_velocity_rad_s(self, radius_m: float) -> float:
        self._outside(radius_m)
        return sqrt(G_M3_KG_S2 * self.mass_kg / radius_m ** 3)

    def weak_field_periapsis_advance_rad_per_orbit(self, semi_major_axis_m: float, eccentricity: float) -> float:
        if not isfinite(semi_major_axis_m) or semi_major_axis_m <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Semieixo maior deve ser positivo e finito")
        if not isfinite(eccentricity) or not 0 <= eccentricity < 1:
            raise ValueError("Excentricidade deve satisfazer 0 <= e < 1")
        denominator = semi_major_axis_m * (1.0 - eccentricity ** 2) * C_M_S ** 2
        return 6.0 * pi * G_M3_KG_S2 * self.mass_kg / denominator


def minkowski_christoffel_cartesian() -> tuple[tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...], ...]:
    return tuple(tuple(tuple(0.0 for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(4))


__all__ = ["G_M3_KG_S2", "SchwarzschildMetric", "minkowski_christoffel_cartesian"]

"""Reference special-relativity primitives in SI units."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import isfinite, sqrt

C_M_S = 299_792_458.0


def _speed(vx: float, vy: float = 0.0, vz: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in (vx, vy, vz)):
        raise ValueError("Velocidade deve ser finita")
    return sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz)


def lorentz_gamma(v_m_s: float) -> float:
    speed = abs(float(v_m_s))
    if not isfinite(speed) or speed >= C_M_S:
        raise ValueError("Transformação de Lorentz exige |v| < c")
    beta = speed / C_M_S
    return 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 - beta * beta)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FourPosition:
    t_s: float
    x_m: float
    y_m: float = 0.0
    z_m: float = 0.0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not all(isfinite(v) for v in (self.t_s, self.x_m, self.y_m, self.z_m)):
            raise ValueError("Quatro-posição deve ser finita")


def minkowski_interval_squared(event: FourPosition) -> float:
    return (C_M_S * event.t_s) ** 2 - event.x_m ** 2 - event.y_m ** 2 - event.z_m ** 2


def lorentz_boost_x(event: FourPosition, velocity_m_s: float) -> FourPosition:
    gamma = lorentz_gamma(velocity_m_s)
    v = float(velocity_m_s)
    t = gamma * (event.t_s - v * event.x_m / (C_M_S * C_M_S))
    x = gamma * (event.x_m - v * event.t_s)
    return FourPosition(t, x, event.y_m, event.z_m)


def compose_collinear_velocities(u_m_s: float, v_m_s: float) -> float:
    if abs(u_m_s) >= C_M_S or abs(v_m_s) >= C_M_S:
        raise ValueError("Velocidades de entrada devem ser subluminais")
    result = (u_m_s + v_m_s) / (1.0 + u_m_s * v_m_s / (C_M_S * C_M_S))
    if abs(result) >= C_M_S * (1 + 1e-14):
        raise ArithmeticError("Composição produziu velocidade superluminal")
    return result


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FourMomentum:
    energy_j: float
    px_kg_m_s: float
    py_kg_m_s: float
    pz_kg_m_s: float
    rest_mass_kg: float

    @property
    def momentum_squared(self) -> float:
        return self.px_kg_m_s ** 2 + self.py_kg_m_s ** 2 + self.pz_kg_m_s ** 2

    @property
    def invariant_j2(self) -> float:
        return self.energy_j ** 2 - self.momentum_squared * C_M_S ** 2


def four_momentum(rest_mass_kg: float, vx_m_s: float, vy_m_s: float = 0.0, vz_m_s: float = 0.0) -> FourMomentum:
    if not isfinite(rest_mass_kg) or rest_mass_kg < 0:
        raise ValueError("Massa de repouso deve ser finita e não negativa")
    speed = _speed(vx_m_s, vy_m_s, vz_m_s)
    gamma = lorentz_gamma(speed)
    energy = gamma * rest_mass_kg * C_M_S ** 2
    factor = gamma * rest_mass_kg
    return FourMomentum(energy, factor * vx_m_s, factor * vy_m_s, factor * vz_m_s, rest_mass_kg)


def mass_shell_relative_error(momentum: FourMomentum) -> float:
    expected = (momentum.rest_mass_kg * C_M_S ** 2) ** 2
    scale = max(abs(expected), abs(momentum.invariant_j2), 1.0)
    return abs(momentum.invariant_j2 - expected) / scale


__all__ = [
    "C_M_S", "FourPosition", "FourMomentum", "lorentz_gamma", "minkowski_interval_squared",
    "lorentz_boost_x", "compose_collinear_velocities", "four_momentum", "mass_shell_relative_error",
]

"""Typed presentation of exact results and bounded previews for print."""
from fractions import Fraction
import math
import re


def display_value(value):
    if type(value) is int or (type(value) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?\d+(?:/\d+)?',value)):
        try:
            rational = Fraction(value)
        except (ValueError,ZeroDivisionError):
            pass
        else:
            if max(len(str(rational.numerator)),len(str(rational.denominator))) <= 24:
                return {'kind':'exact','numerator':str(rational.numerator),'denominator':str(rational.denominator)}
    if type(value) is float and math.isfinite(value):
        return {'kind':'approximate','text':format(value,'.10g')}
    if isinstance(value,list) and value and len(value) <= 6:
        parts = [display_value(v) for v in value]
        if all(part['kind'] in {'exact','approximate'} for part in parts):
            return {'kind':'vector','items':parts}
        if all(isinstance(row,list) and 1 <= len(row) <= 4 for row in value) and len(value) <= 4 and len({len(row) for row in value}) == 1:
            rows = [[display_value(v) for v in row] for row in value]
            widths = [max(len(part.get('text',part.get('numerator',''))),len(part.get('denominator',''))) for row in rows for part in row]
            if all(part['kind'] in {'exact','approximate'} for row in rows for part in row) and max(widths,default=0)*len(rows[0])+2*(len(rows[0])-1)<=30:
                return {'kind':'matrix','rows':rows}
    if isinstance(value,list):
        return {'kind':'text','text':f'{len(value)} entries; complete values in the experiment bundle'}
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        names = ', '.join(str(k) for k in list(value)[:5])
        return {'kind':'text','text':f'{len(value)} fields: {names}; complete object in the experiment bundle'}
    text = str(value)
    text = text if len(text)<=256 else text[:240]+'… [complete value in bundle]'
    text = re.sub(r'[^\s]{32,}',lambda match:'\u200b'.join(match[0][i:i+20] for i in range(0,len(match[0]),20)),text)
    return {'kind':'text','text':text}

FOOTER = r'''
#set page(margin: (left: 22mm, right: 22mm, top: 23mm, bottom: 35mm), footer: context [
  #set text(font: "DejaVu Sans Mono", size: 6.3pt, fill: rgb("526471"))
  #set par(leading: 0.25em, justify: false)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt + rgb("c9d5db"))
  #v(3pt)
  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), text("NABLA / AUDITABLE COMPUTATION"),
        [#counter(page).display() / #counter(page).final().at(0)])
  #linebreak()
  #text("Experiment SHA-256: " + nabla.experiment_hash) \
  #text(nabla.signature_label) \
  #for line in nabla.signature_lines { text(line); linebreak() }
])
'''


def _hash(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _read(path, maximum=MAX_BYTES):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        value = stream.read(maximum+1)
    if len(value) > maximum:
        raise ValueError('Publication input exceeds byte budget')
    return value


def _pointer(value, pointer):
    if not isinstance(pointer,str) or (pointer and not pointer.startswith('/')):
        raise ValueError('Result bindings require RFC 6901 JSON pointers')
    for part in pointer.split('/')[1:] if pointer else []:
        part = part.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        value = value[int(part)] if isinstance(value,list) else value[part]
    return value


def _signature(bundle, envelope, trust, required):
    if envelope is None:
        if required:
            raise ValueError('This publication requires a trusted laboratory signature')
        return 'Unsigned: no laboratory signature supplied',[]
    if trust is None or not trust.verify(envelope):
        raise ValueError('Unknown, invalid or revoked publication signature')
    payload = envelope['payload']
    if payload == bundle:
        scope = 'experiment'
    elif any(payload == calculation for calculation in bundle['receipts']):
        scope = 'receipt '+payload['content_id']
    else:
        raise ValueError('Signature does not cover this experiment or one of its receipts')
    text = envelope['signature']
    return f"Signer: {envelope['signer']}; scope: {scope}",[text[i:i+72] for i in range(0,len(text),72)]


def _verify_footer(pdf, experiment_hash, signature):
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
    except ImportError as error:
        raise ImportError('Install nablamath[publishing] to check PDF provenance footers') from error
    reader = PdfReader(pdf)
    if not 1 <= len(reader.pages) <= 1000:
        raise ValueError('PDF page budget exceeded')
    for page in reader.pages:
        text = ''.join((page.extract_text() or '').split())
        if experiment_hash not in text or (signature is not None and signature['signature'] not in text):
            raise ValueError('A rendered page is missing the required experiment hash/signature footer')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Publication:
    pdf: Path
    manifest: Path
    experiment_hash: str
    publication_id: str
    changed: bool


class TypstCompiler:
    def __init__(self, *, executable=None, trust=None, require_signature=False, timeout=60):
        if type(require_signature) is not bool or type(timeout) not in (int,float) or not 0 < timeout <= 600:
            raise ValueError('Invalid publication policy or renderer timeout')
        self.executable = executable or shutil.which('typst')
        self.trust,self.require_signature,self.timeout = trust,require_signature,timeout
        self._lock = RLock()

    def compile(self, artifact, destination, *, template=None, variables=None, figures=(),
                asset_root=None, title='Nabla living paper', signature=None,
                authors=(), abstract='', language='en'):
        with self._lock:
            destination = Path(destination)
            if destination.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('Publication PDF cannot be a symlink')
            with publication_lock(destination.with_suffix(destination.suffix+'.lock')):
                return self._compile(artifact,destination,template=template,variables=variables,
                                     figures=figures,asset_root=asset_root,title=title,signature=signature,
                                     authors=authors,abstract=abstract,language=language)

    def _compile(self, artifact, destination, *, template, variables, figures, asset_root, title, signature,authors,abstract,language):
        bundle = load_bundle(artifact) if isinstance(artifact,(str,Path)) else json.loads(canonical_json(artifact))
        if not verify_bundle(bundle):
            raise ValueError('Living papers require a verified Nabla artifact bundle')
        label,signature_lines = _signature(bundle,signature,self.trust,self.require_signature)
        if not isinstance(title,str) or not title.strip() or len(title) > 4096:
            raise ValueError('A bounded publication title is required')
        if not isinstance(authors,(tuple,list)) or len(authors)>32 or any(not isinstance(v,str) or not v.strip() or len(v)>256 for v in authors):
            raise ValueError('A publication accepts at most 32 named authors')
        if not isinstance(abstract,str) or len(abstract)>8192:
            raise ValueError('Abstract exceeds its publication budget')
        preamble = typst_style(title,bundle['content_id'],language=language)
        template_text = (_read(template,1048576).decode() if template is not None else
                         resources.files('nablamath.publishing').joinpath('templates/living_paper.typ').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if variables is None:
            result = bundle['receipts'][0]['result'] if bundle['receipts'] else {}
            variables = {k:'/receipts/0/result/'+k.replace('~','~0').replace('/','~1')
                         for k in result if re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}',k)} if isinstance(result,dict) else {}
        if not isinstance(variables,dict) or len(variables) > 128:
            raise ValueError('A publication accepts at most 128 result bindings')
        bindings,results = {},[]
        for name,pointer in variables.items():
            if not isinstance(name,str) or not re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}',name):
                raise ValueError('Invalid result binding name')
            value = _pointer(bundle,pointer)
            text = value if isinstance(value,str) else canonical_json(value)
            if len(text) > 65536:
                raise ValueError('Select a result summary instead of embedding an oversized data array')
            bindings[name] = text
            results.append({'name':name.replace('_',' '),'value':display_value(value)})
        def replace(match):
            name = match.group(1)
            if name not in bindings:
                raise ValueError('Unknown template result binding: '+name)
            return '#nabla.bindings.at('+json.dumps(name)+')'
        body = PLACEHOLDER.sub(replace,template_text)
        if len(figures) > 32 or (figures and asset_root is None):
            raise ValueError('At most 32 figures with an explicit asset_root are allowed')
        images,assets = [],[]
        for i,figure in enumerate(figures):
            if not isinstance(figure,dict) or set(figure) != {'path','caption'} or not isinstance(figure['caption'],str) or len(figure['caption']) > 4096:
                raise ValueError('Figures require path and bounded caption')
            root = Path(asset_root).resolve()
            path = Path(figure['path'])
            path = path if path.is_absolute() else root/path
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or path.suffix.lower() not in {'.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.svg'}:
                raise ValueError('Figure is outside asset_root or has an unsupported format')
            raw = _read(path); relative = f'assets/figure-{i}{path.suffix.lower()}'
            assets.append((relative,raw))
            images.append({'path':relative,'caption':figure['caption'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
        data = {'title':title,'experiment_hash':bundle['content_id'],'bindings':bindings,'images':images,
                'signature_label':json.loads(typst_literal(label)),'signature_lines':signature_lines,'results':results,
                'authors':list(authors),'abstract':abstract,'language':language}
        renderer = self.executable or 'python-typst'
        try:
            renderer_version = version('typst') if self.executable is None else 'external-cli'
        except PackageNotFoundError as error:
            raise ImportError('Install nablamath[publishing] or a Typst executable') from error
        identity = fingerprint({'experiment':bundle,'template':template_text,'data':data,
                                'signature':signature,'renderer':renderer,'version':renderer_version,'footer_template':FOOTER,'style':preamble})
        destination = Path(destination)
        manifest_path = destination.with_suffix(destination.suffix+'.nabla.json')
        if destination.exists():
            if not verify_publication(destination,trust=self.trust,require_signature=self.require_signature):
                raise FileExistsError('Existing PDF has no intact Nabla publication manifest; it will not be overwritten')
            old = json.loads(_read(manifest_path))
            if old['input_id'] == identity:
                return Publication(destination,manifest_path,bundle['content_id'],old['content_id'],False)
        elif manifest_path.exists():
            raise ValueError('Publication manifest exists without its PDF')
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        history = destination.parent/(destination.name+'.history')
        if history.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('Publication history cannot be a symlink')
        history.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.nabla-paper-',dir=history) as directory:
            stage = Path(directory)
            (stage/'experiment.json').write_text(canonical_json(data),encoding='utf-8')
            (stage/'bundle.json').write_text(canonical_json(bundle),encoding='utf-8')
            (stage/'template.typ').write_text(template_text,encoding='utf-8')
            source = '#let nabla = json("experiment.json")\n'+preamble+'\n'+FOOTER+'\n'+body
            (stage/'paper.typ').write_text(source,encoding='utf-8')
            for relative,raw in assets:
                path = stage/relative; path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); path.write_bytes(raw)
            if self.executable:
                command = [str(self.executable),'compile','--root',str(stage),str(stage/'paper.typ'),str(stage/'paper.pdf')]
            else:
                command = [sys.executable,'-m','nablamath.publishing._typst_worker',str(stage/'paper.typ'),str(stage/'paper.pdf'),str(stage)]
            run_renderer(command,cwd=stage,timeout=self.timeout)
            pdf = _read(stage/'paper.pdf',256*1024*1024)
            if not pdf.startswith(b'%PDF-'):
                raise RuntimeError('Typst did not produce a PDF')
            _verify_footer(stage/'paper.pdf',bundle['content_id'],signature)
            body_manifest = {'schema_version':1,'kind':'nabla_living_paper','input_id':identity,
                'experiment_hash':bundle['content_id'],'signature':signature,'images':images,
                'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pdf).hexdigest(),'template_sha256':hashlib.sha256(template_text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                'rendered_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
                'renderer':renderer,'renderer_version':renderer_version,
                'limitations':'Signature scope is explicit; prose, experimental validity and independent scientific review are not certified.'}
            manifest = {**body_manifest,'content_id':fingerprint(body_manifest)}
            snapshot = history/(identity+'-'+manifest['pdf_sha256'][:16])
            if snapshot.exists():
                if _hash(snapshot/'paper.pdf') != manifest['pdf_sha256']:
                    raise ValueError('Historical publication snapshot was altered')
            else:
                shutil.copytree(stage,snapshot)
            manifest['snapshot'] = snapshot.name
            # The pointer to an immutable snapshot is part of the manifest digest.
            manifest['content_id'] = fingerprint({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k != 'content_id'})
            if not (snapshot/'manifest.json').exists():
                with (snapshot/'manifest.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    stream.write(canonical_json(manifest))
            descriptor,temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.nabla-pdf-',dir=destination.parent)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(descriptor,'wb') as stream:
                    stream.write(pdf); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                if destination.exists():
                    # Recheck immediately before publication; never replace an edited PDF.
                    if not verify_publication(destination,trust=self.trust,require_signature=self.require_signature):
                        raise ValueError('Publication changed during compilation')
                    os.replace(temporary,destination)
                else:
                    os.link(temporary,destination)
            finally:
                Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            descriptor,temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.nabla-manifest-',dir=destination.parent)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(descriptor,'w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    stream.write(canonical_json(manifest)); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                os.replace(temporary,manifest_path)
            finally:
                Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return Publication(destination,manifest_path,bundle['content_id'],manifest['content_id'],True)

    def watch(self, artifact, destination, *, stop_event=None, poll_interval=.5,max_updates=None,**options):
        if not isinstance(artifact,(str,Path)) or not .05 <= poll_interval <= 60:
            raise ValueError('Watch requires a bundle path and poll interval in [.05,60] seconds')
        if max_updates is not None and (type(max_updates) is not int or max_updates < 1):
            raise ValueError('max_updates must be positive or None')
        stop_event = stop_event or Event(); updates = 0
        while not stop_event.is_set():
            publication = self.compile(artifact,destination,**options)
            if publication.changed:
                yield publication
                updates += 1
                if max_updates is not None and updates >= max_updates:
                    return
            stop_event.wait(poll_interval)


def verify_publication(pdf, *, trust=None, require_signature=False):
    try:
        pdf = Path(pdf); path = pdf.with_suffix(pdf.suffix+'.nabla.json')
        manifest = json.loads(_read(path))
        body = {k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k != 'content_id'}
        if manifest['schema_version'] != 1 or manifest['kind'] != 'nabla_living_paper' or fingerprint(body) != manifest['content_id'] or _hash(pdf) != manifest['pdf_sha256']:
            return False
        name = manifest['snapshot']
        if not isinstance(name,str) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}-[0-9a-f]{16}',name):
            return False
        root = pdf.parent/(pdf.name+'.history')/name
        if root.is_symlink() or root.parent.is_symlink() or any((root/file).is_symlink() for file in ('bundle.json','paper.pdf','template.typ','paper.typ')):
            return False
        bundle = load_bundle(root/'bundle.json')
        if bundle['content_id'] != manifest['experiment_hash'] or _hash(root/'paper.pdf') != manifest['pdf_sha256'] or _hash(root/'template.typ') != manifest['template_sha256'] or _hash(root/'paper.typ') != manifest['rendered_source_sha256']:
            return False
        for image in manifest['images']:
            asset = root/image['path']
            if not asset.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or _hash(asset) != image['sha256']:
                return False
        _signature(bundle,manifest['signature'],trust,require_signature)
        _verify_footer(pdf,bundle['content_id'],manifest['signature'])
        return True
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,IndexError,RecursionError):
        return False

"""Reactive scientific papers: escaped Typst/LaTeX, standalone HTML and PDF.

Documents are structured data, not executable templates. Typst/PDF compilation
uses the existing isolated renderer. LaTeX source is exported but never executed
with shell escape. An experiment attachment and clickable local audit companion
make provenance inspectable without a verification service. Hashes establish
integrity, not the scientific correctness of prose or results.
"""
import base64
from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import html
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile

from ..artifacts.bundle import load_bundle, verify_bundle
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json
from ..publishing.living_paper import TypstCompiler, _pointer

_BINDING = re.compile(r'\{\{\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63})\s*\}\}')
_MAX_BYTES = 16*1024*1024


def _read(path, limit=_MAX_BYTES):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        raw = stream.read(limit+1)
    if len(raw)>limit:
        raise ValueError('Publication input budget exceeded')
    return raw


def _latex(value):
    replacements = {'\\':r'\textbackslash{}','&':r'\&','%':r'\%','$':r'\$',
                    '#':r'\#','_':r'\_','{':r'\{','}':r'\}','~':r'\textasciitilde{}','^':r'\textasciicircum{}'}
    return ''.join(replacements.get(c,c) for c in str(value))


def _literal(value):
    # Typst receives only quoted strings, never user-provided markup/math source.
    return json.dumps(str(value),ensure_ascii=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PaperBuild:
    directory: Path
    experiment_hash: str
    manifest: Path
    pdf: Path | None
    html: Path


class LivingPapersCompiler:
    def __init__(self, *, timeout=60, trust=None, require_signature=False):
        self.renderer = TypstCompiler(timeout=timeout,trust=trust,require_signature=require_signature)

    @staticmethod
    def _bundle(artifact):
        bundle = load_bundle(artifact) if isinstance(artifact,(str,Path)) else json.loads(canonical_json(artifact))
        if not verify_bundle(bundle):
            raise ValueError('Verified experiment bundle required')
        return bundle

    def resolve(self, artifact, document, *, bindings=None):
        """Resolve {{names}} through explicit RFC6901 pointers into a bundle."""
        bundle = self._bundle(artifact)
        if not isinstance(document,dict) or set(document)-{'title','authors','abstract','blocks','language'}:
            raise ValueError('Unknown document fields')
        title = document.get('title')
        if not isinstance(title,str) or not title.strip() or len(title)>4096:
            raise ValueError('Bounded nonempty title required')
        authors = document.get('authors',[])
        if not isinstance(authors,list) or len(authors)>32 or any(not isinstance(a,str) or not a.strip() or len(a)>256 for a in authors):
            raise ValueError('Up to 32 named authors required')
        bindings = bindings or {}
        if not isinstance(bindings,dict) or len(bindings)>128:
            raise ValueError('At most 128 explicit bindings required')
        values = {}
        for name,pointer in bindings.items():
            if not isinstance(name,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}',name):
                raise ValueError('Invalid binding name')
            value = _pointer(bundle,pointer)
            values[name] = value if isinstance(value,str) else canonical_json(value)
        def text(value, limit=65536):
            if not isinstance(value,str) or len(value)>limit:
                raise ValueError('Bounded document text required')
            def replace(match):
                if match[1] not in values:
                    raise ValueError('Unknown result binding: '+match[1])
                return values[match[1]]
            result = _BINDING.sub(replace,value)
            if len(result)>limit:
                raise ValueError('Resolved text budget exceeded')
            return result
        blocks = document.get('blocks',[])
        if not isinstance(blocks,list) or len(blocks)>256:
            raise ValueError('At most 256 document blocks required')
        resolved = []
        for block in blocks:
            if not isinstance(block,dict):
                raise ValueError('Structured document block required')
            kind = block.get('kind')
            if kind in ('paragraph','heading','equation') and set(block)=={'kind','text'}:
                resolved.append({'kind':kind,'text':text(block['text'])})
            elif kind == 'table' and set(block)=={'kind','headers','rows'}:
                headers,rows = block['headers'],block['rows']
                if not isinstance(headers,list) or not 1<=len(headers)<=16 or not isinstance(rows,list) or len(rows)>1000:
                    raise ValueError('Table dimension budget exceeded')
                if any(not isinstance(row,list) or len(row)!=len(headers) for row in rows):
                    raise ValueError('Rectangular table required')
                resolved.append({'kind':kind,'headers':[text(v,4096) for v in headers],
                                 'rows':[[text(v,4096) for v in row] for row in rows]})
            elif kind == 'figure' and set(block)=={'kind','path','caption'}:
                resolved.append({'kind':kind,'path':text(block['path'],4096),'caption':text(block['caption'],4096)})
            else:
                raise ValueError('Unsupported document block or extra fields')
        language = document.get('language','pt')
        if language not in ('pt','en','es','fr','de'):
            raise ValueError('Unsupported document language')
        return bundle, {'title':text(title,4096),'authors':authors,
                        'abstract':text(document.get('abstract',''),8192),
                        'blocks':resolved,'language':language}

    @staticmethod
    def _sources(document, experiment_hash):
        """Generate two escaped editorial sources with identical block content."""
        typ = ['#nabla-title(nabla.title)', '#text('+_literal(' · '.join(document['authors']))+')',
               '#block(fill: rgb("f2f6f7"), inset: 12pt, radius: 3pt)[#text('+_literal(document['abstract'])+')]']
        tex = [r'\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}',r'\usepackage[margin=22mm]{geometry}',
               r'\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}',r'\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}',
               r'\usepackage{graphicx,booktabs,longtable,xcolor,fancyhdr,hyperref}',
               r'\hypersetup{colorlinks=true,urlcolor=teal}',r'\pagestyle{fancy}',r'\fancyhf{}',
               r'\fancyfoot[C]{\tiny SHA-256: \texttt{'+_latex(experiment_hash)+r'}\quad\thepage}',
               r'\title{'+_latex(document['title'])+'}',r'\author{'+_latex(' · '.join(document['authors']))+'}',
               r'\date{}',r'\begin{document}\maketitle',r'\begin{abstract}'+_latex(document['abstract'])+r'\end{abstract}']
        figure_index = 0
        for block in document['blocks']:
            kind = block['kind']
            if kind=='paragraph':
                typ.append('#par('+_literal(block['text'])+')')
                tex.append(_latex(block['text'])+'\n\n')
            elif kind=='heading':
                typ.append('#heading('+_literal(block['text'])+')')
                tex.append(r'\section{'+_latex(block['text'])+'}')
            elif kind=='equation':
                # User equation is displayed literally. No arbitrary TeX/Typst execution.
                typ.append('#block(width: 100%, inset: 9pt, fill: rgb("f2f6f7"))[#align(center, text(font: "DejaVu Sans Mono", size: 9pt, '+_literal(block['text'])+'))]')
                tex.append(r'\begin{quote}\ttfamily '+_latex(block['text'])+r'\end{quote}')
            elif kind=='table':
                cells = block['headers']+[v for row in block['rows'] for v in row]
                typ.append('#table(columns: '+str(len(block['headers']))+', '+', '.join('text('+_literal(v)+')' for v in cells)+')')
                tex.extend([r'\begin{longtable}{'+'l'*len(block['headers'])+'}',r'\toprule',
                            ' & '.join(map(_latex,block['headers']))+r'\\\midrule'])
                tex.extend(' & '.join(map(_latex,row))+r'\\' for row in block['rows'])
                tex.append(r'\bottomrule\end{longtable}')
            else:
                suffix = Path(block['path']).suffix.lower()
                path = f'assets/figure-{figure_index}{suffix}'
                typ.append('#figure(link("audit.html", image('+_literal(path)+', width: 92%)), caption: text('+_literal(block['caption'])+'))')
                tex.extend([r'\begin{figure}[ht]\centering',r'\href{audit.html}{\includegraphics[width=.92\linewidth]{'+path+'}}',
                            r'\caption{'+_latex(block['caption'])+r'}\end{figure}'])
                figure_index += 1
        typ.extend(['#pagebreak(weak: true)','#heading("Audit & reproducibility")',
                    '#par("The attached experiment records the computation; integrity does not certify scientific conclusions.")',
                    '#link("audit.html")[Open local audit companion]',
                    '#figure(image("audit-qr.svg", width: 24mm), caption: [Experiment identifier])'])
        tex.extend([r'\section*{Audit and reproducibility}',r'\href{audit.html}{Open local audit companion.}',
                    r'\end{document}'])
        return '\n'.join(typ), '\n'.join(tex)

    @staticmethod
    def _qr(experiment_hash):
        try:
            import qrcode
            from qrcode.image.svg import SvgPathImage
        except ImportError as error:
            raise ImportError('Install nablamath[publishing] for publication QR codes') from error
        stream = io.BytesIO()
        qrcode.make('urn:sha256:'+experiment_hash,image_factory=SvgPathImage,box_size=4,border=4).save(stream)
        return stream.getvalue()

    @staticmethod
    def _html(document, bundle, assets):
        raw = canonical_json(bundle).encode()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        encoded = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
        title = html.escape(document['title'])
        parts = ['<!doctype html><html lang="'+document['language']+'"><meta charset="utf-8">',
                 '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width"><title>'+title+'</title>',
                 '<style>body{margin:0;background:#edf2f4;color:#172b3a;font:17px/1.65 Georgia,serif}main{max-width:850px;margin:32px auto;padding:48px;background:white;border-top:5px solid #117879}h1,h2{font-family:system-ui;line-height:1.2}h1{font-size:2.2em}h2{color:#117879}aside{padding:18px;background:#f2f6f7}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:14px system-ui}td,th{padding:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe3e7;text-align:left}tr:nth-child(even){background:#f2f6f7}img{max-width:100%}code,pre,footer{overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap}footer{font:12px system-ui;border-top:1px solid #cad7dc;padding-top:16px}button{padding:10px;background:#117879;color:white;border:0;cursor:pointer}@media(max-width:650px){main{padding:20px;margin:0}}@media print{body{background:white}main{margin:0;padding:0}button{display:none}}</style><main>',
                 '<h1>'+title+'</h1><p>'+html.escape(' · '.join(document['authors']))+'</p>',
                 '<aside>'+html.escape(document['abstract'])+'</aside>']
        for block in document['blocks']:
            kind = block['kind']
            if kind in ('paragraph','heading','equation'):
                tag = {'paragraph':'p','heading':'h2','equation':'pre'}[kind]
